description: Animal Courses Direct offer an extensive range of Regulated Qualifications that are designed to enhance career and employment prospects in the Animal Care, Veterinary and Wildlife sectors worldwide - our courses raise the standards of animal care through education.

records.title: Columbo was so amazingly helpful
records.text: Columbo was so amazingly helpful, he answered all my questions. He was so informative on the call and the conversation was so helpful. I’m so grateful and excited for my next journey with the courses!

records.title: Very good service
records.text: Very good service , lots of information given easy to sign up and can’t wait to get started

records.title: Extremely pleased
records.text: Had a lovely interaction with my agent called Aaron. He was really eager to help me get my courses started and extremely friendly. He answered all my questions extremely quickly. He was extremely understanding of my situation and even helped me get a discount due to my circumstances.I am now enrolled on the Access to Higher Education in Veterinary Science and have already completed my first module. I am really excited for complete this course, as it truly involves actual hard work and support for starting your university application and past that.I believe this course will truly get me ready to apply for a Bachelor’s in Veterinary Medicine once achieving the adequate grades. I truly recommend this service and thank Aaron and the team for giving me this opportunity to complete my life long dream of pursuing this career, especially after being unable to sit my A-Level exams earlier this year due to medical issues.Only thing that I do not like is that it does take a little bit to get your assessment reviewed and graded, but that’s understandable as a tutor has to manually review and this gives me time to start my other assignments whilst waiting.I will update this review after completing the course and give you a true rundown of how the course went.

records.title: Great experience
records.text: I had a great experience working with Columbo. He was incredibly friendly and took the time to explain everything to me in detail, which I really appreciated. His professionalism and clear communication made the entire process smooth. Highly recommend his work!

records.title: Eloise my placement advisor was amazing…
records.text: Eloise my placement advisor was amazing , she helped me secure my placement when I was beginning to lose hope , very helpful lovely lady.Becky

records.title: Very good and clear communications from…
records.text: Very good and clear communications from Columbo Bew.  A very knowledgeable and friendly customer service from him.  He was able to answer all our questions.   He was also patient enough to talk us through the registration process.

records.title: Animal Courses Direct offered a great service and great support
records.text: Animal Courses Direct offered a great range of courses to meet my needs. After looking through the website, I had some questions I wanted to ask, so I spoke to Columbo Bew. He was incredibly helpful and knowledgeable about the courses on offer, but more than that, he offered advice and was supportive in my quest to make a career change into something I am passionate about.

records.title: Great distance learning providor
records.text: The courses are well structured, assessment critera is concise and easily understood, additional resources are provided and it's nice to see your hard work pay off as your course progresses. Ariane Holder is my Hydrotherapy assessor and she's great. She marks submitted assignments quickly between 1 - 5 working days. The feedback is always warm and concise and she's told me exactly what I need to improve on and provides plenty of praise as well. Happy with my overall experience so far.

records.title: Best Placement Coordinator
records.text: I'm doing a level 2 Nurse Assistant Cours with Stonebridge Collage.Eloise - Placement Coordinator help me a lot the last few weeks. Without her would of lost my practical experience placement. She did everything in her power and find a tutor who could jump in and help me with questions from my placement director. Can't imagine friendlier and more helpful people. So so happy that I been matched with her in the journey.

records.title: Excellent Course and Tutor!
records.text: I have completed the level 3 diploma course for assistance dog training. The course was very easy to follow and I had a great tutor (Karen Marsh) who always got back to me quickly if I emailed with a question and she was very helpful with what I needed to do to improve my marks on the assessments. I’d definitely recommend using Animal Courses Direct.

records.title: Diploma in Canine care, Welfare and Behavior
records.text: I recently completed The Canine care, Welfare and Behavior Diploma course, and i must say, i am thoroughly impressed with the quality of the content.The modules were engaging and informative. The support provided by my tutor Karen was exceptional. However, my one issue was with the communication from the administration upon completing the course. I found it difficult to get a clear information about the certification process and had some delays in receiving my diploma. Improved communication in this area would greatly enhance the overall experience for students. Despite this minor hiccup, i would highly recommend this course.Thank you for offering such a valuable experience!

records.title: I have only done 2 modules so far
records.text: I have only done 2 modules so far. Going through the learning is simple enough. Ariane Holder who marks my assignments is great with the feedback which helps me alot. I know where to direct my learning My feedback to animal direct would be to give mature students like myself a little more guidance when going to complete assignments as to what they expect from you. I could have asked but I didn't. Really hoping to get hands on at some point as I learn better that way.

records.title: L4 diploma in canine training, welfare and behaviour
records.text: Good course content, and felt I learnt a lot from doing the course I did not know previously. The assessments were manageable, and again covered the essential things I would need to know to run a dog training business. My tutor, Karen was supportive throughout and marked things quickly and in detail. Some of the course content felt slightly too in depth for what I would require (in terms of anatomy and physiology, however appreciate some others going into slightly different career paths may benefit from this more).

records.title: Cainine First Aid Webinar
records.text: This course has alot of information that i found really interesting and what i didn't know.  Unfortunately i did find it hard to remember everything to be able to answer the quiz at the end.  It took me a while to make notes and to re-read the slides to give the right answers.  It would be good if you got quizzed after each subject so its bitesized it might make it better to digest it all.  Otherwise overall i thoroughly enjoyed listening to the webinar and learnt alot.

records.title: Hydrotherapy Dip level 3
records.text: Very well constructed course with easy to follow modules. Great to be able to study all the theory from home. A few minor mistakes in the text but very easy to report any issues that did arise. I had an extremely helpful tutor, Ariane Holder, who was quick to respond to any questions and even chased up my certification to try and speed things up for me as I needed proof of qualification as quickly as possible for work.

records.title: Very comprehensive and interesting…
records.text: Very comprehensive and interesting course and I feel I learned a lot.  Really liked my course tutor, especially in the speed at which she marked the assessments and answered any queries for me - helped speed up the process.  If I’m being totally honest, I found some of the assessments onerous in that they required small word counts in the  answer.  I found I spent more time reducing the word count than actually answering the question.  That’s being picky though, overall really enjoyed the course and learned a lot.

records.title: Just do the ofqual qualifications much better
records.text: The first course I did was first aid webinar it was OK for £20 but they should have done a short video assessment and made it a practical.The second course was the dog walking certificate which was a little disappointing for someone with a bit it knowledge for £100 However the IPET Level 3 Award was spot on and indepth video and tutor and assessment assessment known awarding body and £360 discounted was fair. Very pleased with Ipet award 😀

records.title: I signed up for the L3 Dip in Canine…
records.text: I signed up for the L3 Dip in Canine Care Behaviour and Welfare as a requirement for my Five Star Dog Breeding Licence and have enjoyed the course very much.  The resources provided were all very much appreciated and helped me step up to the challenge of completing the Course despite being very busy looking after my dogs and puppies.  The feedback has been informative and encouraging.   The length of time allowed (2 years) is about right and is certainly a generous amount of time to make allowances for those who have full time jobs.

records.title: Dip. Small Animal Hydrotherapy
records.text: Overall a great course. I found it to focus heavily on some areas more than others. For example more actual hydrotherapy scenarios and treatment plans etc through theory would have been useful but the practical placement was second to none in teaching me these things. The tutor was helpful and the payment plans made this course achievable for me. Although it is a Lv 3 Qualification prepare to spend some time on it, as a veterinary nurse some areas proved challenging and it took me just under 2 years to complete alongside work.

records.title: I have had a really good experience so…
records.text: I have had a really good experience so far. My tutor Ariane Holder has been super helpful and has been quick to reply for any questions that I have. She also marks my assignments quickly so that I can move on with the course or go back and make changes when need be.The only issue I have had is when I have contacted ACD directly and waited nearly two weeks for a reply so I contacted my tutor who was able to chase them up for me and get the issue resolved.

records.title: Good overall course
records.text: Very interesting course and I learnt a lot about basic canine behaviour and spotted they I was doing at my placement what I should have been doing.  One or two mistakes in units but no course booklet is perfect. Tutor was helpful when I got stuck on a question. Overall a good experience

records.title: Brilliant course
records.text: I loved the course I felt I learned a lot from it. Already started my next one and enjoying that one as well. The only reason for dropping a star was the course material, sometimes I had the reread a paragraph three times to work out what was being said. There where a lot of errors, I felt it obviously hadn't been read before being used as course material. Apart from that it was great, Lisa my tutor fantastic throughout.

records.title: The course in dog grooming level 3 has…
records.text: The course in dog grooming level 3 has been very challenging but I have enjoyed it immensely. However,  I am now ready for my practical placement and I have emailed my tutor 3 times with no reply over several weeks!  Getting a bit worried

records.title: Dog grooming level 3
records.text: I've just finished the theory part of the dog grooming course, just the practical after lockdown! Once done, I will review my opinion. The tutor was extremely helpful, lots of positive feedback on the assignments, which were swiftly marked. I really enjoyed the course, was a little 'rusty' to start with as not studied for years, but the course is enjoyable and I feel I'm now not to old to carry on learning, Would recommend this.

records.title: It has overall been a good experience.
records.text: It has overall been a good experience, I have nearly completed my course. I have enjoyed learning about hydrotherapy. I have found that some of the information is really difficult to find or not explained in a good way to understand. However when I ask my tutor for help, she always replies with resources that are very useful to make it easier to understand. I am looking forward to doing my practical placement.

records.title: I took the level 3 canine care
records.text: I took the level 3 canine care , welfare and behaviour course and I am very happy with a pass and the qualification. Some of the questions cannot be answered from the information given and need independent research and no copying, so must be put in your own words . records.title: Great course and helpful tutor
records.text: I have enjoyed my hydrotherapy course so far, even though I am only halfway through. My tutor Ariane is very helpful, grades the modules quickly and helps when I need it.My only critique would be that some of the questions are not very clear, especially where practical and theory are combined. records.title: Good course
records.text: Such a convenient course for those who still want to be able to work as it is all online so you can work at your own pace. Ariane, my tutor, was helpful when marking my work and always gave suggestions when I hadn’t completed the assignment correctly.

records.title: I have enjoyed the course especially…
records.text: I have enjoyed the course especially the behaviour section which I found both fascinating and insightful. The course was easy to follow with lots of resource material to read as additional support. I feel that the knowledge gained will help me greatly to understand my own dogs better (I have three and foster additional dogs) and work to enrich their lives to a greater degree. I am looking forward to enrolling to do the level 4 course once the tutor has marked my two assessments.

records.title: Good Course, suitable for my job
records.text: I have recently completed the Wildlife Rehab course and found it really informative, simply to use and useful for my day job.  The information is easy to find and the assessments are challenging yet achievable as long as you read the theory. I'm looking forward to booking the next course with Animals Courses Direct.

records.title: Good Course Content Awful Communication
records.text: Very good course content and easy to use portal. However, communication is awful. Despite emails, contact via social media no-one has been in touch to give me the results etc. When I used the virtual chat, the person shut me down and told me to ring with a smiling emoji. Really rude. Lots of reviews saying the same so buyer beware. Very poor experience which is a shame as I had intended to do more as the content was good. I shall be looking elsewhere.

records.title: Animal Campaigner Course
records.text: The Animal Campaigner Course gives a good insight into the welfare issues and the campaigns surrounding them. It can be basic at times and requires a lot of individual research from the student. There are lots of resources for each unit but they seemed outdated, no more current than around 2015. The grammar could be poor at times and could be written in a clearer way. Overall, this course has given me a good foundation to work from and the diploma will hopefully increase my employability.

records.title: Level 3 Diploma Canine Hydrotherapy
records.text: Level 3 Diploma Canine Hydrotherapy. The course was quite good and took me about a year. However I wished I’d gone to a centre first before paying the £3000+ for the course because a) I didn’t realise how much back pain I’d get from the work and b) it’s actually a really difficult industry to get into as it’s still quite specialist. I found this out on the work experience week which is the final element. I thought of setting up on my own but realised in order to make it pay, you have to treat a LOT of dogs. The premises, utilities, equipment (treadmills are £20,000+), chemicals, insurances, CPD versus a limit of say £35 - £40 charge per dog. Definitely do your research before embarking.

records.title: Change assessments partway through course (plus resolution info)
records.text: Animal Courses Direct recently changed the way my qualification is assessed. This was done without warning and after I was halfway through completed the original assessments (which I'm sure they're not allowed to do). Therefore, the many, many hours I'd spent answering essay questions was wasted, my answers to the original questions were deleted and I'm being told that I have to do all my work again...and I've paid £600 for the privilege. I'm currently trying to right against this but the company is not being very helpful. The contact that I have at the company is not responding to me and I don't feel my concerns have been taken seriously, despite me explaining how negatively this has affected me.EDIT (6th April 2021): Upon leaving the above review, I received a response from the contact at Animal Courses Direct that I had been corresponding with. She was attentive and I felt like she listened to and followed up my comments to a satisfactory level. I feel that my comments have been taken seriously, and have been reassured that the issue has been discussed at a high level within the company. I stand by the fact that this company making changes to my course assessments had a significant negative effect on me, but have been offered an upgrade on my course to make up for this. I am really happy about this resolution and feel this is a suitable gesture from the company to compensate the upset that was caused. It my sincere hope that Animal Courses Direct won't change course assessments for those part-way through a unit without warning in future.

records.title: good course, but not great
records.text: its good, but the questions can be repetitive and some of them can be confusing with the wording.i didnt like that you had to get everything correct to pass. there should be a threshold to pass. like 80% and above or something like that.for what the course is, i feel the price is too high.a lot of the questions required me to use google instead of being taught in the course. i could google stuff for free instead of paying £2300the tutor Julie was very helpful though.and i really enjoyed the week i worked at Colchester Zoo that was part of this course

records.title: This course is decent depending on how you take in information.
records.text: This course really has a great amount of information, however I wish it was a little easier to digest. I was hoping this course could be completed though more bitesize pieces, such a reading a topic, then answering questions based on that topic, and doing that a few times for each of the 6 units. Instead you have to read through A LOT of information to then complete the assessments afterwards for each unit. For me this took a long time to go through as I can't just sit and read and take the information in...even note taking took a while. By the time I got to the questions I had forgotten half of what I have read/noted down because it was so long ago. Other people may be great learning like this but unfortunately I am not one of them and so I feel like I have not learned a great deal because it simply has not stuck in my head well enough. After spending £400 this is not great. I believe the information simply needs to be broken down more. But I feel I have learned some things so its not a complete loss, I will just need to do more research in my own time to make sure I remember details of important topics. A few times a required help from my tutor, and after sending emails she always responded fairly quickly and she was very helpful everytime.

records.title: lots of mistakes

records.title: Although this was incredibly…
records.text: Although this was incredibly informative as someone who only keeps herps as a hobby i was able to complete the Herpetology level 3 diploma in 4 days roughly 7 hours to 100%. I wouldn't say it is worth £500 however it had relevant and interesting information.

records.title: Still no certificate from 2021
records.text: I completed my course early 2021. The course was very good and very well laud out, tutor was amazingly attentive and helpful with swift replies to questions. Unfortunately the administration side let's it down. My first certificate was delayed by about 9 months but i was told about this and i didn't have a problem. I changed my address on the system when i moved house into my mum's house while we purchased our new house. I moved again but didn't change address as my previous address was my mum's so she would let me know if anything turned up in the post for me. 2023 came along and i still hadn't heard anything, so contacted student services who had no record of the address my certificate was posted to, i receive no notification it had been posted to me and it must have been send to my very old address, although the signature said my name it hadn't lived at my old old address for 2 years at this point, or in the South, i moved up north. Anyway, shrugging it off as possible miscommunication. I paid £35 in April 2023 and still no sign of a replacement certificate and emails are no longer being replied to. I understand that they rely on a third party to source the certificates but this really needs to be sorted out for a better student experience. It is now 29th June 2023, i completed my course in early 2021 and still no certificate, so i can't start my own business or add it my CV. Really poor, after working so hard to get a qualification in something i actually care about.

records.title: Absolutely terrible communication!
records.text: Absolutely terrible communication with this company, I paid £800 for the course which I completed on the 3rd of August. I have made several enquiries since then in regards to receiving my certificate, being told that it can take up to 5 months to be sent out! Last night I logged onto my account again, thinking is there any further updates regarding this situation, and there was a message on my home screen waiting for me to confirm my details for the certificate to be sent to me! How long was that sitting there? Wouldn't it be a good idea to actually contact people via email to advise them the certificate was now ready and waiting? I think for an £800 course it needs a serious communication overhaul, very poor indeed! At the start of the course, it was impossible to get replies from the tutor and it took around 3 weeks to get my graded assignment back, but that situation improved when the tutor changed a few months into studying. I wouldn't recommend this college particularly, I'm glad I've done the course, but wouldn't do another one, mostly because of poor communication, which should be so much better when you're paying alot of money to complete!

records.title: Rabbit Studies diploma
records.text: I recently completed the Rabbit Studies diploma. As someone with a huge interest in rabbits and over 25 years experience as a rabbit owner, I was really excited to find this course available. Generally, I was happy with the modules covered, and I learnt about the biology of rabbits, was given new ideas on ways to enrich my rabbits lives, and feel more confident in how I take care of my rabbits.However, I feel the course was low quality for the price I paid.In terms of the course materials, there were multiple errors in the text and sentences that didn't make sense which made it hard to read at times. There were also various external links that didn't work. Additionally, in one section there were references leading me to believe I would be writing an essay to complete the module, which I prepared for, but instead found the final assessment was a multiple choice exam.I noticed information that is out of date with current research (e.g. a lot of mentions of mixed dry food which is not considered something that should be fed anymore, and a mention of feeding plum trees to rabbits which are now considered an unsafe wood as they contain arsenic which can be toxic.) There was also conflicting information (e.g. a recommendations of a cat ball with bell being used as an enrichment toy, then an attached PDF stating these are dangerous to rabbits). In terms of the modules covered, I was generally happy, but I would have liked some more information on diet - I felt that this module was very focused on how their digestive system works but lacking in practical information about what to feed. There were also various sections about other animals that didn't seem relevant, plus a huge amount of information on cleaning/hazardous materials in the final module that could have been condensed.Unlike other reviews I've noticed, there is no tutor for this course, or exams that are marked by a real person - it is all done online and the certificate is auto-generated at the end. This was not a problem for me at all, but I don't think it is very clearly mentioned at the beginning.In conclusion, the course is on the right track, but it really needs someone to review the information, make sure it is up-to-date with current research and to proof read to fix all the errors - this would make the course higher quality and value for money.

records.title: Feline Care, Behaviour & Welfare L3.  Needs work
records.text: Whilst the course is good (feline care, behaviour and welfare L3) and I’m enjoying it I’ve found it a frustrating process.  I’ve had a module marked incorrectly, modules graded but not all questions marked, few modules are marked within 7 days as promised. I’ve enjoyed the course but not the chasing of the tutor to rectify problems. It’s not a cheap course to undertake and I do feel a bit disappointed I’m afraid.

records.title: I would not recommend this course!

records.text: Online classes or courses can sometimes be considered to be boring or less educational, however, I found teach the teacher course virtual class really interesting and helpful. It was interactive throughtout, encouraged all participants to take part and even put pressure sometimes on few participants who were lagging or were introverts. I learned about new models and studies. I got to know about different ways by which I can improve my teaching and not just teaching, I would say it is gonna help me in everyday life in all the matters. Giving presentation/teaching on the 2nd day was very fun and in real meaning the time went by so quickl that we didn't even realize that course had completed.In the end, I would like to take this opportunity to appreciate Gill who was brilliant and kept things running smoothly. 👏Thank you team.

records.title: Excellent service and I would thoroughly recommend to others.
records.text: Excellent service and expertise.  I really appreciated the thoughtful approach and I got some great ideas for answers. I liked the format where constructive feedback was given after each individual answer rather than all at once at the end.  This is beneficial for several reasons including that memory of the answer is better immediately after. Additional materials including the videos and guide were very informative.

records.title: Can get the different training…
records.text: Can get the different training strategies. Can have the knowledge of aim, objective and outcome of learning.

records.title: Class was very lively and informative
records.text: Date of experience: 13 December 2024

records.title: Best training session I have attended
records.text: Best training session I have attended. Very interactive, lovely teacher/trainer, content was well laid out

records.title: Pre-course materials were good
records.text: Pre-course materials were good Study days themselves did feel slightly rushed and tech was difficult so I would probably do this course again face to face only

records.title: Different people teaching in same…
records.text: Different people teaching in same session . Got to pick few points from everyone's teaching method

records.title: Review of Oxford Teach the teachers course for Doctors
records.text: I recently completed this teaching course, and it was outstanding. Mrs. Heather was exceptional—her expertise in various teaching styles and methods brought the material to life. She demonstrated every technique with clarity and patience, ensuring we felt confident in applying these methods ourselves. Her passion for teaching made this course both inspiring and practical. Highly recommended!

records.title: It was an eye opening session to learn…
records.text: It was an eye opening session to learn the different modes of teaching, how best to reach my audience. And the Maslow hierarchy was useful

records.title: It’s a good course and taught very…
records.text: It’s a good course and taught very effectively with interactive sessions. However I feel it can be covered in one day rather than 2 day course easily.

records.title: It was a good experience and teaching…
records.text: It was a good experience and teaching environment.

records.title: It was a very comprehensive teaching
records.text: It was a very comprehensive teaching. The time keeping by Colin the host was impeccable. The course has given me good tips on how to become good at teaching. Using technology has been one of my drawbacks but they have helped me gain an insight into using newer tools to engage students.

records.title: A wonderful learning experience
records.text: A wonderful learning experience that can make a difference in your future self.

records.title: Teach the Teacher course
records.text: Actually I have been teaching for on and off to the small groups but I didn't knew much of the structure for teaching which I found it pretty good.

records.title: Well structured and informative
records.text: The courses are conducted really well. They are well structured and organised. The instructors make an effort to ensure that everyone is engaged and interacting to their fullest.I am a happy chappy after having attended a couple fo courses with Oxford Medical.

records.title: Good experience overall
records.text: Good experience overall. I personally prefer face to face teaching rather than online!!!A suggestion for improvement - have a small 30-60 min session on using various online teaching tools - like kahoot, mentimeter and others. The tutor can first show how to set up an online poll/quiz and then the mentees can then have a go at doing it themselves

records.title: The two days teaching was quite what I…
records.text: The two days teaching was quite what I wanted. Had a chance to reflect, to undertake good teaching plan. I would recommend it to my friends. One suggestion would be to give some pre course work or learning and to give more time for the discussions in future.The location was wonderful, refreshments and the food wad awesome. Loved the seating arrangement around tables, offline is much better than online no doubt.

records.title: Consultant Interview
records.text: Prof CK Sinha was very good and gave very excellent tips and tricks to Consultant Interview.Luckily we were only 3 candidates, had the opportunity to practice the interview.Prof C K Sinha, Thanks a lot for your guidance and advise about keep smiling.I went for my first substantive consultant interview and I smashed it. I have got the job.( 30th October 2023 )Many thanks again

records.title: Good Teacher and approach
records.text: The instructor/teacher  was very polite and knowledgeable. She provided good tips on how to teach and give presentations. the course is very much structured.concept of break intermittently make more involvement and keep every one active and involved in group discussion

records.title: It was well designed and interactive…
records.text: It was well designed and interactive course. Instructor was very helpful, encouraging and nice.Material was nice, easy and was taught in a way to make it simple and understandable.However i think its expensive. There is no difference in price in virtual and as in person course, where there is less use of resources.Overall i liked it and i hope it will help me in giving a teaching session.

records.title: The course was ok
records.text: The course was useful. I felt because the course was conducted by single person, that person was tired at the end to do constructive feedback..I feel if two people conduct, one can ask and one can listen to us and give better feedback.  I did learn how to talk from the other candidates rather than the person conducting it

records.title: Overall
records.text: Overall, the course was useful and had a lot of new information. I was glad to be with and amazing team of participants. But I can say that some improvements can be made to the course to become much more interactive and useful. First of all, personally I prefer in-person rather than online. Secondly, it would have been great if more than one person presented the course rather than one person only. Finally, It would have been much more interesting If you could provide some video lessons regarding the materials of the course before starting date.

records.title: the course was good
records.text: the course was good, and host had a good knowledge. The course material was good but not everything from the course book was mentioned during the course. There was good hands on

records.title: On the day 1 & 2  The tutor was quite…
records.text: On the day 1 & 2  The tutor was quite energetic and engaging. However,the sessions were too short. Tutor was giving frequent breaks and closed the session quite early. Projected it as if we want to leave early.The material given as attachments is excellent.

records.title: It was a very interactive and educative…
records.text: It was a very interactive and educative class.My tutor Gill made it fun.

records.title: Good but very highly priced.
records.text: The Teach the Teacher program for doctors is well-structured and delivers valuable content with a clear focus on enhancing teaching skills. The sessions are organized effectively, ensuring a good learning experience. However, the program's cost is disproportionately high compared to the value it offers, which can make it less accessible to many attendees. A more reasonable pricing structure that considers affordability would make it more inclusive and align better with the needs and expectations of the participants.

records.title: Good basic course. Complete rip off
records.text: Basic course. Decent intro but complete rip off for what it is. - Lasted from 0930-1430 or 1530 each day. Not sure why it finished early when we were paying £200 per day each...- No need to be 2 days long either when starting at that time and finishing early- Praying on keen doctors in a broken system needing "points" for applications

records.title: Interesting course  with useful …
records.text: Interesting course  with useful  advices  about how to improve teaching.Interaction was very nice and productive.Not too bad for a virtual course.I think  though the critic I received from the Teacher at some point was not  objective. It was rather based on the personal opinion of the Teacher but it was expressed in a way as it represented everyone in the classroom.I felt that I was targeted for having a loud voice (as if I know how my voice is heard through a laptop speaker).

records.title: Other institutes are offering the same…
records.text: Other institutes are offering the same course at a lesser price. Hence it would be nice if you reconsider the cost of the course

records.title: A Mixed Bag: Oxford Medical's "Online Teach the Teachers for Doctors" Course
records.text: Oxford Medical's "Online Teach the Teachers for Doctors" course, had its ups and downs.Heather was a welcoming and professional instructor, but the course material felt like readily available free content online. The second day mainly consisted of lengthy 12-minute presentations, which became monotonous. Feedback during these sessions lacked constructive criticism, as participants tended to be overly polite. Short group exercises offered some relief but couldn't fully compensate for the tedium of the second day.Overall, the course felt overpriced, and while some may have different expectations, it didn't meet mine.

records.title: This was my first interview course…
records.text: This was my first interview course experience and I’ve heard from past candidates Oxford tutors give lots of personal pointers to improve .My learning experience was from hearing how other candidates were performing ,and unfortunately the tutor just kept on saying you need to practise and nothing else .I did not receive any personal feedback on things I need to change and how I should say things differently.This as a shame .

records.title: It was online meeting which was more…
records.text: It was online meeting which was more convenient as you don’t have to travel to Oxford to get the course. However this made the course less interactive. The topic of the course I was not oriented with it before this made this course very useful for me.

records.title: I learnt a few theoretical aspects of…
records.text: I learnt a few theoretical aspects of identifying the type of students and how to make teaching more interactive. But mostly I found it boring and less stimulating to the mind.

records.title: Overall
records.text: Overall, the course is well-structured and informative; however, it is relatively expensive considering the content provided.

records.title: Ok, but was hoping for a bot more.
records.text: I was expecting some more tools and professional feedback rather than exercising between each other without a facilitator. Otherwise well provided session.

records.title: The activity or the course is titled…teach the teacher for doctors
records.text: The activity or the course is titled teach the teacher for doctors so I thought there would be some elements or components that are related directly to our work as a clinicians but unfortunately it’s a kind of course that you would provide for any teacher without any specification.I believe in interactive activity but some presentation is needed. For example the theories of adult learning  were not covered at least the basic principles of each one and examples for each one were mot mentioned for practical application. Just mentioned auickly.

records.title: I thought the two days were fine
records.text: I thought the two days were fine, I certainly learnt new teaching skills and ways of learning.I suppose I was hoping to find more ways of conveying information-helpful tactics to share information. I expect a lot of this is in the handbook so perhaps that is why it wasn't covered.I engage less well with lots of theories of teaching which I felt there was mroe focus on. The trainer was encouraging and interested

records.title: No tailored individual feedback
records.text: Re: Oxford Medical Training CMT/Reg Interview CourseUseful, but would appreciate more individualised feedback and more than 1 consultant/senior registrar tutor. What I liked was being able to watch other people's answers/techniques especially if they were more senior. However there was a definite lack of tailored feedback or fruitful discussion after the individual interviews. This was quite disappointing given the high cost of the course.

records.title: This is with regards the teach the…
records.text: This is with regards the teach the teachers course. The first day was very useful with theory and some group work but the second day was very little content. It was an opportunity to 'teach the group' and get feedback but such fake situation and the feedback of minimal help considering the amount of time I was there. Disappointing for the amount paid. 3 stars as first day was brilliant.

records.title: The first day was useful and practical…
records.text: The first day was useful and practical however there were too many people in the class so the second day was not very useful as there were too many individual talks and not much time was able to be spent learning about feedback.  I felt the first day was useful in general but because of the group size I don't feel I got very much at all out of the second day.

records.title: Filmed mock interview brilliant. Morning session less useful
records.text: Afternoon session was brilliant. Full mock interview with feedback and video. Invaluable. 5+ stars.However the morning was disappointing - lacked focus, I felt like I knew more than the host on some topics, and the slides were out of date. My time would have been better spent on BBC news website. So 1-2 stars for the morning, 5 stars for the afternoon = 3/5

records.title: This was a well-organised course with…
records.text: This was a well-organised course with engaging instructor and good venue. The pre- and post- course communication was excellent. However, this was not a course on either leadership or management: we focussed almost entirely on personal project planning, making it feel more like a careers workshop. Good course but not as per the advertised title.

records.title: ST/CT Interview Course
records.text: This course was overpriced at £300. The hot topics section was useful but the practice interview in the afternoon was not. We had one consultant interviewing all 8 of us. The actual practice interview was only 20 mins then you had to watch everyone else. For £300 I would expect a 3/4 station interview with more than one consultant, longer time and specific feedback

records.title: Difficult to review this course, far too expensive
records.text: Difficult to review this course. The tutor was great, managing to make the topic interesting for the full 2 days, made you feel included and gave opportunties to try teaching. But that’s all it was, a try. 18 people to 1 tutor is way too many. No opportunity to individually teach a small group session and very little chance to practice the techniques learnt. If you have teaching experience I question if this course will add anything you don’t know alread , and all this at over £300!

records.title: I did not feel that i learnt very…
records.text: I did not feel that i learnt very specific tips as to how to answer the questions. Mainly listening to others answering questions, not relevant to my specialty, not much feedback even when we were not answering very well, I was only asked 8 interview questions in the whole day.

records.title: Did not seem tailored to Medics and the…
records.text: Did not seem tailored to Medics and the NHS. Some of the activities reminded me of High School learning! Very friendly tutor though.

records.title: Some interesting information…
records.text: Some interesting information possibility of receiving the recorded answer but not enough time for feedback. Feedback was very general, no time to ask detailed questions. No much hint given to the specific questions. My recording showed other person not me but at least my voice.

records.title: Overpriced and unnecessarily long
records.text: What i got out of the course could have been summarised in a 2h lecture. The course is very pricy for what you get, and very stretched out 2 days unnecessarily.

records.title: Dissatisfied
records.text: I had high hopes from the interview preparation course but honestly I was a bit disappointed with they way the session was conducted. I was expecting it to be more enlightening which unfortunately it was not.

records.title: Course was vague and answer given very…
records.text: Course was vague and answer given very vague and not helpful. Definitely not consultant level

records.title: Could have been a 10 minute YouTube video
records.text: Not much. Didn't learn allot

records.title: -The course interface needs…
records.text: -The course interface needs development: it doesn’t save progress, videos need subtitles -The course should have more videos-The content isn’t sufficient, the course doesn’t teach communication skills as much as it enhances pre-existing skills-No topic was explained in depth -The module notes are poorly written, it’s not illustrative as much as it’s a literary prose

records.title: Quite expensive for the quality
records.text: It was an acceptable course but quite expensive for the given quality nd material. There was only 1 speaker for 2 days. I suggest there should be couple of speakers. AV aids were sub standard. Venue was decent and food was good but these things aren't top most priority for me. I am afraid I won't recommend this course to my friends for this price.

records.title: Not particularly focused for ST3 interviews.
records.text: Course broad and not specific enough to ST3 interviews.  Facilitator had no recent knowledge of the ST3 interview structure or how it is marked, I think he would have been very knowledgable for a consultant interview course though.  Basic skills taught that skim reading a interview book could have given me.  Expensive for what it was.  Positive was that we had a reasonable amount of practice interview questions and lunch was ok.  Wouldn't recommend though.

records.title: Teach the teacher
records.text: The course delivered an ok amount of learning but needed to be more focused on theory and application. I also felt that it did not help with building on confidence and presentation skills, which was a key outcome that we had discussed. I was unfortunately unable to attend the second day due to sickness and was disappointed that I was told that I could not attend the second day at another opportunity to complete the course.

description:
TTC Group
We are a leading provider of driver education and road safety services. With a commitment to improving road safety, TTC offers innovative solutions, including driver training, risk management, and eLearning programs.
Our expertise helps individuals and organisations promote safer driving behaviours, reducing risk for all road users.
We are trusted by UK Police Forces, Government Agencies, Magistrates Courts, and commercial organisations to deliver high quality training, helping to make our roads safer for everyone.
"Protecting people on the move."
The quality of our services is a priority for TTC, which is underpinned by our ISO:9001 Quality Management System.

records.title: Non judgmental and friendly. Tea provided.
records.text: I was slightly apprehensive at first but pleasantly surprised at the informality and friendliness of the presenters. It was not judgemental which put people’s mind at rest. It was informative without being condescending. I personally learnt a few things particularly stopping distances and time saved when driving at speed. Very pleased that tea was provided. 3 hours is a long time without a warm drink at my age. Thank you

records.title: Driving Awarenes. Roy
records.text: I attended the course on 20 December 2024 at Sandal rugby Club. The content of the course was very good and made me aware of certain aspects of driving and road lay outs that I had forgotten over the years. The instructors were first class and loads of audience participation and questions back and forth.

records.title: Speed awareness course
records.text: Took TTC Speed awareness course through online zoom meeting.  The host was wonderful and made the course a pleasurable experience which was a surprise.   Very informative about the speed limits through different roads and stopping distances.  The added bonus was no points on licence.  If you get the option use TTC

records.title: Better Driver
records.text: The knowledge of my trainers exceeded any queries I had, they delivered the course in a serious but jovial manner which kept my Intrest & concentration level throughout. The course was delivered in a factual approach but in lay man's terms that was easy to take on board. The course really has improved my driving, definitely worth a 5 star performance.

records.title: NSAC course
records.text: The NSAC course I attended not only was informative but reminded me not to take road use for granted after many years of driving.  Our trainers were amiable and made the course well worth attending.

records.title: Steve was great and made the course…
records.text: Steve was great and made the course very interesting.It definitely wasn’t punishment by boredom completely the opposite it was very educating for a driver like myself who passed my driving test 43 years ago.

records.title: Thoroughly enjoyable and interesting
records.text: From the moment I registered with the person leading the course to rut moment it ended the whole experience was fantastic. The plan of thir course was explained at the start and each section was interesting and factual, questions were asked to each of us during the session and explanations given. I really enjoyed the session and would happily do it again (without the letter of the police though), it's pace and nice way to refresh my knowledge.

records.title: Surprisingly enjoyable!
records.text: Wasn't sure what to expect as first time doing a speed awareness course but I was pleasantly surprised how interactive it was (online), how much I enjoyed it and how much I learnt (even though  having over 30 years experience!).  There were lots of tips and strategies to take away.The trainer Phil was brilliant, very friendly, engaging and knowledgeable.  I would consider other courses to refresh knowledge.

records.title: Sarah
records.text: Sarah, who delivered the online coarse, was very respectful of all the people who sat the coarse. There were a wide range of ages and experience from all over the uk. Everyone including myself took something away from this.Well done Sarah.

records.title: Really informative and excellent trainers - Cumbria
records.text: Really informative and excellent trainers. So glad I have done it. I have learnt a lot and it has had a positive impact on my driving, and my responses to situations. Great atmosphere with fellow participants, I think mainly because it was non-judgemental and realistic, that even the best of us can make mistakes when driving. The techniques and knowledge I gained make me feel that I will now be a better driver. I even went out and bought myself an updated Highway Code because I wanted to keep learning. Thank you to the trainers, definitely 3 hours well spent.

records.title: Experienced trainers and good use of various types of learning
records.text: Belinda and Jack were experienced trainers who listened but kept things moving! They had a pragmatic style plus started/finished on time. Good mix of slides, videos, discussions etc. Ended up with some practical things to ‘put into practice’ rather than an unrealistic ‘wish list’.

records.title: Useful in-person course with calmly…
records.text: Useful in-person course with calmly authoritative and inclusive trainers. Would have given five stars but for the other participants (routinely talking about themselves/their own experience, blaming others - notably cyclists - and rubbishing the given statistics). I would have been interested to attend a course exclusively for women, and/or to have heard more from the small minority of other women in the room. I would also like the course to include some content from a road accident survivor or a parent/loved one of someone killed in a road traffic accident to a.) convey the human impact of speeding at its worst and b.) to hopefully shut down some of the louder voices in the room who seemed to take no responsibility for being there. I wonder if this is something the Road Victims Trust might support with? Potentially for a small percentage of each course given to the charity.

records.title: Good facilitator and friendly group dynamic
records.text: Mike was brilliant to assuage our fears of doing the course. Just wish the police would work with people reporting bad driving instead of punishing the safe drivers. The course made sure we were comfortable with ways we can avoid falling foul of this in the future.

records.title: No lecture given
records.text: I was expecting a 3hour lecture, and I was pleasantly surprised. The information provided was very given in a way I feel I will retain it for the future. I learned some signs regarding street lights I wasn't aware of.Simon an Ian used their own experience and expertise to help make the course interesting, an helpfulWith

records.title: A good refresher course
records.text: I was impressed by the video content and the discussion that went along side each video. It did show that just taking your driving test is not enough to keep safe driving. As a retired driving instructor remembering your old lessons and commentary driving is so important. It also shows how lack of knowledge and the Highway Code makes drivers vulnerable on these Smart Motorways.

records.title: Got us through it as painlessly as possible
records.text: This was an online speed awareness course, nobody wants to do it obv, and some of it is reminding you of some pretty basic stuff, but we all made choices that got us there, so we can’t complain. The admin and organisation was good, the guy running it was friendly and kept things ticking over well and kept us involved and engaged. A couple of the awareness videos were a bit choppy for me, but that might have been a connection issue and it didn’t really impact the course. Possibly they could think about improving the inclusiveness of some of the language, but that’s a minor point too. In summary, they did the job, they got us through as painlessly as possible. If you find yourself in the position of needing this, then I’d recommend.

records.title: Prevent Death & Injury - Make the Most of Your Speed Awareness Course
records.text: The course was provided in my native Welsh language which was a great aid to understanding. The tutors engaged well with us and helped us to grasp the effect on stopping distance of even a tiny 1mph over the speed limit as shown in a video re-enactment. We ended by devising a personal action plan that would minimise the likelyhood of speeding. In my case ALWAYS select 2nd gear when entering a 20mph zone. The course was a very worthwhile use of my time. My only criticism was that the TV screen was way too small for such a large room.

records.title: I thought the content was good and felt…
records.text: I thought the content was good and felt more examples would have been helpful

records.title: An informative course
records.text: A very interesting, useful and informative 3 hour course. The trainers set everything at a sensible level for a diverse group of 25 people and it never hurts to refresh your memory. It would have rated 5 stars if light refreshments had been provided.

records.title: i wasnt looking forward to the…
records.text: i wasnt looking forward to the course,but the man taking the course was very easy to listen to and made the time go quickly and i did actualy learn a lot.

records.title: Not too much dogma.
records.text: Not too much dogma, not judgemental. Some misinformation which stated that fuel can be saved by setting an automatic to sport mode or that delaying gear changes when accelerating in a manual also saves fuel. Better than points on my licence.

records.title: Well run course by professional tutors
records.text: Very clear course run by the tutors. Kept to time and emphasised the importance of being aware of different signage in respect of speed.

records.title: course served to remind us of some…
records.text: The course served to remind us of some driver safety information that we may have forgotten but moreover it enlightened me on stuff that we should have been taught during the process of getting our license. I enjoyed the course because of the diversity with women and men from all walks of life.

records.title: A very thought provoking session
records.text: A very thought provoking session. I came rather cynical but the data/evidence of the implications of driving over the speed limit, even small ones, really made an impact and I learnt stuff that I will apply. It was a good use of time, thank you.

records.title: Informative and useful
records.text: I found the course very informative and interesting. The statistics given are surprising and shocking, especially the residual speeds when needing to stop in an emergency. Due to being on a hill and the momentum of my vehicle meant my speed crept up to 26 in a 20 (so did the vehicles in front). I have taken away a lot of the information provided. I only gave 4 stars as the connection wasn't great at times, otherwise a great course. Cannot fault Chris, great tutor, thank you.

records.title: Booking was fairly straightforward.
records.text: Booking was fairly straightforward.During the course, I was pleased the tutor was willing to say a few words explaining that horse riders are much more vulnerable as road users than many people realize.I was genuinely taken aback by how little time is really saved by speeding.

records.title: Sarah was our facilitator.
records.text: Sarah was our facilitator.. she’s was brilliantly cheery and clear even at 7:45 am … the audio visual experience was disappointing.. if you are showing “ examples “ if what and what not to do and “ what happened next “ then the quality of the graphics and audio needs an over haul … best Mark

records.title: Very professional and engaging…
records.text: Very professional and engaging trainers, made it interesting and made me think far more of my speeding/driving, even tho been driving 52 years. I felt engaged throughout the course,

records.title: Well delivered training without any…
records.text: Well delivered training without any judgement.

records.title: Who knew about phantom traffic jams and that the bulbs blow on gantry signage??
records.text: The course was interesting and informative.  The instructor deftly handled one participant who kept leaving the call which did adversely affect the experience for me and everyone else, I suspect.  Clearly this was not the instructor's fault.  The reason I am not giving this course five stars is due to the joining the meeting problems/instructions.  I got a text the day before and it didn't give me a link to the meeting.  I do online group meetings all the time and they are always very easy to join.  This one was not and I was panicking that I was going to not get in to it on time.

records.title: Excellent instructor and excellent but
records.text: Excellent instructor and excellent content. Only 3 stars because sound was very poor and videos tiny, with any pictures being blurred.

records.title: Poor start to the course.
records.text: 1. Course started 20 minutes late and instructor did not say why, it may have been people having technical issues logging but no feedback was provided.2. Course could not be listened too in head set, advert worked fine but when in meeting head set didn't work.3. Instructor spent first 30 minutes telling us about him having to go to accountant about his tax return and getting his dates mixed up for the courses. Not relevant.4. Course content is good and demonstrates speed in a way I'd not seen before.

records.title: I can now drive faster on dual track roads
records.text: I was amazed that the man next to me had done 6 of these courses, and another man close to me just ignored the course, more or less snoozing, as he said he was there happily as he was being paid for nine hours to sit there and do nothing for only 3 hours! I learnt that I have been driving much slower than was necessary on dual track roads. I have always carefully driven up to 59mph on those routes, but now find that I am allowed to go 69mph when safe to do so! Thank you.Jill Hammonds

records.title: The course but helpful but much too long and repetitive
records.text: The course but helpful but much too long and repetitive, making it difficult to concentrate for that length of time. It would ne more effective if shorter and more focussed on key issues.  I'm sure prople would get more out of the course if this happened.

records.title: Good course but needs improving!
records.text: Found this very interesting and thought provoking. The two people invigilating the course were fun and informative but not very PC. Kept referring to husband and wife, little dated in todays times! The videos and photo were very hard to see and were of very bad quality and could easily be improved. Learnt my car has a speed restrictor on it which may help. Really makes you thing about the time you save by driving faster, it's minimal.

records.title: Online course
records.text: Content was good, learnt some new things and useful refresher of others. I tried to get involved and answered the questions, but being a quiet person, found others regularly spoke over me and I simply wasn’t heard. I’m not used to online meetings being run that way - it is usual to keep people muted and use the raise hand function to enable everyone to have a fair chance to speak. I found it very difficult, as a highly introverted person trying to participate in a loud uncontrolled environment.

records.title: Was put under stress to do 3 hours of study
records.text: Was put under stress as have a wife with advanced Alzheimer's Dementia. 3 hours course is a very long time to fail to proved her with care. Feel they breach Human Rights. Should have taken the 3 points and fine. Course told me many things I already knew. Tried to tell instructor that people in the middle island should be allowed to cross road as pedestrian have priority over cars. Had bought the new Highway code as keen to make a positive contribution. Feel very upset to be driving away from a danger zone and get camera taking back plate whilst on a country road. Will not drive subconsciously in a safe manner, but obey every half hidden tiny sign in a hawthorn hedge in future to meet every hidden camera that is out to make money. Not many say what they feel.

records.title: The course was good on the whole
records.text: The course was good on the whole, the lady presenting it was very good. My reason for marking this as 3 stars is that a lady was asked to leave because her child opened the door twice to where she was sitting. I think it was too much, I felt very anxious after that that I may need to go to the loo or have an emergency and there is no leeway whatsoever. It’s not an exam course so I don’t feel there is any need to be so militant. I felt very sorry for the lady who had to leave, it wasn’t her fault and totally unnecessary.

records.title: our trainer was excellent
records.text: our trainer was excellent. However I had to do this course about 7 years ago - and had to go in person. The course then was in every single respect very superior to this one. I left that course genuinely shocked by the dangers of even small breaks of the speed limit. This course had no heft, no emotional engagement, no content that was memorable. It was content by AI.

records.title: Speed Awareness course spoilt by background noise
records.text: The course material and trainers were generally goodHowever the course was spoilt by the amount of background noise emanating from a wedding reception which was taking place at the same timeThis made it difficult to hear the trainers and to concentrate, i would suggest that the meeting room should not be used if an event was taking place downstairs

records.title: Speed awareness course suggestions....
records.text: It was very well presented but it does get a little frustrating when the same person over and over shouts out the answers not giving other people chance to answer any questions,  maybe people need to respect others in the room and give others chance. Maybe you could suggest people put their hands up so it gives the less out spoken people a chance to speak?

records.title: Speed Awareness Course
records.text: Whilst the course overall was very useful, the two course leaders made unnecessary comments. One said their partner was given a "finders fee" for recommending them to the company, the other kept making assertive comments that everyone's cars had speed limiters and cruise control. My 2009 car has neither of these. The same person spent a couple of minutes, assertively saying you should argue with a Police officer if they are attempting to bring you into a box junction at red traffic lights so they can pass. The instructor had already made their point. There was no need to repeat it three times. It seemed apart from being led by the slides we were shown, the course instructors had no other professional input to make their presence worthwhile

records.title: This is the second course I have…
records.text: This is the second course I have attended, and to be honest, I got more from the first one. On this course, we were shown four animated clips and then given four answers to cover the possible hazards. I saw at least three but we were only required to give one! It made things slightly unreal and I didn't enjoy this second course as much as the first.

records.title: WELSH LAW…
records.text: I COMMITTED MY OFFENCE IN WALES BUT THE COURSE WAS BASED ON ENGLISH RULES, I THINK WELSH RULES WERE MENTIONED TWICE OR THREE TIMES. 20 MPH SPEED LIMIT, NO REPEATER SPEED LIMIT SIGNS. CONFUSION OVER STREET LIGHTS, SPEED LIMIT SIGNS OBSCURED BY FOLIAGE.

records.title: keep learning
records.text: a worthwhile course, with some good content. plenty of areas for refeshing & updating knowledge. Just too little information stretched out over a too long time period, helpful tho' !

records.title: Found the lady a little intimidating
records.text: Found the lady a little intimidating, a felt like a naughty schoolgirl!! Constantly being told to answer questions, "too many answers from the front but not the back'' being told to stand up and shake your arms about as some members were falling asleep...  That's because content was boring Most of the congregation  were in their 70's. Found some of the information inaccurate.

records.title: Informative Course - shame about one of the tutors
records.text: The course content was informative, comprehensive, and thought provoking . It presented a reminder of what the consequences of speeding can be backed up with statistics.The course was presented by 2 tutors, M & J.  However, J was not of the same calibre as M.  J was was patronising and opinionated with a very passive aggressive manner when challenged.  Whilst I absolutely appreciate we were on the course to learn due to committing a speeding offense and being told at the beginning that engagement was key, speaking down to people is not the best way to foster engagement. Even when engaging with J they had their own opinion.  I was told to avoid speeding I should plan things better.  I'm a senior project manage with the UK Government managing multi-million pound projects - think I know how to plan things.....! Overhaul a slightly disappointing as J's attitude lowered the impact of the course as one feared to contribute in case we were  spoken down to.Wouldn't recommend this supplier if J continues to be one of their tutors.

records.title: The safety aspects were well presented in respect of actions and consequences, speed and human integration. Unfortunately the instructor failed to engage with constructive questioning.
records.text: The safety aspects were well presented in aspects of consequences and details.Also, I appreciated driver awareness and concentration elements.What was frustrating was the ‘instructor’ failed to engage with constructive criticism of certain course topics.ie: the 20 mph across the board speed limit in Welsh urban areas.She instigated the law was perfect valid and failed to question why 30 mph was the agreed safe limit in The rest of the uk AND that Wales is almost certain to revert back to the 30 mph limit  soon.It was like she had her brief and that was not to be questioned at all!

records.title: the couse will teach you something
records.text: Unfortunately I could not alwys understand what the lady was saying but she still managed to give some useful information and the graphics were helpful .

records.title: Course content was ok
records.text: Course content was ok.  Visuals were a little bit unimaginative.  A previous speed awareness course which I attended around 15 years ago was much more hard hitting and used real life high profile examples of when speed or tiredness can, and does kill.

records.title: Condescending/patronising
records.text: The joining instructions for this course were sent only the day before and because of this some key information was missed. The course started half an hour later due to registration delays. The  dialogue with the trainer was condescending and I felt that he could have handled the discussion around the attendees feedback instead of dismissing what we were saying without acknowledging the reasons behind our opinion. He needs to think about his words and accept that if asking for someone's opinion then he needs to take it on board at least before dismissing it entirely.

records.title: Could be better
records.text: The joining instructions for this course were sent only the day before and because of this some key information was missed. The initial dialogue with the trainer was condescending and I felt that he could have  handled the discussion around the action plan better instead of dismissing what I was saying. He needs to think about his words.

records.title: Too much crammed into 3 hour course not…
records.text: Too much crammed into 3 hour course not all equally relevant / no written material provided /  insufficent time for Q&As. All that said the course did refresh my memory on the principles  underlying  speed limits and brought home to me the terrible injuries or deaths cars can cause even at very low speeds

records.title: Driving course
records.text: Really great that you are able to undertake the course from home - lots of information However the trainer treated us like school children I was even asked to ‘prove’ I wrote something down when reading my action plan when I’m 29 years old I found this extremely rude and patronising if it wasn’t for the trainer I would of given this a 5

records.title: Incorrect info at times.
records.text: Gave incorrect info a few times and advised the reliance on cruise control/speed limiter far too much.Didn't seem to grasp that cruise control will not stop you exceeding the speed limit and that cruise and limiter will be disengaged when you brake or change gear, therfore making them useless.Talked about how stopping at the end of a slip road is a huge no-no, but wouldn't admit you may be required, by law, to do exactly that! The stopping distances they talked about was wildly inaccurate too, especially regarding 30mph vs 31mph

records.title: Poor content
records.text: Trainer was good, and the process to attend was easy.The content was extremely poor. The course seems to be based around emotional manipulation and an incredible ‘education’ video (incredible … not in a good way).

records.title: Contents and Delivery of the Course needs totally restructuring
records.text: At times, due to diction with both and one tutor speaking too quickly, sometimes ending sentences like Michael Parkinson, it was sometimes not possible to clearly hear what the two tutors were saying. The room was unsuitable audibly, partly due to the very high ceiling, so why hold it there. The Tutors need to be "miked up" which would be a distinct advantage. It was disappointing that in having to pay £88.00p for the Course, that the form said to bring own pen and notepaper and that no soft drinks would be provided. Water, pens and One sheet of notepaper were provided. It was also very disappointing that in having to pay £88.00p that a copy of the Highway Code was not included. There were 24 people there, we were told all for speeding offences, but for me, insufficient time was given to RECOGNISING THE SIGNS FOR SPEED LIMITS, and too much time on the consequences that speeding can cause. Solving the ROOT CAUSE, substantially helps to REDUCING the CONSEQUENCES.

records.title: Better than points on your licence, but
records.text: The material around avoiding driving when stressed or tired by using breathing exercises and taking breaks was well presented and well stated. However, a lot of the material is misleading or possibly even a misrepresentation of facts. The statement that every 17 minutes someone is injured or killed in a collision with a car is meaningless. Of course there will be accidents given the number of cars and the number of journeys made in the UK. The nature of accidents is there is a certain inevitability, but what is critical to a course such as this is: how many could have been avoided by people who were speeding, while not commiting another driving offence at the same time (such as using a phone or being under the influence)? The example of a car travelling 31 mph as opposed to 30 mph is also misleading, while it would be fair to say that while driving at a slower speed one has more time to react, when driving marginally faster a good/sensible driver still may have enough time to react and would likely react sooner to an obstruction ahead, but this isn't how it was presented

records.title: Absolutely no good if you suffer…
records.text: Absolutely no good if you suffer anxiety with and don't like participation, I should have taken the points, the course in itself is a deterrent for me not to break the limit.  Awful experience for me.

records.title: Respect
records.text: I attended this course at North Petherton Rugby Club on the 30th of July at 08:00hrs. The course content was fine but felt that both instructors were patronising and didn’t really get the feel of the attendees, mostly middle aged and above.Can I suggest a little more respect and course assessment of their own, would be beneficial.

description:
130 YEARS EXPERIENCE                                                                          

We’ve been pioneers in distance learning for 130 years, and partners with leading professional bodies like CIPD for more than 30 years.

                                                                        

Offering a wide range of globally recognised professional qualifications across HR, L&D, accountancy, management, IT, marketing and more, we take pride in helping our students start and advance their careers from anywhere. 

                                                                        

 LEARN AT YOUR OWN PACE   

                                                                        

We make getting qualified simple and flexible. Our online courses enable you to learn at home, at work, or even on the go! All you need is an internet connection. 

                                                                        

 UNLIMITED TUTOR SUPPORT  

                                                                        

Whether it be online or by phone, we help you achieve your goals with support from your expert tutors, giving you the confidence that you’re on the right track throughout your learning journey. 

                                                                        

 FLEXIBLE PAYMENT PLANS  

                                                                        

We know life can get pricey – that’s why we offer students the option to spread the amount of their course across set monthly payments at no extra cost, making learning flexible and affordable so you can get ahead without feeling behind. 

                                                                        

 PRICE MATCH GUARANTEE  

                                                                        

We’ll match any online provider’s price, so you can learn with total flexibility and get the best deal.

                                                                        



 REVIEWS

records.title: Good

records.title: Good for AAT level 2,3 and 4
records.text: I've used ICS Learn for AAT levels 2, 3 and 4. Using only the ICS self-study resources and the AAT website, I've passed all exams, so what you get IS enough. The online learning platform has lessons based on a PowerPoint type structure, where you read each screen and work through examples and small tests of knowledge before moving on. Each module is broken down into chunks with computer marked and tutor marked tests at the end. There's also pre-recorded or live seminars (usually just one or two per module) and tips on he assessment format. The price of the courses is good too, and they often give discounts on the next level. Personally I've found the tutors to be responsive, getting back to me within the stipulated 4-5 days. Generally feedback is useful however sometimes I got "take another look at X subject" which isn't much help when you don't know where you're going wrong. That being said, if I'd asked for clarification I'm sure they would have explained. One downside is that there are occasional spelling or continuity errors but these don't really affect the experience. I also found the support period for level 4 to be too short, which is something to bear in mind. Overall I'd recommend ICS Learn for AAT.

records.title: Great support, the study materials could use improvement
records.text: The support I received was excellent. Whether I reached out to my tutor or the Student Services team, my questions were always answered promptly and thoroughly. However, the study materials could use improvement. While they cover the basics, they rely heavily on text, which can make the learning experience dull at times. Incorporating videos would really enhance the experience with the course.

records.title: Why I enjoyed learning from ICS Learn.....
records.text: This was the first time for me to do this kind of online course and at first I was dubious about whether I could do it but with the help of my Tutor and the layout of the ICS Learn Dashboard, I was able to navigate my course program with ease.Even the course content was brilliant.  I loved the scenarios and the down-to-earth way the definitions were explained so that I could relate to them in my work environment.  The diagrams were also a huge help to get a better understanding of the information and these stuck with me, so much so that I was able to pass all 7 units with no referrals.

records.title: Before you enroll make sure it’s the right course for you.
records.text: Update: I have increased my review with a couple of stars and updated my review on it due to the great customer service received from Rory and Dominic recently. Thank you both for your support, it’s much appreciated.🙏🏻 This might be or maybe not the right school for you. For some it’s a great one for others perhaps it’s not the right fit. What I would suggest is to make sure you’re informed about the course before you register and that you’re happy to enroll into a fully self thought course where you need to do a lot of online reading and submit your assignments afterwords. Also make sure that the course you’re choosing will really make a difference to your career as they have a wide range of different course so choosing the right one is important.Good luck in your studies.
