records.title: I had a problem signing in that was…
records.text: I had a problem signing in that was related to my laptop misfunctioning and was in danger of losing my 100 plus day streak. I contacted Julia at Busu support and heard back within 24 hours and with her help kept my streak!

records.title: Busuu is a great app.
records.text: The Busuu app is a great experience. I have tried many but only Busuu is logically and compactly done for me, which allows me to achieve good English in a short time. Busuu, in my opinion, has a good understanding of the needs of students and knows how to teach English well. I miss the lessons that used to be online with native speakers of English. One thing that bothers me is the gendern in Spanish lessons, such as two women and one is supposed to be an uncle and the other an aunt. This trend is already becoming unattractive especially after the US election. I wish the company the best of luck as you are doing a good job. With greetings from a satisfied Busuu customer.

records.title: Bussu is great
records.text: Bussu is one of the few language learning  apps that helps you succeed. Most other apps either give pointers about where to go and let you figure it out, or guide you hand in hand through every step. Bussu has a perfect mix of just enough guidance and just enough freedom to be challenges by lessons. Really amazing app and in my opinion the best for learning a new language:)

records.title: Great for learning German
records.text: Great for learning German. Uses nowadays themes and expressions, also teaches about local culture and places. Platform reliable both on desktop and phone.

records.title: Busuu support experience
records.text: Busuu is a platform to learn languages well done and it has the option to use it free or at payment  with some options included.The support answers your questions  and solve  your issues quickly.

records.title: Subscription Issues Quickly Resolved.,
records.text: I was unable to cancel my subscription due to an error with the app. I reached out to Busuu for support, and was so impressed by how helpful Julia was! She apologized for the error and refunded me in full. I sent my request on Wednesday morning, and has an email confirming my refund would be processed by Thursday afternoon. I was very pleased with the service I received.

records.title: It’s my favourite language app
records.text: It’s my favourite app and website to learn my French, and also the customer Service is fast and very helpful and solved my issue, I recommend this Language learning app

records.title: Busuu user experience
records.text: What I like about Busuu is how well structured everything is. For example all their courses adhere to an international standard called the “Common European Framework of Reference for Languages”. This is very helpful as it allows me to know which level I am at and which level of the language I am using.Each chapter also has a lot of units and gives a lot of information and explanation on the grammar, verbs, structure etc. The exercises are also very quick and straight foward to get to.Its also very nice to have your own exercises corrected and given feedback by other users on Busuu.

records.title: Helpful support!
records.text: Helpful support!My experience regarding the app is limited but the customer support staff is nothing but generous and kind!

records.title: Busuu free trial
records.text: I recently downloaded the Busuu app after being recommended by a friend and did not receive the 30 day free trial . I contacted  customer service and liaised with Julia who was very helpful and quickly resolved the problem .  A very satisfied customer.

records.title: Great application
records.text: Great application! However, I had a problem a few days ago with vocabulary words, which was resolved in (less than) a week. I guess I wasn't the only one with this problem because support (which takes 24 hours to respond) took a little longer, but ultimately that's ok. Julia, from support, kept me informed of the evolution of this bug from start to finish. Thank you.

records.title: This is the only language company that…
records.text: This is the only language company that I have used and the format seems to work well for me.  I have had some technical problems, which I have received help for, however continue to experience periodically.  This requires rebooting and clearing caches.  Currently it does not allow me to speak an answer for an exercise, but can only write it.

records.title: Unfeasible request made possible
records.text: My request was initially deemed unfeasible. However, when I insisted, I was shown a way to achieve my goal.

records.title: Nice Community feature
records.text: The Community feature is rather unique (users check the written and oral tests in their native language (e.g. A German user who wants to learn Spanish is going to correct German tests by other users who want to learn German and get's his Spanish tests corrected by Spanish users),

records.title: I like the progressive approach of…
records.text: I like the progressive approach of introducing new vocabulary and grammar concepts.I must say I learn quite a lot with the German language. I can now read little texts. I don't remember all the words I studied though.I think I would be able to have a little conversation with a native germans provided they don't speak too fast.  I still have a lot to do to become fluent in this languages. This could be reached with an immersion travel or having friends with whom I could communicate. This kind of contact is  not possible on this platform, at least for the moment.

records.title: I like the Spanish course very much
records.text: I like the Spanish course very much. It is a user-friendly and interactive course,  and I can feel that I'm really learning it. The only thing that bothers me is the fact that someone I don't know is going to correct the activity that I did, and I should do the same to someone I really don't know. I don't like social media, and I would prefer having my activities reviewed by a teacher, not by a stranger.

records.title: Very effective language learning tool!
records.text: Busuu's learning modules are well designed. Each lesson utilizes a variety of techniques to reinforce the learning objective. Getting and giving feedback to and from other users is another great feature. I feel like I'm really making progress in learning a new language  using Busuu! I knocked off one star because lessons that are downloaded for offline use are sometimes missing some content.

records.title: Great method
records.text: Really love the method and so good to do a lesson early morning and to repeat as often as I need.Have had an extremely stressful and busy week with sick friends etc and got irritated at all the emails I received Well meant for motivating students but annoying if its impossible to study. Would be good to have a choice, eg 1, 3 (or however many)  email / text reminders per week. Couldn't find anywhere on website to comment on or request that.

records.title: Great app for learning on the go.
records.text: It’s a great app to do some learning whilst on the go. Grammar is explained and you get a chance to answer questions (voice recording or writing) and get feedback on how you’re doing from native speakers via the community. That’s a feature I haven’t seen anywhere else. I’m doing Japanese and it’d be great if you were given the option to turn romaji off when learning new words as it’s hard not to read that first and it slows down the learning of hiragana, katakana and kanji.

records.title: The review feature of the app/website…
records.text: The review feature of the app/website is not very helpful. There are two reasons for that:1. It doesn't correctly capture memory decay. It marked as "memorised" even words that the user had practiced only once and a long time ago.2. In the review exercise, the order between word recognition and word translation tasks for a given word is randomized, however once the user encounters the listening task, the translation task is no longer helpful for word retrieval from long-term memory.

records.title: Busuu  gave me an incentive to learn
records.text: In fact, I tried several applications to learn Italian, but BUSUU is the best of them because of the method that relies on gradual learning and the combination of learning conversation and grammar in an easy way.But I would have preferred to have at least one hour a week for direct conversation with the teacher online.

records.title: Just three stars because...
records.text: I'm rating three stars to give the owners of the app a message. The app is potentially the best app I've tried so far. There are some things to make better. First of all not all the grammar explanations are complete. Then I sometimes see explanations that are uncorrectly written. In the English Complete Course thete are some grammar explanations that start in English and go on in Italian. In the Italian Complete Course, there are omissions in a few grammar lessons (like in Chapter 9, Lesson 2). In the Complete English Course, Level A2, Chapter 4, Lesson 2 "Adverball phrases" in the explanatory table you wrote in English and Italian, while it should be just italian. The most useful tool in the app is the possibility to correct other people's exercises and get your own exercises correct from native speakers. I would like to offer my help to improve the app, regarding the Italian and the English courses.

records.title: stayed for the learning, ignore the league.
records.text: i like that the app is interactive and beginner friendly as it progressed to an advanced level. i have used the app to learn korean language. in the beginning i liked that it keeps you in a competition from the points you've collected but now i'm questioning myself if i'm learning a language or am i just trying to keep my points and be in the opal league? i was working at a remote location with poor wifi connection so didn't had the time to look at the app itself. hence i was booted out from opal league and tbh, i didn't really care much at that point. busuu is great but could do better without it being competitive with the points. to some, it may be a motivation but it's not hard to keep your points if you just took the language you're fluent in and collect as much points just to stay on top. it doesn't separate the points from the language you're actually learning or the language that "you're fluent in but took anyway" just for points. nonetheless, i'd still think it's a great app albeit the unnecessary competition.

records.title: Support and technical side of things not the best
records.text: The app itself seems to be useful, and I was super excited to buy an annual plan and start learning. However, 2 days after I purchased my plan, it suddenly disappeared and I was back to the free plan (the money didn't return to my account). Got in touch with the support team, it's been 3 days and no one has responded yet. Had to request a refund from a payment provider. Sad, I really wanted to love this tool, very disappointed.

records.title: Inflexible customer service
records.text: Busuu as what it is is fine. I subscribed because it seemed like a step up from Duolingo, but in truth it is unfortunately just more of the same and I didn’t feel my language skills progressing. In what was obviously an error on my part, I allowed the annual subscription to auto-renew without meaning to. I sent the support team an email clearly saying that I knew it was my mistake, but making clear I had not used the service for a long time, did not intend to start again, and making clear that I could not afford to be paying a high amount for it. They sent a wholly unempathetic response amounting to a ‘gotcha’. Whether it is policy or not, this seems an unnecessarily cruel one when they could doubtless see the service was not being used, no actual benefit had been rendered at the time of contact immediately after the renewal, and the customer was stating it would place them in financial difficulty. It is essentially a trap to try and catch people out, and then not even be willing to have a conversation on a case by case basis.

records.title: Lacking in Russian content

records.title: Take renewal fee with no warning
records.text: Used it for about a month. Paid for the premium membership. Now they took another 80 euro from my card with no warning! And will not refund it!!! If you try it - never have them have your card info.

records.title: Great but there Grammar Revision needs sorting out.
records.text: There is so much about this app that is good. Yet, when my contract expires I’ll go elsewhere.The lessons are great.There is a revision section and this is where it falls down. Vocabulary works well. But grammar doesn’t. I did a general grammar test many times, far harder than on a single subject and made lots of mistakes, no problem to be expected.The problem is that I am going through them individually now, A1first, then A2. But even though I get them right 100% or at most get 1 question wrong many times over they are still shown as weak. This is massively disheartening as I want to move onto B1, then B2 nether I start more lessons.Over now been stuck for 4-5 months, doing 25 mins a day.So, there you have it. I’ve mentioned this to them and they haven’t sorted.

records.title: The Russian course takes a nosedive on level A2
records.text: I’ve been doing the Russian lessons, mostly for review because I studied Russian in college and graduate school and even taught it. I just finished the first level A1 and the first two chapters of level A2. They were great! Chapter 3 took it from 0 to 100. In just the first two lessons, we got 16 new vocabulary words, and dialogues and examples with vocab and grammar we haven’t seen yet (instrumental case, до того, как). If I were a beginner, I’d be overwhelmed. Even as someone with a background in Russian, some of the new words were unfamiliar to me.Now there’s nothing but complicated vocabulary and extremely complicated example sentences with no explanations. For коллега по работе, the example sentence is Я до сих пор поддерживаю отношения со своими коллегами с предыдущего места работы. We haven’t learned any of these constructions. The only familiar words are я, коллега (but not instrumental case), and работа (but not genitive case).And the example sentences don’t always illustrate the vocab. You give быть свободным/свободной and then the examples are short form adjectives (свободен/свободна). You give может... as “shall…” and then the example sentence doesn’t even have может in it. There’s been no grammar. It’s like I’m suddenly doing a completely different course. The “grammar” lesson on past tense had exactly ZERO grammar explanations on even how to form the past tense and just numerous complicated sentences with unfamiliar vocab and grammar. The exercise that it gave expected you to answer a question using past tense and words that haven’t been introduced. I’m frankly shocked, and I  don’t think I’ll continue this course at this point.

records.text: Kaplan are helpful but the whole booking of study materials for the CFA exam is confusing. Being a UK resident it’s not clear if there’s any difference in booking the materials on the .com or .co.uk webpage and whether there is any differences between them.

records.title: Good so far
records.text: Good so far,  though had some few hiccups in the beginning regarding accessing online study text,no option to highlighting notes, not user friendly at all.nothing compared to Bookshelf is the best for me,user friendly app.

records.title: I'd recommend Kaplan...
records.text: I did not receive a dispatch notice but I cannot complain as the order confirmation and delivery were very quick. Great service. Will be using Kaplan again for my study materials and I would 100% recommend them to anyone studying ACCA.

records.title: Every one was very helpful
records.text: Every one was very helpful. It was well organized. Only problem would be it was a bit noisy but that’s if I’m being really picky. It was a much better experience than at Pearson vue.

records.title: I have had a great time studying using…
records.text: I have had a great time studying using Kaplan materials. They are straight forward and easy to understand just like a professional explains to a lay person in simple language for ease of doing business.

records.title: Plus and Minus
records.text: I am happy to purchase all necessary learning materials from the Kaplan. These materials are very useful and helpful for my AAT studies and exams. Very fast delivery and very secure. Appreciate it. The only one what about I am very disappointed, that the Kaplan closed their branch in Hull and I am (others) forced to sit our exams somewhere else or travel far away. This is a reason why I choose another provided for my exams. Disappointed about that as I have a good experience with the Kaplan before.

records.title: It will be nice if you could start sending the books again.
records.text: It will be nice if you could start sending the pepers books again. I do understand it's good for an environment but it's more difficult for me to study using the digital book. I've been studying for few years now, completed AAT and all with pepers books so it's actually a big change for me to use the digital materials now and it's not helpful with my study at all. I fo like studying with Kaplan but I'm thinking of changing the provide due to that change.

records.title: Everything is okay the only minus is…
records.text: Everything is okay the only minus is that the materials are very expensive and despite that, there is a time limit for books that have already been purchased.

records.title: Easy to purchase
records.text: Easy to purchase, good range of questions and mocks. Only downside is not comparable with Safari and have to use a different browser.

records.title: I order on the 22nd the 3 books for AAT, 1 have ripped pages. Still waiting for the replacement.
records.text: I order on the 22nd the 3 books for AAT level 3, tax processes for business, £65, a lot.I received the material but 1 book, the exam kit, have quite a good number of ripped pages, easy to see with a bare eye. I was quite annoyed. Called the number of the student service, no way you can get hold of someone. I sent an email to the student service, with photos of the pages. They tried to blame the delivery but was clearly lack of quality control before the delivery. Who boxed the book clearly could have seen that. They asked for my address; okay, given. Then, the day after another email asking which book is!!! And in the meantime the time goes.I need this book before next week. The 8th I will leave to go and visit my family. Can you please send me the exam kit book at your earliest convenience? My order number is 2200665312 made 21/11/24. Thanks. While in here, I’d like to add that the choice of using the full dark purple is really bad, in particular against the black ink, why don’t just make the border purple? In a low light environment is very tiring for the eyes. Many thanks. Please sort my order asap.

records.title: Content is good, service is bad
records.text: I am studying via distance learning. I went through all of AAT and now CIMA with Kaplan. You no longer receive hard copies of the study text or exam kit by default, only the revision notes, and so you have to purchase them separately. The digital books provided have a clunky interface through Bibliu and when you open a book, half the screen is covered by blank space.The content itself is still very good, the service has just been let down by greed.

records.title: Quick delivery
records.text: Quick delivery, pleased to receive my books so fast, however, the quality of Pocket Notes' printing was very poor. Hardly could read the text!

records.title: An underwhelming experience
records.text: As a neuro diverse student, support has been hit and miss.  Shout out to Jo Middlewick, who was incredibly supportive and helped me through an exam i failed multiple times.Technology often doesnt work, the video clips via pulse aren’t compatible with ipads, bibliu library is currently inactive, unable to annotate text online. Little things add up to a poor experience.

records.title: I bought an online ACCA book
records.text: I bought an online ACCA book , PMAnd I found the platform so complicated I can't deal easily with it. I can't follow my study progress

records.title: Works! But needs improvement.
records.text: Past my exam first time! Which is the most important. However 100% things Kaplan can improve on. A lot of my course are too short or time is taken up with introductions every week. You will find nearly all courses don't have enough time to fill all of the content which the exam covers especially advanced exams. The teacher normally says do you want to cover the rules or exam question practice not both. Also investment needs to be made into the teachers technology as on most of my course the teacher has WiFi or laptop issues. However I have only failed one exam during my time studying ACCA with Kaplan so it does work just need some small changes to improve.

records.title: Kaplan - average learning provider
records.text: Coming to the end of accounting exams with Kaplan.Some live online classes are good with knowledgeable tutors. However, some poor with average tutors. This used to be backed up by a physical copy of the CIMA study text and therefore if you had a poor tutor it didn’t really matter as you had a full study text. However, now only offered as a virtual copy which make it much harder to study - especially due to already spending my working week on a screen. I have raised this concern with Kaplan and physical materials are no longer an option. Not having physical materials is really disappointing considering the cost of the courses.Further, Kaplan state that you should be able to pass exams with the integrated workbook (basically high level notes of the study text). However, this is not realistic as exams go into the detail which is only in study text.I do no recommend On demand classes as these are not good value for money (essentially, a person reading at you from a book). I (and colleagues) will be suggesting alternative learning providers for future graduates.

records.title: Game changer for exam prep!
records.text: The actual content of the exam study material was great! I got the ebook version and the contents page was not working for me so I could not quickly go and forth with pages in different sections

records.title: Not everything available yet
records.text: Order was processed quickly. However, books are send from the USA meaning UPS charges an extra fee for customs. Not all parts of the CFA 2024 curriculum are available yet and their delivery day seems to be moving. Some videos were supposed to be available 'early November' but 2 weeks into November this became 'late November'.

records.title: Prepare to self study
records.text: Tutors who take the tuition classes just very briefly goes through the content. More than half the chapters are home study chapters.  2.5 months - 3 months for a professional paper is too cramped for some people. They need to offer a 6 month course with the pass guarantee. If you fail in December, and you want to sit in March, if you wait till results, it will be too late to enrol on the full course in March. Tuition would have started, and if you just enrol on the revision, you lose the pass guarantee. Such information is not easily visible on Kaplan. Call centre have provided incorrect infromation, which was later confirmed on email to be incorrect. The positives include, really good study modules, and revision debriefs.

records.title: Returns
records.text: I returned some books and i haven't had my refund. Which is fine, but i have sent emails and been calling with no answer.I had to edit my review, because I was contacted by Tom Gladstone, who was really patient and successfully helped me with my query and helped me with other unrelated stuff, like links to other study materials that Kaplan offers, that I didn't know about.

records.title: More Online Access, Please
records.text: Would be more useful if access to online resources could be maintained after the end of a course. It's helpful to go back over key topics even after your passed a certain level.

records.title: Good materials but terrible course setups
records.text: Study materials are good. Course set ups are very poor and only reflect a desire to make money, and not what is best for the student. The Live Online study method for example - access is only given to the online portal two weeks before the first class. Why is access not given straight away? Some students may wish to make a start on the course. According to 'student support' nothing can be done about that. Secondly, the Live Online (the most expensive option) is split into separate bundles, largely the core classes and an additional revision course if you wish. However, the exam kit and pocket notes are only provided if you pick the revision course. These materials are included in cheaper packages? E.g. Distance learning, so why have they been removed for the core Live Online bundle? So you also buy the revision course too! It's ridiculous.

records.title: Expensive books and bad and expensive delivery.
records.text: Very good service, good costumer service, DPD delivery not good , we weren’t home , the delivery man didn’t leave any card or instructions what to do . I was lucky because we have cameras and I saw him , so I had to call Kaplan to take the reference number and collect the books . Book are expensive and Delivery not good and expensive .

records.title: Postage costs are insane
records.text: Books are great and delivered well and on time but the postage costs are ridiculous. They also don’t even reduce for the amount of money you spend.

records.title: I think KAPLAN style questions do not…
records.text: I think KAPLAN style questions do not overly reflect the AAT Sitting the AAT exam is abit different when it comes to the wording and the overall examples However I do find the resources good with Kaplan I do use both

records.title: A lack of depth in theoretical content
records.text: Certain sections of the study text did not provide clarity, and it almost felt like it was expected that the student was aware of the theory. It is only when attempting the TYUs thereafter that the lack of clarity becomes apparent. Certain model answers in the exam kit had discrepancies.

records.title: Beware of 1 year timelimit
records.text: Study material is good but the online access goes after a year so if you pause or fail your time can expire, especially if you buy all modules in a level. You must then buy it again to get access which seems a bit harsh.

records.title: Delivery and gramatical errors
records.text: Website didn’t have an option to deliver to the UK, only Europe or rest of world at a cost of £60 or £100. I emailed with a screenshot and was told the error would be reported and I would be informed when fixed. I contacted a week later to check in and was told that I needed to select the blank option in the delivery list to deliver in the UK. Frustrating as I could have ordered a week earlier if someone had told me. By the reply I don’t think anyone intended to get back to me. As for the books there are a number of gramatical errors which doesn’t inspire confidence when you are questioning the content..

records.title: Terrible response time
records.text: Terrible response time. Always say they have an “unusually” high number of requests all the time. Shouldn’t be so unusual by now

records.title: Reduced the materials provided in the live online course without reducing price
records.text: Have had to order paper copies of the study text and exam kit as they now only provide a digital copy. I can’t spend extended periods of time reading text off a computer monitor due to eye fatigue so I need hard copies.

records.title: eBook is only available for 365 days
records.text: eBook is only available for 365 days, as I bought the whole package - with no download possibilities- I have no chance to use them up to full potential. That’s not satisfactory as the price was nearly as much as the book in printed version. Printed version I would be able to use much longer than a year. So that’s a very disappointing fact that I was not aware upfront.

records.title: KAPLAN review
records.text: Positive points: Comprehensive Study Text, easy to understand. I managed to pass F1-F7 ACCA exams the first sitting and all exam topics were covered in the Study Text and Exam Kit.Negative points : I had problems with the last order placed. A month later and my parcel hasn’t arrived. The fact that they don’t hold themselves responsible for the orders customers pay for is bothersome. I asked for a refund, but they don’t even bother replying to my email.

records.title: Why can’t we track our shipments!
records.text: Why can’t we track our shipments!! I pay 45 pounds for delivery and it still takes TEN DAYS to get my books and I can’t track where it is!! Please consider tracking them most delivery companies provide this service anyway.

records.title: CIMA study text E1, P1, F1
records.text: I have purchased three CIMA books from Kaplan, but I'm not very much impressed. First of all, shipping to the EU is very expensive (first item 20 pounds, and each next item 10 pounds). I ended up paying 70 pounds for 3 books and 3 exam kits. Kaplan makes a serious profit on shipping mediocre books. The quality of the books it below mark I'd say. The books could have been easily consolidated into a book half the amount of pages, due to it's ridiculously large font size (it would save printing costs as well). So far, the chapters aren't very well structured and coherent. A lot of text, examples, and supplemental information has been printed in tables, which makes it an unsatisfying experience to read.

records.title: IMC Unit 1 distance learning
records.text: I purchased the distance learning package from Kaplan for the IMC Unit 1. However, I feel that with this package Kaplan provides limited support aside from self assessment questions at the end of each chapter and some mocks. Personally, it would be improved if the slides from classroom sessions could be include to help with summarising the content.

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: Poor customer service. I called student services for advice on Ebooks. I spoke to 3 different people and nobody knew what I was talking about. 1 person on the online chat actually ended the chat in the middle of me asking questions.In terms of the teaching however, I have had a good experience but I feel the sessions can be slightly rushed and the whole course is not taught. Some chapters are “self study” but I don’t think is made clear when enrolling into classroom or online learning.

description: ScreenCastsOnline is your personal training resource, delivering easy to follow Mac and iOS video tutorials every week.

records.title: LOVE these SCO folks so much
records.text: LOVE these SCO folks so much! I’ve been a customer for at least 15 years. Their integrity, intentions and contributions to my Mac success cannot be understated. It’s the one subscription I don’t even have to think about! Thank you SCO!

records.title: It’s great to have independent reviews…
records.text: It’s great to have independent reviews and teaching at the same time.

records.title: Treasure trove of information for the Apple enthusiast
records.text: ScreenCastsOnline is an indispensable resource for any Apple enthusiasts.  These days, there's a lot happening in the Apple ecosystem and SCO is a great resource for keeping up with the latest.  But, it doesn't stop there - they have a phenomenal archive of past shows on almost any Apple product that is a treasure trove of information.  And, best of all you can consume it on almost any Apple product (Mac,iPhone,iPad,AppleTV) and you can't beat the $6/mo cost!

records.title: ScreenCastsOnline & Apple Power Users
records.text: ScreenCastsOnline is the single best way to stay current with Mac hardware, systems, apps, and utilities. SCO also covers iPad, iPhone, and Watch.Their coverage of third-party apps is inclusive and thorough. I am a power user thanks to SCO tutorials. They are remarkable both in detail and presentation.

records.title: Don and Lee of SCO are Amazing
records.text: Don and Lee of SCO are AmazingThe knowledge and information that they provide are phenomenal. Time saving knowledge and tips and tricks that will benefit you in more ways than you can imagine. If you are a beginner, you will get up to speed quickly. If you are a power user, well get ready because now you will learn super powers. Also, these are genuine and sincere people with hearts of gold.

records.title: Apple Boost
records.text: Screen Casts Online has boosted my Apple action and awareness for the past 8 years.Jumping into fresh software or updates can be a task. And you're not always aware of new releases or version updates.SCO educates you quickly with on screen examples plus there's a sense of serendipity and discovery.This ranges from totally new apps to 'I didn't know the operating system / app could do this!'

records.title: Many Years of Great Tutorials
records.text: Many Years of Great TutorialsSCO has been a great source of high quality tutorials across a broad range of applications. It has helped me learn new things about apps I already use as well as discover new apps that improve my existing workflow or fill a need.

records.title: Great service for both New and Long time Apple product owner.
records.text: I've been a Screencasts Online subscriber since 2012. I have always enjoyed the content, it is well narrated, covers relevant topics and keeps up with the natural evolution of the existing software products on the iPhone iPad and Mac.

records.title: ScreenCastsOnline Is Critical to Staying Current
records.text: We have been clients of ScreenCastsOnline for many years and for one good reason. Don and his team of software experts keep us current on all Apple platforms — Mac, iPad, iPhone, and Watch. They save us countless hours in researching the best software and learning how to use the software effectively.

records.title: I am a Charter member of the…
records.text: I am a Charter member of the screencasts online project and still, after all these years, look forward to every week's new edition. DON is amazing and has expanded both the services mandate and co-presenters brilliantly. Useful intelligence in a language we can all understand and apps we all use! Win Win Win, THANK YOU

records.title: thoughtful and clear
records.text: thoughtful, clear presentations that are easy to follow

records.title: Very useful site
records.text: Overall, this is an incredibly useful site. It would be nice if they considered trimming some extraneous detail from their scripts (e.g., I don't think we need to see how to download an app and its installation prior to the tutorial—unless the install is really out of the ordinary), but otherwise, they cover apps very well and have helped me navigate several apps before I decided to purchase them too.

records.title: Very useful source for reference and…
records.text: Very useful source for reference and information, especially on updates and new features in the operating systems and key applications.It appears that the ScreenCastsOnline magazine app has been removed from the US App  Store. How do I restore it to my iPad?I am about to migrate to a new MBP and I suspect many others will be upgrading to Apple Silicon Macs in the near future. A tutorial or reference on apps that have to uninstalled or deactivated on the old platform such as MS Office and the Adobe CS apps would be very useful. Thank you.

records.title: I don’t subscribe to many things…but…
records.text: I don’t subscribe to many things, but this site is definitely worth it. I’ve learned so much from their tutorials on topics on which I am interested.  The speakers are generally very good, though I must confess to a preference for Don (The gentleman who started the service) and Allison (who’s enthusiasm always comes across).My only “complaint“ is that I have suggested apps to review over the past few years, but they often don’t get reviewed. I suppose this is inevitable since there are so many apps deserving of reviews.

records.title: Helps find diamonds in the rough
records.text: Honestly, most of the time the reviews don't pertain to anything I can use, but I've gotten several absolute gems (Like Devonthink) from the screencasts that I'm sure I wouldn't have ever found if I hadn't been a subscriber. For that alone it's worth the price of subscription.

records.title: Lots of great tips and articles and…
records.text: Lots of great tips and articles and customer service!Would like to see price upfront to know if I might be interested in new apps. Many articles are beyond my interests.Well worthwhile subscription.

records.title: Really Happy with my SCO Subscription
records.text: Have been a long time member and really enjoy the shows. I find them informative and a good way to learn about the new features in new releases of MacOS and iOS. Show production is high quality  and I appreciate the chapters and subtitles.

records.title: Have been a member since it was $72.00…
records.text: Have been a member since it was $72.00 for five years.Very much appreciate your service.However,Not being from the UK one reviewer is quite difficult to understand.Brian

records.title: Has changed the way I use my computer
records.text: Screencasts Online lessons are always comprehensive and easy to understand. Some of the lessons cover software I don't have and don't want, but others have taught me a lot about software and apps I already have. And still other lessons have introduced me to productivity-enhancing software and apps I didn't know about that have changed the way I use my computer.

records.title: When a tutorial is of interest
records.text: When a tutorial is of interest, I enjoy the depth and presentation. However, there are less of the tutorials that I actually listen to as I find them gearing more for the corporate or business environment, or on topics that are of no interest to me. My rating is based on the decrease of tutorials that I watch, and not on the quality or depth of presentation.

records.title: The shows are instructive
records.text: The shows are instructive, and well made. Explanations are thorough, and easy to understand. And, they are up-to-date, with new changes. A wide variety of shows are shown. There is something for everyone.

records.title: Very useful
records.text: Very useful service helping me to learn about new apps, what for and how to use them, as well as to get to know the ones I already use even better. Highly recommended.

records.title: Screencasts Online
records.text: Screencasts, Don and the crew work hard to be relevant in introducing new and longtime Apple fans to the continuous evolution of operating systems, equipment and applications.  The scope is massive, even if I couldn’t possibly apply all to my daily use, boneless less as I struggle to keep up, the library of presentations is invaluable to moving forward!

records.title: Informative for Beginners to Moderately Experienced Users
records.text: The instructional videos are informative for beginners to moderately experienced users, of a uniformly well done quality, and mostly relevant. When major updates occur to something they’ve covered in the past, the service often issues new instructional videos to cover the updates. The Apple TV app is very useful.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, however my needs have changed, so I no longer need subscription. Recommend to any Mac/iOS user.

records.title: SceeenCastsOnline is a good resource to…
records.text: SceeenCastsOnline is a good resource to either learn about an application that you have or learn about one that you are considering downloading.

records.title: Very good programming
records.text: Very good programming, but would like to see more revisits of updates to previously explained softwares.

records.title: great experience in the field
records.text: great experience in the field High price

records.title: Useful for new macOS and iOS / iPadOS…
records.text: Useful for new macOS and iOS / iPadOS user!

records.title: Disappointed with the choices of…
records.text: Disappointed with the choices of subject matter recently. Not always relevant to me.

records.title: I 'm one of those who cling as long as…
records.text: I 'm one of those who cling as long as possible to an old and perfectly working system and set-up. That's why I gave 3 stars only: I don't benefit much from new posts, for , hah, some yrs now already. Yet I give 3 stars because I 've benefited a lot in the past, and every now and then I look up old screencasts, to learn again about some program, which I like very much.That's why I keep endorsing; I'd say: keep up the good work!

records.title: I've been a subscriber to SCO for many…
records.text: I've been a subscriber to SCO for many years, and it's changed quite a lot in that time, becoming slightly less relevant to me as each year goes by.  At the time I joined it gave tutorials on specific subjects like VPN, RAID and Server setups as well as software reviews.  It seems to have gradually moved to almost purely software tutorials that show us how to use the app with less emphasis on why we would want to use it in the first place.  Don't get me wrong, I can occasionally find a real nugget that makes that one tutorial easily worth the annual fee purely in saved time, and some of the shorter tips are useful.  However, and this is a personal issue, there is at least one reviewer who's voice I find difficult to understand due to it being nearly always at the top of the register.  Probably down to my age I suppose.

records.title: expensive but worth it when I have the…
records.text: expensive but worth it when I have the time

records.title: Need more rich content
records.text: Honestly, I like to videos but I also have subscription of Lynda.com where the content looks much more professional. They have wide variety of topics be it iOS, Mac OS, Servers, Apps, MDM, leadership etc.No doubt, screencast is good but there's a lot of room for the improvement and I am looking forward to the change and the coverage on latest topics. Thanks

records.title: The tutorials are much better when …
records.text: The tutorials are much better when presented by Don. I usually don't watch any of the others because their presentation is less coherent, less conversational, and just harder for me to follow. Don is a natural.I'd rather have fewer tutorials, but all with Don. The little 4-5 minute tutorials released in the beginning of the week could be dropped in favor of this.If I'm only getting 25% of the shows with Don I may not renew my subscription.

records.title: Because I am not a power user?
records.text: Maybe it is because I have been in the Apple stratosphere for almost 8 years now, but I don't get as much benefit out of the screencasts as in the beginning. I know what I use and like. Although I use my apple devices a lot, for work and pleasure, I don't consider myself a power user, who just uses new or other apps for fun. Don, I like your screencasts the most. You speak at a pace that I (from the Netherlands) can follow very well. Some others have the tendency to speak to quick.

records.title: A Few Thoughts…
records.text: I do enjoy tutorials when they are on productivity apps (my personal slant).  However, I would like to see more update videos, and possibly workflow only tutorials on complex apps like mind-mapping, outlining, task management, note taking, etc.  These workflow videos are, of course, stylistic which means that they may not fit everyone, however if they are introduced as workflow/style videos they might prove to be a big benefit to many.  Just thoughts.  Thanks for your GREAT contribution to the Apple/iOS Community!

records.title: While the quality is good, I want to see more from Don.
records.text: While the quality is good, it seems more and more content is being "farmed out" to other presenters. I don't expect Don to know everything, but I did sign up with SCO for Don's efforts and NOT all the others'. If I wanted to see them, then I'd go after their channels.

records.title: Not that interested in applications.
records.text: Honestly, I am less interested in applications and more interested in just dealing with basic Mac problems. I use very few applications so Screencastsonline is become less useful to me. Will probably drop it when I remember to do so.

records.title: I have only been a Mac user for 2 years …
records.text: I have only been a Mac user for 2 years now after 30+ years of Windows apps and Microsoft. Although there are many nice features of the Macs, at time I really miss the feel and intuitiveness of  my old windows environment.  I use office 365 for My sp sheets and word programs as I have found the Mac apps deficient and not very intuitive. I do love what you bring to us and will most likely continue as there are some great things. I originally change both myself and wife to Imac 27" retina dispalys because of stable security. Since then more hackers are focusing on apple products and we use a few AV type pgms. Spamseive is great for trash emails.. Good luck in the future.

records.title: I HAVE HAD DIFFICLULTY OPENING YOUR…
records.text: I HAVE HAD DIFFICLULTY OPENING YOUR WEBSITE OF LATE.I'V PURCHASED A NEW MAC AFTER MY LAST ONE CRASHED IN NOV. 2018.I WILL BE MAILING A BANK DRAFT FOR $45.00 CANADIAN FOR A ONE YEAR SUBSCRIPTION.

records.title: Still OK
records.text: Originally terrific content. Over time, started presenting non-mainstream apps and programs - lost a good bit of its value by presenting niche products that don't appeal to mainstream viewer.

records.title: Don McAllister is great - but...
records.text: Don McAllister is a terrific video presenter, but too often he brings in third parties that simply do match up to the quality that Don stands for.

records.title: It used to be better
records.text: It used to be better, more relevant to me and the stuff I used, less so now, I have just renewed, but not sure I will again next year.

records.title: Too much talking
records.text: Good reviews, but too much talking. It would be better if reviews were more concise. As it is it takes too long to watch.

records.title: Prefer Don as the host
records.text: Prefer Don as the host and had a few more of late I haven't even bothered to download never mind look at.

records.title: Would appreciate more tutorials on…
records.text: Would appreciate more tutorials on standard Apple Applications

records.title: Back to Basics
records.text: For 6 years I was president of our local Mac User Group, which is still going strong. I still teach a Mac class once a month for the group. I subscribe to your screencast to give myself good source material for teaching. I find your screencasts easy to understand and full of useful information.However, what we found in our club (whose membership is generally 70+ years of age) was that our members were really only interested in better understanding the basics. Try as I may to have introduced them to exciting new programs, I only ever got very limited response to those efforts.I find that I have the same problem with your screencasts. Your shows lately seem to be mostly centered on introducing new or updated 3d party software. As such, I am finding it less and less useful as a tool to help me in teaching the basics to my own classes. Even though I still subscribe, I rarely look at your screencasts any more. I still go into your archives for source material, but it's been a while now since I've watched anything contemporary. If I don't see more content on Apple systems & programs this year, it will probably be my last subscription year, even though I do appreciate the depth and skill of the work you produce.

records.title: Screencastsonline as of late has been …
records.text: Screencastsonline as of late has been focused on the Mac and has given iOS a seat way ,way in the back of the bus. For the past year it has beena terrible disappointment. For iPad users it's not worth the money.

records.title: I-to-I TEFL helped me accomplish my…
records.text: I-to-I TEFL helped me accomplish my English goals. The course I did was great from start to end! There was always help available when I needed it. records.title: I am honored to complete my teaching…
records.text: I am honored to complete my teaching English journey with I to I tefl although I would like better and faster  communication  methods with the tutors.

records.title: Review that you requested
records.text: Lesson content and presentation.However, communication in case of queries is not effective, if existing at all.For example, I forgot (under great stress for time imposed at work), to enter my name and assignment number. I requested a call-back. This is a second event for requesting this. The first never happened, and I lost money. Will call-back happen this time? When, if?

records.title: Mr Theo Murray was so helpful
records.text: Mr Theo Murray was so helpful. He answered questions I had and really walked me through the steps to enrolling, which is something that was very important for me to know.

records.title: Quick response from the site

records.title: Most  of my experience was good
records.text: Most  of my experience was good.  But was just co corned with poor communication when there was issues The response to queries was too slow. I’m still waiting for my certificate.  I finished the course two weeks ago.

records.title: Happy with 120hr Course
records.text: The 120hour basic course is well presented and engaging. The information is delivered in a variety of ways to keep focus up and there is a wealth of suggested reading and links provided to further study and resources. I would hope that some video pieces are updated soon; some footage is obviously decades old. Molly is especially helpful and responds very promptly on the help-chat facility.

records.title: I'm really enjoying the course so far
records.text: I'm really enjoying the course so far. Carol Pienaar.All lessons well set out.However, some of the questions are too open ended and for the multiple choice questions, there are sometimes more than one answer.Unit five Language in context - higher levels= that exercise was MOST frustrating. But I do understand the reason for including the exercise.I'm finding it difficult to contact the tutor.difficult to get hold of the tutor.

records.title: Thank you Molly and Idiel for your…
records.text: Thank you Molly and Idiel for your efficient assistance in the chat box, and for allowing me grace when I was confused with the marking time lines.NB! Overall I feel the course should disclose for example, that if your course expires before the assignment is marked you will not be able to access your results. Fellow or potential users beware of this.

records.title: Purchasing a course
records.text: Helpful, honest staff.  There was no hard sell or bartering about price or eligibility for discounts.  I purchased a course after 3 calls. All 3 operators provided consistent advice to my varied queries. At no stage during my 3 calls was I passed on to specialist.

records.title: Webchat
records.text: Webchat: Sent in a question. Answer took a few minutes to come through but when it,  it did contain a wealth of information.  A transcript of the web conversation was also sent to my email address - which was very helpful. In this method of communication there was a lot of effort taken to personalise the service. Molly was my virtual assistant

records.title: This company is very good however I…
records.text: This company is very good however I didnt give 5 stars because we do not have access to our tutors to ask questions. Also the feedback we receive from the tutors is detailed but I feel that only receiving two attempts to do the assignment unless you pay a fee is ridiculous especially if we have never done something like this course before. I think that there needs to be 3 attempts at least.

records.title: Overall satisfied
records.text: I really wanted to make a larger deposit, but the option was not provided. Before I enrolled, I asked about it and was told that it was possible which wasn't. I contacted the person who helped me and is still waiting for any response from her. Otherwise, I am good and already busy with unit three. I just want to say thank you for the sale you had run. This enabled me to enroll at a much affordable price.

records.title: Easy to use and navigate (if you are interested)
records.text: Very easy straightforward sign up. However the 'sales agents' are very persistent. I already decided that I was going to do the course, so their phoning was fine. But if you were just curious and their constant phoning interrupted your life the whole time I would be very put off.Otherwise the course itself is very insightful and easy to navigate and the people I did speak to were very friendly and helpful.

records.title: Holly - efficient and helpful
records.text: Holly is efficient, engaging and helpful. I needed proof of enrollment and received said document on the same day as requested. In addition to this, she answered all my questions in a timely and friendly manner. I am grateful for her assistance and appreciate her knowledge re i-to-i.

records.title: This course help me to be independent
records.text: This course help me to be independent, l studied everything myself, though it was difficult for me to understand the course the first time but when I went through it the second time, I understood the courseI am very grateful for this course, thank you very much for your help . Evangeline Amuche Ogbodo

records.title: Professional and friendly service
records.text: I connected with Selena on chat as I have had some queries over this last month and she was professional, friendly and very helpful. She assisted me in resolving said query quickly and politely.

records.title: Turnaround times are slow
records.text: I was frustrated by your lead times (the time lapse between raising a query and getting resolution).Also I've experienced delays in simple requests such as  settling my outstanding balance early and paying for a retake fee. Resolution to these simple requests seemed to take forever.

records.title: Did not follow up on zoom classes…
records.text: Did not follow up on zoom classes .Dismissed it by saying that they do not do it anymore.False advertising.

records.title: Tutor Reply & Marking Times Too Long
records.text: The course content was excellent. However, accessing timely support was difficult. From my experiences the marking time for an assignment was usually 9-12 days, certainly not the advertised timeframe. When I sent an email query on an assignment the reply arrived 15 days later. Running out of time to complete the course I paid for the fast track marking system which was excellent with the assignment returned within 24hrs as advertised. I finished my course and waited 6 weeks to receive my certificate. When I had not received any notification I emailed and received a response 24hrs later with my certificate attached. It had been signed 4 weeks earlier but not sent out. The  price of the course is very competitive but timeliness of responses & assignment marking times is too long. I recommend adjusting the advertised marking and response times to meet customer expectations.

records.title: requires hardword
records.text: This is my 2nd attempt at the course as life got in the way of my 1st go. I chose the 420 course. You have to put the hours in and regularly. Its tough. Alot of information to digest. The assignments take your time and most likely to come back to resubmit, follow your tutors feedback and you will be fine. Remember it's objectional so everyone has a different opinion. Follow your tutors, they are the ones that mark your assignment. Marking is slow 14 days normally. I carried on learning but found it tough going back if I had to resubmit.Customer service is poor tbh and tutors are busy so asking questions is a long process.For the end of course certificate, it takes 1 month. Look in your spam it could be there.It's not for the learner to put in odd hours, you lose your thread and you will never do it in the time, so will end up paying for an extension.I found it very informative, sometimes a bit too much waffle in sections and some links don't work. Happy to have achieved it. Good luck everyone.

records.title: I liked the teaching program that it was awesome. every unit has a small test that it makes to improve studying skills but checking the assignmet takea along time as it was written to check in 7 days
records.text: I liked the teaching program that it was awesome. every unit has a small test that it makes to improve studying skills, unfortunately checking the assignment takes a long time as it was written to check in 7 days.

records.title: I didn't like the amount of time spent waiting for results
records.text: I didn't like the amount of time spent on receiving feedback on my results. The last time I paid for a 10 day extension, I was supposed to have received the results by Friday. Nothing materialised, until Sunday when I was told that my course had expired  I feel like I am being cheated. I am beginning to ask myself a lot of questions. There is need for honesty and timely feedback. Also, it would be good to inform the clients their results using their email address, instead of having to wait for payment to access the course

records.title: Review about a refund
records.text: After contacting for months to get my full refund from Learn direct Jesse contacted me back with information about my refund. Make sure you always have a chat transcript as evidence in case of something. Every time  i called customer service they would forward me to the finance team then put me on hold i also contact them via email- i do have to say they have always replied but it took more than 30 days.    Thank you Jesse!

records.title: Overall the course is great
records.text: Overall the course is great. It is challenging and gives you a lot of knowledge and direciton about the TEFL world. What I don't like is how long it takes for assignments to get marked and for customer support to respond. It is extremely frustrating and disheartening when your assignment gets rejected (which is completely fine, if it was your fault) and then you have to wait an enormous amount of time for it to be resubmitted. But I suppose that that is simply the reality--maybe they are actually marking a ton of assignments. Fair enough. But I would hope that at least the customer support would work a lot better and quicker.

records.title: There is no download option
records.text: Be aware that you can only do the work online. There is no download option, so should you be travelling abroad teaching/volunteering etc. and the internet is not 100% reliable, you will not be able to complete any work.I find this shocking since the gist of teaching a foreign language for most people is about travelling; not everywhere in the world has effective/reliable internet.To clarify I have paid for my course in full.

records.title: Jesse was answering with one word in…
records.text: Jesse was answering with one word in the beginning about info that I couldn't find but then he sent me a link and I could help myself at the end. Another customer service made sure I receive a phone call, he can do better please we pay a lot of money for this certificate

records.title: Overall good experience and course, just disappointing waiting for certificate
records.text: Overall, I enjoyed the course and most of the staff have been great. They even helped me when I couldn’t finish the course in time due to personal reasons. The issue is I have completed the course back in march and we are now in June and nobody seems to know when I can receive my certificate. It shouldn’t be that hard to generate a certificate after completing the course. I have passed all the assignments. It just seems very slow..it is also restricting me from pursuing a career in teaching English as it would be hard to go to any school and tell them I have completed a TEFL course, as I have no certificate or proof. I even asked for a “proof of completion” letter from itoi and Direct learning, but was simply told I will receive an email when my certificate is ready..

records.title: I love the courses
records.text: I love the courses. The way they are structured. I feel like the assignments are well planned. The assessment of them however I do not agree with. As it can be a matter of perception. I also think it takes too long to grade which takes time away from being able to advance. It is confusing that one pays for prime yet still paying for fast tracking. It is too complicated to communicate with a tutor and for the price I think tutors should be more accesible. One starts to loose interest when the help/answers are taking too long to be provided if they ever are.

records.title: It is not a dislike but i do not find…
records.text: It is not a dislike but i do not find the assistance of the tutor or the responsible person for my studies when I need help. I was asked to mention my challenges and send them through, while I need to chat with her/him directly. The standard of the language used does not seems to be the best, there are some error that sometimes makes it difficult to understand the sentences

records.title: technical support

This requires alot of support the gather everthing together.  Next time I would direct that the number of extension of the person be included for smoother communication

records.title: Please Respond

records.title: This service is good but after…

records.title: There is no option for me to download a…
records.text: There is no option for me to download a copy of the study material for future reference. This is unfair since I am a paying customer. I know there are other ways to get the material but that's a tedious process.

records.title: No material and correspondence
records.text: I paid the deposit for the course and received acknowledgement of the receipt, and that was the last correspondence. I never received the material to start on the course. Well I was hoping we'll start beginning of April even though it was not stated.

records.title: Just dissapointed
records.text: Just dissapointed. Wanted to finish off my qualification but they said their platform shut down and I should enroll for a new course. Just bummed because I was almost done. Their content is good though.

records.title: Good Platform & Teaching,But After Care Is Not Great
records.text: I would like to give them a 5 because the content to study is good and the critical assignments and a tough process which is preparing us for greatness is good but when it comes to after care it is a big challenge. The issues: (1) I try to fast track my assignments, but the payment does not go through and this is not my card or service provider issue. So I have to get the support of customer service to assist me in my payment. I have advised them but the issue has not been resolved so it leaves me having to call the sales team to get through to the customer service team which is not good I feel nervous. (2) Unfortunately, it takes more than an hour to get a hold of them and then the call gets cut and due to the fast tracking of assignments that only last 2 days to opportunitize it, in saying this the call that does not get answered no matter how many hours I spend trying to get a hold of them and this then means I have no opportunity to fast track my assignment (3) When I do call customer service, the call does not go through so I have to choose another option and ask them to put me through to customer service of which I advised them and there is nothing done too. This is happening on repeat and not a once off. Its a massive challenge and I wish I never had to experience this. If this was not the issue I would stand by a 5 star rating. I am disappointed to say that due to these technical and after care sales I am not able to fast track my assignment and I still have more assignments to submit and it will be the same issue again.

records.title: TEFL
records.text: It was absolutely unprofessional. I had to wait for a couple of days to get a response. But for the payment, you guys were very quick.. absolutely not done!! No proper communication at all.

records.title: i-to-i
records.text: The course is excellent, but the service is poor.The marker takes a long time to mark your assignments, and my most recent work was not even marked.I'm still waiting for my certificate, and it's been a year and a month and I'm still struggling to get it from them... I force myself to travel to another location and complete my 120-hour TEFL course so that I can only work for my teaching company. And now, I can't give many classes because I'm still waiting for my certificate.

records.title: Be Prepared for Frustration
records.text: The course is difficult to navigate and that impedes progress. Slow response times by customer service and admin is frustrating. Despite what you read in these 5Star reviews you get bounced around a lot when trying to solve a tech or other issue. Re the content, its your basic mediocre TEFL course. It could use a restructuring and updated videos.

records.title: Lack of certification threatens my job
records.text: I passed my diploma a month ago and have yet to get my certificate. Everything is digital and online, so why the delay? Communication has been dismal throughout my 1.5 years journey. I cannot get a straight answer, I'm sent from pillar to post. They are terrible at answering questions of any description and this is now impacting a potential job I applied for. VERY unhappy.

records.title: I was initially impressed with the…
records.text: I was initially impressed with the excellent support provided by I to I Academy, but my experience took a disappointing turn when my course expired. Despite reaching out to multiple employees two weeks ago, I have been met with complete silence and ignored. My attempts to contact support were equally frustrating, with a full day passing without a response. To date, my emails and requests through the portal remain unanswered. I am extremely dissatisfied with the company's overall response and lack of follow-through. Unfortunately, my initial positive experience has been overshadowed by this poor treatment.

records.title: Messages never returned.
records.text: Messages never returned.I cancelled my course yesterday due to huge family committments.I thought once my deposit was paid, I was ok till May.No chance, I received stressful messages saying I would forego my deposit and have to pay for the course regardless.That does not make already stressed day happy.I just could not "save" the first position.Then I could not get it back from the cloud.Ridiculous to think everything hangs on the start now when May would have been great.I would like confirmation of my cancellation too.😳

records.title: My course was blocked due to non…
records.text: My course was blocked due to non payment according to them. Although I opted to pay monthly, I paid half of the course fees already within the 1st month of starting the course, now I am immediately asked to pay the balance. I tried to pay the balance but their system rejects. No answer at their call Centre either

records.title: Poor service and inadequate accountability
records.text: I have been a huge ambassador for the i-to-i institution as they seemed affordable and reputable. However, after months of dispute about unwarranted charges made on my account as well as no clarification from them or their legal representatives, I am deeply disappointed as a client and as a student. They will send you pillar to post and when you ask for feedback or documentation, they hardly ever respond.I never expected to receive such poor service from them.

records.title: This one is a full 5 star rating

description:
Mini First Aid offers a range of classes across the UK for all the family; parents, grandparents, carers and for children as young as three years old, training them in basic and life-saving first aid.
As the leading provider of first aid classes for parents, carers and children across the UK, Mini First Aid currently has nearly 80 franchises, training around 1,000 families each week, in basic and lifesaving first aid. Kate, together with husband Matt, appeared on hit BBC One Series, Dragon’s Den in 2021 and gained an investment from Sara Davies MBE who continues to champion the business. 
Mini First Aid classes are affordable and flexible, to suit people’s busy lives. Mini First Aid are the official  partners of the Meningitis Research Foundation, Children's Burns Trust and The Sepsis Trust and are committed to support the health education targets of these organisations. 
Mini First Aid also partner with the National Childbirth Trust (The NCT) and The Twins Trust for first aid education for parents and carers supported by these organisations.  
Mini First Aid products, including the award winning Mini First Aid Kits are available to buy from Mini First Aid classes, and leading UK retailers including; Amazon, John Lewis & Partners & Babies R Us.
Mini First Aid podcast 'Family Health' features in top 25% of podcasts and covers a range of family health issues.  The podcast is sponsored by Savlon Advanced Healing Gel.

records.title: Family group - mini first aid course
records.text: With our first grandchild due in a few months, we thought it would be a good idea to brush up on our first aid skills.  We found the mini first aid course from an internet search and were really pleased to find we could have the course run from home and involve all our family.  So 8 of us - our daughter and husband expecting their first baby, my husband and myself plus our son and other daughter and their partners - did the course together from the comfort of our lounge.  Nicola was a great tutor and adapted the course to our needs.  The course materials, tips and instruction were all excellent.  It was really helpful to do the session as a family.

records.title: Taught by Ross
records.text: Taught by Ross. Fantastic course and great information. Would recommend this to all new parents and all family to put your mind at ease and learn baby and child first aid and to have a refresher on first aid. Ross was happy to stay on and answer any questions you have or in the future to email them. Great first aid kits with everything you need and at a great price. Would definitely do a refresher in a year or so.

records.text: We are new grandparents and wanted to refresh our first aid knowledge. Laura was our trainer at Mulbarton Village Hall. We thought the course was excellent and perfectly met our needs. Laura presented the information with just the right balance of humour and seriousness about the subject. The practical demonstrations were great and we had the opportunity to practise on the manikins. We would recommend the course to any parent, grandparent or carer.

Highly recommend this class.

records.text: I attended the mini first aid course in Heather Village Hall on 8th April and I was so disappointed. Considering there are so many free courses now, the fact that I paid £21.50 each for my partner and I to attend to learn something we could have watched a 10 minute YouTube video on was not what I expected. The trainer and her 'boss' were irritatingly slow with going through the basics of first aid. The trainer basically followed a printed sheet of a PowerPoint and even then she was extremely slow and her 'boss' annoyingly interjected the trainer to tell her she was going wrong or hadn't mentioned something, so it felt like an awkward back and forth between them both. I would not recommend this course whatsoever, you're better of finding some material online. They also try and sell you their mini first aid kit but you can get it cheaper on Amazon. Serious waste of time, wish I could get my time and money back!

records.title: Unpleasant and unnecessary content
records.text: I Attended the baby first aid course in Hitchin, Hertfordshire with my pregnant wife. Felt generally that the key topics we wanted to learn about were covered to varying levels of thoroughness and we were able to practice CPR on baby mannequins. However, the delivery of the course was awful. In a two hour course, about 60% contained relevant and useful information on giving first aid to a baby or child. To obtain that information, we had to sit through lengthy descriptions detailing the first aid practices used in the police force (our trainer is a police officer), with various morbid anecdotal scenarios from which just do not apply to baby first aid.Much of the course, both relevant and irrelevant parts, was delivered like a standup comedy routine, with the morbid police work anecdotes coming off as really insensitive. Towards the end of the session, while talking about dealing with burns, we were told how badly burned flesh smelled like pork. This was followed by an anecdote of our trainer attending an incident in which a woman had died in a fire, remarking that it smelled delicious and joking that they would have gone well with apple sauce… An absolutely disgusting thing to have to listen to, and utterly useless information. I was left with little doubt that our trainer is vastly experienced in providing first aid. However, we paid for this course with the serious intention of learning about practical first aid we could deliver to our baby in the event of an emergency. Much more time could have been devoted to important details that really mattered without the constant attempts to make paying attendees laugh at unhelpful and distasteful anecdotes. I’m sure this isn’t representative of the courses delivered countrywide, but we were disgusted by our trainer’s attempt at humour during this course.
