records.text: Felt more like a child care setting/day care than an art class. So it’s probably very good if that’s what you want. My son didn’t not enjoy it, but wouldn’t go again. Not really what I expected.

records.title: I think Maximo liked the activity but he had high expectations and thought he will be getting much more out of it. For him, it felt just another Half Term activity - nothing he's going to specially re
records.text: I think Maximo liked the activity but he was happy it only lasted one day. He enjoyed the exploration of different techniques and the possibility of mixing subjects that do not usually go together. To be honest, I found the space a bit too tight and contained for a very active 11 year old boy. In my opinion a more spacious, more open layout will allow the children to move more freely and explore his own interests and ideas.

records.title: My daughter enjoyed it as she was with…
records.text: My daughter enjoyed it as she was with her friends however she was a little disappointed with the art she made, it was called a flag. But in actual fact it was a rough cut rectangular piece of hessian. That she was told to colour in for a couple of hours. We could make better at home. I really expected more form this establishment given the price tag. Staff friendly.

records.title: Expensive for what it was
records.text: A bit expensive given the duration which is only 5 hours and kids get nothing for snack. Not even a cracker. Toilets were also not very clean hence my child refrained from using it and that’s not good.There are other local art clubs where 6 hours cost 50 pounds rather 66 pounds for 5 hours.Not sure if I will use them in future.

records.title: Not good value for money
records.text: Whilst the children had a lovely time, they came back with small, basic paintings they seemingly could have done in any childcare setting / at home. I had thought they wouild have been expose to using more mixed-media. For the price, and short duration, I didn't feel like it was worth it.

records.title: Really liked the studio and relaxed feel…
records.text: Really liked the studio and relaxed feel. Sarah, the art studio manager/teacher, is lovely - helpful and encouraging. For me, a one and a half hour slot is too short for an art class (comparing it with others I know about). It would have been nice to have some 'real objects', too, to draw or paint from: everyone seemed to be using a photocopy or picture of something...but I guess it's not a huge studio to accommodate that. Overall, I really enjoyed myself and would like to sign up for more classes in the future. Thank you for the great experience.

records.title: I was happy with the setting
records.text: I was happy with the setting, the way the room was organised. The politeness of the teachers,etc. However, I did not continue taking my child there because, their level and style was not even taken into consideration, because everybody there did more or less the same thing. That's why it is a class perhaps, so that all the group has the same programme. The progress from one learning point to the next was also very slow. For £23 per lesson there could have been a lot of progress, so my daughter was getting bored. It would be nice if each child could be treated and taught according to their pace, but that's what classes are apparently, and that is as much as the teacher can do. I am however grateful for the things that my daughter learned, so if we could afford it and thought it was worth it, we would have continued. There are other classes online with cheaper price and KS3 programmes that are also accredited so we went for them instead.Thank you again Art-K

records.title: My child enjoyed the classes very much
records.text: My child enjoyed the classes very much. Came home very happy and eager to attend more classes.Biggest issue for me is the cost of the classes and this is totally personal to me. I'm not entitled to any help so I have to pay for the classes in full. When you consider what the children do in a day for the amount paid it is very pricey.No complaints about the activities as my child was happy. Feedback at hometime would also be good.

records.title: Class dynamics
records.text: I know my daughter enjoys the Art but perhaps feels that more time is given to the younger ones in the class.

records.title: The art work was great and the girls…
records.text: The art work was great and the girls were very proud of it. It would have been good to get feedback from teacher about how to continue at home.

records.title: Good that it’s local but expensive for…
records.text: Good that it’s local but expensive for what it is.

records.title: A little bit more guidance for the…
records.text: A little bit more guidance for the little ones and more attention.

records.title: The 2 hours holiday course …
records.text: My daughter went on the 2 hours holiday course and be honest she done a sketch which would of taken her 10 minutes to do at home. Not sure what they have been doing for the rest of the time. It will be nice if they got a paper with a summary of the day schedule or theme.

records.title: teacher careless
records.text: teacher careless，learn  less，fun less. and  too many kids in one class but not enough teacher. this  term   only   one  subject but  use almost more than 6weeks  to  finished this one .if i donot   talk  with the teacher i do not  know how long will take   for  that  one！

records.title: Good classes, bad policies
records.text: Art classes are good, our child enjoys them. The adminstration however is very funny, and parents are banned from being inside the large studio. Very poor for parents/grandparents who use public transport, needing to wait outside in the heat/cold. This is post covid too.

records.title: Not for my two children
records.text: Wasn’t for my two children. Both refused to go back as they said it was ‘too like school’ . Very tiny room. No outdoors for lunch.

records.title: Not worth the price as I expect more…
records.text: Not worth the price as I expect more than what my child did. I cannot see any professional guidance to improve my child’s art ability.

records.title: Underwhelming for our 12 year old
records.text: Our 12-year old said that it was an ok way to spend 2 hours with her friend, but underwhelming. They do more sophisticated stuff in her state school,  during playdates etc. Not going to repeat.

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: I had paid for half a day and my daughter came back disappointed. She came back with a fairly simple piece of work, she said they did not help her with it and the activity she was doing seemed like something someone much younger could have done (she is 12 and in her second year at senior/secondary school). I thought the point was that she would get help or be taught how to get better at her chosen media. She hoped that she would get to use more creativity in her piece, she also mentioned that the actual teacher wasn't there and it was just the assistant.

records.title: Full day class for two 12 year olds.
records.text: I paid for two 12 years old to attend the the full day session at £51 per child. This was quite expensive and I was disappointed that they came back with one fairly simple piece of artwork each. I was assured when I booked it that the course would be tailored to their age and not younger, however they said that when they got there they started by having to colour a very simple fish drawing (which I saw when I dropped them off was being done by a much younger girl. I appreciate that there is an element of planning when undertaking all forms of art but in my opinion the products they completed could have been completed in half the time. I don’t think the day course was value for money. Sorry to write this but this is my opinion.

records.title: My daughter newly started
records.text: My daughter newly started, and since she started,  I haven't seen any teaching.  She just draw a picture or colour painted and finished.  If for that reason,  I can help her at home, I don't need to pay money

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: I sent my two boys as a holiday treat. On the website it implies that they would be doing two activities, as a structured class teaching them new skills. As it turns out, they were doing pottery whilst others were doing painting and drawing. Not the structured taught class I was expecting. When I picked them up they'd said they were not allowed to move around much at lunch, had to eat lunch at their desk and generally sit from 10-3. In the morning they made the clay, in the afternoon they painted. Once they'd finished painting there was not much else for them to do. I was very disappointed with this experience after spending £114 for the day for them. I will not be sending them back as we have clay at home and they didn't make anything in the class that they have haven't done at home before. Very expensive clay making session.Thanks for response, however we were not given an opportunity to preselect and the information on the website was mis leading, very expensive waste of money.

records.title: Disappointed in customer service
records.text: Both kids think it’s ok but limited in allowing for them to be creative. In their words ‘it’s strict. We can’t do anything other than a couple of options’. As a parent, I was very disappointed that when my daughter was sick (vomiting) we asked if her class could be transferred or if not if we could get a refund as it can’t be helped. We would have been very open to have a discussion but instead the manager sent us a simple email template just inserting my daughter’s name (very impersonal and obvious) saying no to a refund. There was plenty of availability for spaces later in the week but our email was not considered or directly responded to. So, we ended up sending her in as she was keen, we just wanted to avoid spreading any germs if we could. Despite emailing the team with our disappointment we received no further response. The space is very small and kids confined to a chair for 5 hours. If my kids ask to go again (because it’s art they like) I would just book one day max in a holiday period, even half day really. Its very expensive for 5 hours really. Sending in two kids for a day cost £125, for which they sit for 5 hours and come back with a painting or clay work. I would like to see the customer service improve and even some hellos and goodbyes would be welcome too when we arrive and leave. Essentially a bit more fun and joy, given it’s a creative space.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: I did not want to leave a bad public review at first and wrote privately to the teacher. Unfortunately there was no response or reaction from Art-K, hence I decided to actually share our less positive experience publicly.My son (now 9 y.o.) started at Art-K Wimbledon central nearly 2 academic years ago (Oct 2021). We enrolled him because he was showing a lot of interest and aptitude for drawing. At first he was very engaged in and enjoyed the classes. As time went on he took longer and longer to produce any artwork in classes and what he was producing was frankly not at the level on an 8 year old. I think it all went really downhill from about January 2023. At this point he never even reaches for the paper and pencils/brushes at home to draw, he lost all interest.He did not mind going to classes but I don’t think he was engaged and teachers did not  seem to care. Lately he also started telling us that he does not want to go anymore, so we will now be discontinuing the classes. I know and teachers knew that he has some SEN and communication issues that were not helping. But this being a small class environment I thought something could have been done differently to engage and challenge him.

records.title: Not ideal for adult learners
records.text: I feel a lot more interest and enthusiasm would need to be generated by staff towards student's learning goals to make this a fulfilling experience for adults.  I didn't really feel my wish to learn was always met well.  If anything my enthusiasm was dampened by these classes.   To improve I think far more engagement, interest and indeed teaching needs to be given in line with what the adult wants to do.  It seemed as if it was up to me to get anywhere with this, I didn't feel met half way and I wasn't very much encouraged.Addressing the reply from ArtK I would like to make clear that I was invited to drop by on the phone when I rang to enquire about booking the classes.  It was not a free 1 to 1 private session by any means and not worth £27.50.  Moreover I have a flyer advertising free preliminary sessions for adults anyway, it says 'book your trial now' but that doesn't appear to be available on the website.  So the idea I got this private consultation free is misleading,  it was a chat, and there was another student there it wasn't one to one.  I did not know ArkK had CCTV cameras recording students and if I had known I wouldn't have gone, I wouldn't have been comfortable doing my art on camera.  Perhaps ArtK should be clear that they are recording people doing their art, some may not like it.Re the alleged free and 'bespoke' materials these were some pencils which I returned and a rubber.  Also I was given a drawing book but that's to be expected.  I asked for work to do at home but felt somewhat ridiculed for it at times.  I was told 'most people don't ask for homework' but I had paid and I wanted to learn and I wanted to practise at home.  I was given some ideas to work with at home when I asked but I wouldn't say I was much encouraged.This is not to say I learned nothing, I did learn but my initial review is truthful. When I spoke to customer service at ArtK about my experience they did not imply I was lying where here where I offer my honest review the respondent is almost saying 'CCTV footage shows you aren't truthful'.   I have to say I find the involvement of CCTV here quite concerning.   If I give Trustpilot a review I don't expect to be confronted with claims of evidence through me being recorded in a private learning setting in this very small studio.   I'm relating my experience and you are trawling footage to deny what I say about my experience.   ArtK should make it clear to customers that they are recording them throughout all the sessions.  There should be some indication in the studio that CCTV cameras are recording.  Thank you for your reply.  I won't be returning to ArtK especially given how my Trustpilot review has been handled as if it were a criminal case.

records.title: Amazing!
records.text: I'm really happy that I chose Firebrand for my apprenticeship. The courses and material they provided for learning were very interesting and helped me greatly to improve my networking skills and knowledge. The residential courses were such a great experience! Instructor Gareth did a very good job at leading the lectures, providing support and answers. All thanks to him I managed to pass the vendor exams and get my certifications. Perran has also been very helpful throughout this whole apprenticeship. He has always provided good advice and support. Thanks to him I was able to complete all my project works and pass the EPA successfully.

records.title: Firebrand is by far the best training…
records.text: Firebrand is by far the best training provider I’ve ever used. I’ve already done 4 security courses with Firebrand and I’ve passed them all at a first attempt. Firebrand tutors are knowledgeable, approachable and provide a lot of practical examples when discussing each topics. The courses are very well organised and if you take a residential course, the accommodation and meals are also very good. Failure is not an option with Firebrand.

records.title: CISM - Great quality learning and coaching
records.text: Firebrand delivers solid and great quality of learning for the CISM course I participated in facilitated by a knowledgable and skilled instructor who had real life experience with Information Security Management with a good ability to provide valuable exam coachingThe Wyboston Lake venue was OK, but not top notch, hence the four star review (opposed to five star)

records.title: very nice expierience!
records.text: very well planned and executed training in a very good and quit environment.

records.title: Level 4 network engineer apprenticeship
records.text: Perran Jasmes was my learning mentor for 2 years while I completed a lvl 4 network engineering qualification. He was so insightful and helpful during the challenging times.I recommend him to anyone who is partaking in an apprenticeship as you will be lucky to have him. (he's a laugh as well)

records.title: Overall good experience
records.text: Firebrand training was really great. A lot of information, input and good preparation for the exam. The location could be improved as well as to get a print version of the training material.

records.title: Firebrand Apprenticeship - Decent experience, Perran James a great learning mentor
records.text: My experience with Firebrand consisted of many ups and downs. This was mainly because of COVID-19 alongside multiple changes in learning mentors which lead to a lot of confusion. However, once settled with my final learning mentor - Perran James, he provided me with great support to help me achieve my exams and create project work to a high standard.

records.title: On-site Intensive PMP Course
records.text: I did the on-site 5/6 day intensive PMI PMP course with Firebrand. It's an expensive option but the way that they setup the training is very unique and allowed me to focus 100% on the education and qualification.Th course study material’s contents and volume was good. Our instructor, Jack, was even better and he made an inherently gruelling course much more bearable.

records.title: CISSP !!
records.text: Once the course administration had been confirmed, a well delivered course in great surroundings followed by the exam at Firebrand's own centre near St Neots.  Which again was a really good place, with friendly and helpful staff which helps with exam day nerves.

records.title: CRISC Training Course
records.text: The course itself was very well put together and Richard our instructor was very engaging. The course was very thorough and covered off everything in the CRISC book. The only thing I would suggest to improve the course is that the students get more notice that they need to register for the exam prior to attending, as I missed the chance to do my exam on the Friday as a result.

records.title: The training course is usefull for me
records.text: The training course is usefull for me. However there are some improvements possible for the organization like the classroom. The use of a carre on tables without computer screens should be preferable. Furthermore physical attendance is better than online for the discussions. A hybrid situation is for the trainer a challenge:)

records.title: Good CISM revision class
records.text: The lecture was very good and engaging. Course material as well was good. Course is intense but fine if you've read the course manual atleast once before attending the course. Things will be much smoother and understandable. Wont feel intense if you read manual before attending.

records.title: Friendly and customer service oriented.
records.text: Friendly and customer service oriented.The day of the online course I had an issue with the zoom link provided. The course was starting at 7pm, after working hours. I struggled to find a phone number/customer representative that could help me with the link.I would suggest to always provide alternative contacts. These courses are very expensive and as a customer I do not want to miss any of it.

records.title: Good instructor
records.text: Good instructor. Room for improvement could be doing practise exam questions more spaced out through the week rather than concentrated at the end

records.title: Good course for a condensed format
records.text: Good course for a condensed format.  Strong, experienced instructor.  Course covers material with required amount of detail.  Exam was ok.  Facilities were what they were for a Learning Center, nothing else.  Facility was clean, staff polite and helpful.  Meals were acceptable.  Lounge was available

records.title: A good course exploring Privacy
records.text: A good course exploring Privacy It helps to have a good understanding of the EU GDPR or UK Data Protection Act already in order to get the most out of it. My course was Online with a tutor in Classroom with other students. Would have been nice to see the classroom since the slides can also be shared separately.

records.title: Mature material and delivery
records.text: Actually, upfront information was transparent and understandable; the course matrerial itself also mature and good; we had just four particpants in purely online course,  and it went well in   that small group. One needs o be quite concentrated for such experience.Thanks!

records.title: Great all around experience.
records.text: Great all around experience.This was my first time using Firebrand. Found the whole experience great. The trainer was friendly and presented the course in a clear manner. The whole booking process was smooth and simple. Having everything on site made a great environment to learn in. The only issue I found was that the pre-course reading wasn't displayed very clearly in the email received otherwise all good.

records.title: Interesting and enjoyable
records.text: Hi, Thank you for the sessions on CompTia A+ Core1. The presentation style was great with lots of opportunities to ask questions, virtual lab experience and rocket race questionnaires which all made the course really enjoyable. Thank you for arranging the fantastic accommodation and yummy food. If there were few short online sessions before the class room sessions, they would have helped a lot to get familiar with all the lessons and easier for best understanding during the course. Thank you.

records.title: I can't do 4.5
records.text: I can't do 4.5. I been on two courses, the first was excellent and the second was nearly excellent. Although I passed the exam on both occasions. I felt the instructor could have been a little more engaging the last time. The facilities are good, hotel rooms are little tired but are being updated. The food is excellent

records.title: L4 Network Engineer Apprenticeship
records.text: I have just completed my level 4 apprenticeship with BT and firebrand were our training providers. Perran, who was my point of contact throughout my apprenticeship was absolutely amazing at all time and really values each and every one of his students. The course overall was well structured, however, I do feel when we actually went to firebrand training centre to do our training courses in compTIA SECURITY+, NETWORK + & SERVER+. I personally felt that the courses were far too long (8:30-6) and it was very hard to retain information for that long of a time.

records.title: The training provided was great
records.text: The training provided was great, but I am still awaiting my Exam Token. Other than that will definitely be using this platform in the near future.

records.title: Training was supposed to be for 3 days
records.text: Training was supposed to be for 3 days, but less break and more content and instructor finished the course in 2 days making hard for listeners to grasp the knowledge, 3rd day was just Q&A which only lasted for 1 hour, so the session ended at 10:00 am.Test papers should have discussed more.Instructor was good, but sometime it felt like he was also confused with the question in test papper.

records.title: Firebrands idea of training...
records.text: Firebrands idea of training is to give you 3-4 days that are 9 full hours of information being fed to you and you needing to remember it. Or watching 35-40 hours of online videos and memorizing that. If this is your learning style then perfect, if not, it will be a challenge. That being said, the instructors are good teachers and very patient/understanding

records.title: Not perfect
records.text: Not as expected from a certified instructor of Microsfot. Their license was also expired so about 4 days we did not access all the features of microsoft dynamics. They did not share the slides too. The labs had many issues. The examples by the instructor was not 100% clear, but he was open to feedback and cared about everyone. The course was very compact and did not cover everything.

records.title: Delay in getting exam prep / learning mentors (one bad one good)
records.text: My apprenticeship at the start was difficult mainly because the support from the learning mentors wasn't there. The marking procedures were questionable too. when it comes to preparing for exams, it took long to get resources for the exams. one example was getting the resources a week late, the exam date was not extended for a week either.One redemption was being assigned a different learning mentor that was Perran James. I feel like he did a great job in helping me achieve my apprenticeship when I was struggling.

records.title: Exam room crashed
records.text: In the exam we didn't even answer the first question when the systems went offThe hotel double charged us and its taken quite a few emails to get this back which is very annoyingThe trainer was excellent though

records.title: Mixed results
records.text: I have trained with Firebrand three times now and overall the results are mixed. They are quick to backtrack when there are issues. Overall I would say it is not worth the money and I would explore other options first.

records.title: The course material is rushed through…
records.text: The course material is rushed through so fast it doesn't allow time for you to actually absorb, process and understand.  Pre-course material was not clear as to what we had to do.

records.title: A mixed bag
records.text: The instructors for the residential courses are superb. Their knowledge of their subjects is genuinely extraordinary and their use of humour makes the modules easier to digest and makes the long days on the courses easier to cope with. They make sure they understand our individual job roles and try to pitch the course content, where possible, so it is relevant to our jobs. The reason I couldn't award more than 3 stars, though, is that in the months between the courses there are simply dozens of hours of videos from a 3rd-party website to watch in an entirely passive process, which is in no way helpful to embedding information in your memory, especially on new concepts which are often abstract and packed with new vocabulary and a sea of acronyms. My workplace has been great in giving me lots of projects to do to increase my skills and awareness of the company's operations as a whole, and my managers make me feel empowered to tackle tasks which affect the whole company. In summary, the residential training is truly great and the instructors are brilliant; the pre-course learning resources in between are not though, and are truly a joyless and unrewarding slog, but if you get a good company to work for in your apprenticeship, you should be fine.

records.title: Wonderful as ever
records.text: The facilities, as always, were excellent, the knowledge of the trainer was wonderful, but he couldn't stay on track and I think that was a major part of why I failed the exam, scoring the highest in our class

records.title: Teacher was competent but he was…

records.text: There was a lot of content to deliver in a short amount of time. Whilst appreciated this is accelerated learning. 1.5 of a day really isn’t enough time to prepare for the exam. records.title: Great course with a lot of information
records.text: Great course with a lot of information. I did the online course only I wouldn't recommend anyone doing that, if possible follow a course in person. The facilities for the online course where okay, only it is sometimes hard to follow. For the same course in person I would have gave it 4 starts.The instructor was great the materials for my course weren't that great. I got a online book instead of a physical one, which I prefer.

records.title: More practical examples
records.text: Overall experience was good however i would have appreciated more hands on experience with practical examples and detailed information as opposed to references to the e--book every time a question was asked.

records.title: Overall I had a good experience but I…
records.text: Overall I had a good experience but I did feel as though everything was rushed and a lot of information was crammed into a short amount of time. Listening to someone mainly speak over a powerpoint from 9am to 7pm makes it very hard to take in all the information. I do still acknowledge that this isn’t normal and usually would be based at the on site facility.

records.title: Wrong exam preparation
records.text: The instructor, who was highly skilled, didn't put the right emphasis on the required topics during the instruction. This resulted in a a high precentage of students that didn't pass the ISACA exam, which was completely unrealistic.(An instruction on 'how to pass an unrealistic ISACA multiple-choice exam' would have been more successfull for most students)

records.title: I felt that too much information was…
records.text: I felt that too much information was thrown at us during too few very long days, and because of this it didn't prepare us for the exams properly.

records.title: MS -102 course should be taught over 5…
records.text: MS -102 course should be taught over 5 days. 3 Days (more that 14 hours per day) was not enough.

records.title: things that could improve
records.text: I think the 6 hour training sessions were too intense and we got taught too many different things at once, we should have focused on one topic until finished e.g. python and then onto the next e.g. JavaScript. Also, constantly being online is demotivating and the class is too big compared to amount of teachers.

records.title: No materials were send before the…
records.text: No materials were send before the course. Others attending received theirs well in advance. Still haven’t received this…..No following up on upcoming course on where, time and how to get there until perhaps a week before start. I had to reach out to the DK office as I didn’t hear anything. Bad review and I am very disappointed

records.title: No / bad preparation and knowledge of subjects
records.text: The trainer doesn't prepare his training before the sessions. He gives confusing examples and he makes mistakes when he shows a topic in the system. Group member have to help and correct him often. He seems to have little experience with presenting a training.

records.title: Trainer with no practical experience
records.text: Unfortunately, the trainer did not provide much additional information and had no practical experience and was not up to date. The training room had too many seats, none of which were height-adjustable. The exam went smoothly and competently. The hotel was great.

records.title: rushing
records.text: i think that firebrand expects you and rushes you to try and pass i dont like there training rushing tactics  its like the force the info into you and expect to know it all..  i think the learning can be abit slower and rushing you into your test...

records.title: The course approach and training…
records.text: The course approach and training facility were good however I give it a 2 rating for the following:- the hotel connected to the training facility was well below expectations for a course that cost over Euro1k per day.- all course materials were online which made it difficult to take notes.- the organisation leading up to the course was last minute so cost of travel was significantly higher and there was very little time for prior preparation. - it was a brand new course syllabus but this was not explained by the sales person for firebrand. fortunately participants were experienced otherwise the training itself may not have been enough to pass the exam. On the positive side, the trainer was highly experienced and knowledgeable so that was the major strength of the course otherwise I would not consider another training with firebrand.

records.title: Very poor preparation for certification exams.
records.text: There is a reason they deliver content so fast, they don't actually deliver all relevant content.Elements are skipped to try and cover the majority of material, then you are advised to read the missed parts in the officially supplied material. Then what is the point? Save yourself time and money, purchase the material directly online and buy a Measure up subscription (Instead of Firebrand buying it for you)I have been on 2 Firebrand courses, neither have left me anywhere near suitably prepared for the Certification exams.

records.title: I don’t feel enough content was…
records.text: I don’t feel enough content was explored! I have tried the practice exam and failed as there are so many elements we didn’t discuss

description: We are helping students achieve their dream careers by offering high-quality training courses in the Dental nurse and Veterinary care industry.  Our Access to HE Diploma in Health Professions offers students a qualification to study at university without A-levels to progress to a career in nursing, midwifery or other health professions.

records.title: I have had the best dental…
records.text: I have had the best dental educationist, Lauren Frampton. I am so thankful for everything; I felt supported throughout my course. She would always reply and mark all my work quickly and give clear feedback, which was extremely helpful. She is honestly the kindest, most supportive dental educationist.

records.title: The support I have received from…
records.text: The support I have received from Lauren, my DE,  has been incredible! I am very grateful for the interactive lessons held by Amy. I couldn’t recommend more.

records.title: Jenny Kelly
records.text: Harriet Ellis have been absolutely amazing helping me through my dental nurse apprenticeship,it’s been an incredible journey.I’ve had many ups and downs throughout my course but they’ve been really supportive throughout the whole thing and have helped me qualify as a dental nurse.My tutor Jenny Kelly has been the best tutor ever,I wouldn’t want anyone else as my tutor,she’s been so helpful and given me great feedback and overall been really supportive.

records.title: Harriet Ellis are the training providers to pick
records.text: I don’t know where to start but I’m not a person to right reviews on things but I had to say something about Harriet Ellis. I have adhd so I struggle with deadlines and making sure I complete my work as well as focusing but Harriet Ellis have really helped me and supported me through the process. I went university before and never got this much support I struggled and ended up leaving. Harriet Ellis pushed me every step of the way they wanted to see me succeed and get through my exams to become a dental nurse, honestly speaking if it wasn’t for them wanting me to pass as much as I did I wouldn’t be where I am now. Thank you Harriet Ellis.

records.title: I had the absolute pleasure of working…
records.text: I had the absolute pleasure of working as a dental nurse, and I can’t speak highly enough of the entire team. Raanan’s expertise and leadership are unmatched—his professionalism and care create such a high standard. Zoe and Amy were fantastic, always supportive, skilled, and approachable. The rest of the team were equally amazing—every single person contributed to creating a welcoming and professional environment. The dedication, teamwork, and positive atmosphere made it an incredible experience. I feel so grateful to have been part of such a wonderful practice. Thank you all for making my time there truly special!

records.title: Outstanding Dental Educationalist – Highly Recommend!
records.text: Farheen Mithagare is an exceptional dental educationalist at Harriet Ellis, and I cannot recommend her enough! She consistently goes above and beyond to ensure her students feel supported and confident in their learning journey. What truly sets Farheen apart is her commitment to her students’ success. She is always available to answer questions, provide encouragement.Thank you, Farheen, for your hard work and dedication—you are an invaluable asset to Harriet Ellis, and your efforts do not go unnoticed. I feel incredibly fortunate to Have had you as my DE

records.title: DE Lauren Frampton
records.text: I have been carrying out my dental nursing degree with Harriet Ellis for just under a year and I must say that my DE Lauren Frampton is an absolute dream. She is always making herself available if I have questions, need some advice or would just like to have a chat about any future projects that I need to do. She goes above and beyond for her students and she is a real asset to the Harriet Ellis team. She has made my time at Harriet Ellis enjoyable and I always look forward to having a chat with her.

records.title: I feel that my DE Emma has supported me…
records.text: I feel that my DE Emma has supported me form the beginning. She lets me have an opinion and view on things which I like as then we can make decisions together rather than it be more one sided. I love that she is very kind and understanding and always goes above and beyond in making sure I am happy within my apprenticeship.

records.title: Emma Scott
records.text: Emma is my DE during my level 3 dental nursing apprenticeship with Harriet Ellis, and she has made my course so much easier! She always responds quickly, and gives advice and feedback on everything needed. I feel my experience would be a lot different without her. Thanks Emma!

records.title: I recently passed my dental nursing…
records.text: I recently passed my dental nursing exam with Harriet Ellis, and I can honestly say it has been along road but the support I was given by the apprenticeship manager (Raanan) was exceptional, the communication and help I received in my EPA was Fantastic! Nothing was too much trouble and this really helped me through the final stages! Thank you Raanan!

records.title: Experience heavily based on what DE is assigned to you!
records.text: I am currently completing my dental nursing apprenticeship through Harriet Ellis; I found my first DE quite unapproachable and unhelpful when it came to being stuck and confused with written work. But when my DE changed to Lauren Frampton, everything got so much easier. My percentage of my portfolio went up 20% within the first few weeks due to her marking my work and giving me very helpful feedback, she was extremely helpful with organising observations and assessments. Anything I needed a little extra help with she was there to provide me with support and resources. She went above and beyond to raise my knowledge and understanding as a dental nurse as well as a dental professional overall; I could not even begin to tell Harriet Ellis head office how much of an asset she is to their company!I would recommend Harriet Ellis as a training provider but I think your experience heavily depends on what DE is assigned to you so you just have to cross your fingers that you get a supportive one.

records.title: I had a pretty mixed experience..
records.text: I had a pretty mixed experience... I found that my attendance at online lessons was never recorded leading to me being threatened with further action which I felt was a little unfair. My DE also changed a lot (I think I had 5 or 6 in total) during my course which was quite stressful as I never knew who to email.However, my last DE - Amiee Ninkovic - was lovely and always got things back to me as fast as she could, the EPA manager Raanan Firmin was also excellent and got my EPA completed in under a month!All in all, I am glad I went with Harriet Ellis as they did help my qualify quickly.

records.title: my second to last DE said she would be…
records.text: my second to last DE said she would be my DE till the end. not long later she resigned with immediate effect at the end of my course which really stressed me out …until a couple of weeks later i was blessed with farheen mithagare. she supported me throughout the end of my course so that i could go forward for my EPA on time. no DE out of the very many i’ve had have shown me as much support as she has. she replied to me at out of hours and always put my mind at ease despite being brand new to the company. thank you for everything farheen!

records.title: Clare Peace Review, From Aaron
records.text: Having Clare Peace as my new consultant renders me thrilled. With my last one, which I would like to keep confidential, I experienced literally no luck nor much support. But, Clare literally accelerated the process for me, scheduling interviews for me to attend just three days after I was assigned with her, which was a huge relief. Since I haven't yet run into any problems with the company, I feel pretty at ease speaking only good things about them. I look forward in beginning my dental-nursing apprenticeship with the company.

records.title: My experience with Harriet Ellis
records.text: The experience was a mix overall I really enjoyed the learning and being able to study at my own pace but one thing I would improve is to encourage the DE to mark their students work on time. However, fortunately my DE Shelly was amazing and one of the most helpful people ever. The end point assessor Michelle was also very helpful in giving me my results on top and providing me with ways to improve my study techniques. I wouldn’t have been able to achieve my qualification without them.

records.title: Received help with finding a job as…
records.text: Received help with finding a job as trainee dental nurse, interview tips, good tutors, online study materials available. Online classes happened on Saturdays which was helpful but also felt it was too much to take in as a lot of topics are being covered in one session. Overall good experience. Gurpreet Kaur was helpful and used to respond to queries as quickly as possible.

records.title: Great and helpful support
records.text: I have to say thanks to my office supporter Gurpreet, she always contact me and ask me how I am getting on with my course and ROE. She always try the best to  give much helps as she can.The lessons was good, our tutor Caroline is a great person, she is very patience and very helpful, clear explain for the student's questions.Our ROE marker Caroline Battersby is a great tutor, she always straight way to write the feedback after I done my ROE Pers, very appreciate it for her support. The only thing is not quite right, too much over charging for the resit fees, image how we can afford it.

records.title: Overall happy with the provider
records.text: Hello everyone,Overall, I am quite happy with the training provider.I wanted to tell special thanks to Cathryn Cheetham for her support in completing my ROE on time before my maternity leave so as I could all have it signed off before that time. Also wanted to thank Gurpreet Kaur for her customer service. She was happy to send my copy of diploma to Australia as we left UK shortly after I qualified. I didn't rate them 5 star as at times I had to chase twice for some answers to my queries that made the journey a bit challenging. Otherwise, happy with them

records.title: Excellent
records.text: Getting an opportunity to learn under Harriet Ellis for my dental nursing course is really good and going well so far. They have always been very helpful to their students and student support staff’s Noelia and Gurpreet have been amazing. When I need help and call them their service is outstanding as always.

records.title: The service was very good
records.text: The service was very good, I was constantly being updated during my application stage. If you have any questions the members of the company reply very quickly. Overall, a very good experience. Thank you Amy Day!

records.title: I was a little nervous going back to…
records.text: I was a little nervous going back to study after some years, but my student support officer Gurpreet has supported and helped make this journey so easy. Joining Harriet ellis for my dental nursing was the best decision as I can’t compare them to anyone. My students support officer Gurpreet has been so helpful and checking and making sure am well looked after in anything I need help with.

records.title: The tutors are amazing
records.text: The tutors are amazing, I have been on other courses and none of them beat this one. The teaching and classes are great.  They are reliable, they are actually there to help you. Any help I have ever needed or any questions I’ve ever had, Gurpreet & Sara have always been there. I’ve had a great experience with Harriet Ellis, I’d definitely recommend.

records.title: I think the Harriet Ellis program is…amazing
records.text: I think the Harriet Ellis program is very good . Very polite . I would say very clear explanation of what do it in any phone calls or emails sent , I was always reassured which is good for me as I do get quite nervous as I’ve just left school and now “going into the real world” . However I did call one time and left a message I didn’t get a call back or an email but I understand how busy they are and I sorted my problem out in the end :overall a great place to be apart of

records.title: I had a great time studying at  Harriet ellis Harriet…
records.text: I had a great time studying at Harriet Ellis. I felt really supported.Gurpreet  was amazing, very helpful,  communicative and supportive. I had all the help I needed  and it was very easy  to ask questions , there was always prompt response to my emails. Gurpreet was indeed great.

records.title: Great company and really good support
records.text: Great company and really good support from tutors and staff through the phone lines! Gurpreet has been very helpful to me whenever I’ve needed any questions regarding my course answering! Would recommend!

records.title: Having Jenny Kelly as my educationalist…
records.text: Having Jenny Kelly as my educationalist towards the end of my programme where I was falling behind and losing hope of qualifying due to my previous educationalists, really helped me and pushed me towards my EPA.Ranaan Firmin also was very helpful with my EPA and made the process very easy for me!

records.title: Good course but it is too hard for the unexperienced people
records.text: I have been with this course since last August. It is good course but it is hard for those who haven't got any experience on dental nurse . Especially for the people who is not native English speaker.  I had loads support from Preet. I felt when I needed talking to someone, she is always there.ROE is the big job for this course. I  am so pleased I am nearly finished. I am located in Newcastle upon Tyne. Not many practice would accept trainee. They don't even know ROE. So I would advice other new student who is from North East giving self extra time to look for the practice before the course starts.

records.title: Shannyn Stiffell
records.text: One of the agents Shannyn Stiffell has tried her best and has gone out of her way calling up dental practices  for me to book interview. She really has motivated me and gave me a lot of confidence to try my best!

records.title: EPA review
records.text: Very pleased with the help and support towards the final leg of my dental nursing qualification during the EPA process, and a special thanks to Michelle who I felt was very knowledgable in the process! Thank you :)

records.title: Phone Call Review
records.text: Tayyaba, I am very happy to say that my phone call with Chelsea went very well as I was nervous at first but her polite and gentle tone reassured me that I can go further with this opportunity of applying for the apprenticeship.

records.title: Some incredible staff.
records.text: My journey with Harriet Ellis has been variable, however the two members of staff that really went above and beyond to drastically speed things along were Emily Kilkenny and Raanan Firmin. A lot of my delays were due to unavoidable circumstances mainly on city and guilds end and right at the start of my apprenticeship, however Emily and Raanan worked tirelessly to make sure I was ready at every stage of my qualifications. It was specific staff members that really do make the difference and are such valuable assets to Harriet Ellis.

records.title: Good when you get a good DE
records.text: I started with Harriett Ellis in 2023. I did the course in a total of 17 months. I had about 5 or 6 dental educationalists over this time. My final tutor was Emma Scott. She was fantastic. She is the ONLY person who was organised, replied fast and was very helpful. I wish I had Emma from the start and it didn’t take a year for them to assign her to me. Every other tutor took weeks to mark my work and didn’t explain anything to me. Emma had to undo the mess the past tutors had created and I can’t thank her enough for that. She helped me qualify 3 months earlier than I was originally told. The overall company is unorganised and tutors come and go every few months which makes it very difficult for the student to know what is going on or who to talk to. Emma on the other hand made it very easy and had good communication which kept me up to date with everything

records.title: Mixed opinions
records.text: I started Harriet ellis in nov 2022, I had 2 assessors in that time my first being absolutely awful losing work of mine, never marking my work or getting back to me. My second one Zoe Skinner was great, she was helpful and wanted to do her upmost to make sure I had everything I needed, and had everything together. She was an amazing DE, just a shame the company doesn’t have very good communication, I was made to redo observations/ re do lost work from IQAs for silly reasons, or little to no reason why it needed to be redone. I would also like to thanks Raanan, as he has been very helpful and communicated really well with me during my end point assessment. Zoe is a great DE, and I have nothing bad to say about her.

records.title: Jenny and Emily
records.text: I started my Dental nursing course in November 2022. I got off to a rough start due to my first two dental educationalists being impossible to contact, would lose my work or just wouldn't mark my work. However my final dental educationalist was Jenny Kelly. I can't thank her enough! I have recently just reached the end of my dental nursing qualification and couldn't of done it without her. She offered great feedback towards my portfolio work constant support throughout the latter stages of my course organising study session and calls to ensure i felt comfortable and ready for the end point assessments. Jenny is approachable and was always easy to reach whenever i needed her. I would also like to mention Emily Kilkenny my tutor who i spent two hours with every Tuesday for the duration of my dental nursing course where i learnt all the knowledge to be able to pass my exams. Online learning at times can be boring at times, however Emily is an exceptional tutor always making lessons fun and exciting. Harriet Ellis is lucky to have these members of staff. Thank you Jenny and Emily.

records.title: I have had a very mixed experience with…
records.text: I have had a very mixed experience with Harriet Ellis but my tutor, Emily and my last DE, Lucy were brilliant! Also, going through all the EPA stuff can be daunting but Raanan was so helpful and patient and really made the whole experience less stressful. Thank you, Raanan!

records.title: A good course provider but ....
records.text: A good course provider but could easily make minor improvements which would result in major positive changes. Staffing seems to be an issue, as does communication. Course structure could also be improved in line with other providers who run same course. I would recommend them to people who are able to self direct and do not require much assistance, other candidates are unsuitable for this style of course. Dental nursing DiplomaGurpreet (Preet) is helpful where possible and leaned on her a lot during course.

records.title: I am grateful for a course that gives…
records.text: I am grateful for a course that gives people the opportunity to learn on the job. The the admin side of this company was excellent and every time I needed help Gurpreet Kaur was very helpful and prompt. I didn't enjoy not having a consistent tutor that was helping us I think we had 4 maybe 5 seperate people providing us lessons and the lessons varied in quality. The revision sessions were okay but I did not find them helpful. Overall I have had a good experience!

records.title: Helpful staff but sometimes a little disorganised
records.text: All members of staff are really friendly and nice, and give good instructions. However, the company was a little disorganised - my apprenticeship went on for almost a year longer than it initially was meant to take, which I appreciate is also related to COVID, but it was sometimes frustrating when I knew it was meant to be faster than it was and work got lost. The staff are all helpful and polite though and help where they can. The content of the course was good, delivered well and I passed with lots of support available.

records.title: Dental Nursing
records.text: I've recently qualified as a Dental Nurse with Harriet Ellis. I am partly impressed with my time on the course. They are a few things that I believe could of been better; when starting the Dental Nurse course I was informed that it would be completed within 18 months, however it had taken me over 24 months to complete the course. I partly feel the reason for this is the constant change of Dental Educationist which delayed my completion of the course sooner. However, the Dental Educationist that I did have during my Dental Nurse course were extremely nice and supporting. The last Dental Educationist which I had was a lady named Zhantelle, whom was extremely helpful and rushed to have my course completed for me.

records.title: Dental nursing course is great
records.text: Dental nursing course is great! I had a few critisms on Harriet Ellis unrealistic predictions on completion of the course,  change of course tutors in my case.Overall, Harriet Ellis needs to improve organisation skills. Staff are pleasent & helpful and do try to assist with students needs. I have successfully passed my intergrated dental nursing diploma!

records.title: Not impressed
records.text: Danielle helped me at Harriet and Ellis and overall I didn’t find them helpful, they recommended a place which i accepted and started working at and when it fell through due to an awful manager Danielle told me to call places myself and that was her form of help afterwards. Not impressed, wouldn’t go to Harriet and Ellis again.

records.title: Everything seems to be generic
records.text: Everything seems to be generic, no personal touch or support . Emails sent to everyone I appreciate that there are many students but sometimes it became stressful thinking things hasn't been done correctly on the course. Then my certificate wasn't sent out recorded delivery and which I never received it delaying my GDC registration, loss of earnings , wasn't delt with in a reassuring or calming manner the comment I got was ' well how comes everyone else got there's ? '  I felt like she was insinuating I was lying and to make me feel stupid sent out a photocopied version signed delivery. This photocopy wasn't great.  I stated I could have done that myself . I work hard to gain my qualification and was so upset that Harriet Ellis could not replace the certificate  themselves. They where the ones who did not send it out recorded on the first instant. Glad to be done with this training group, and have giving my employee the same feed back.

records.title: Support
records.text: I really enjoyed my experience with my DE Shelly she was extremely helpful. I would say for an improvement would be for the marking to be better from my previous DE

records.title: Great staff, not so great procedure
records.text: Spoke to Ellie and Lucy on the phone, they were pleasant and friendly and tried to answer all my enquiries, which is why I've given 3*I wasn't very happy with the communication I received about the actual course requirements, as I was informed about the documents I needed to provide as evidence at the very last minute, meaning I wasn't able to acquire them in time.

records.title: Good help
records.text: It’s a mainly student controlled work, I wasn’t sure on how to use the site and had to work it out for myself. Frequent phones calls to check up on us.

records.title: Could be a tad more stutter aware
records.text: The man I spoke to on the phone was really polite and professional, as well as efficient in the way he provided me information and answered my questions. The only criticism I have may be somewhat personal as I do have a stutter, and so when I was answering a few of his questions he thought I was rushing and told me to slow down because "it wasn't a serious interview ". Although I don't particularly appreciate being given unwanted advice about my stutter, I know he didn't mean any ill by it and probably was just trying to help. Overall, he's efficient and good at his job.

records.title: The only reason I would even rate this…
records.text: The only reason I would even rate this course, is because of the classroom tutor (Kelly). She would go above and beyond to help you achieve where you want to be! She’s a very good support system to have. Other than her, the course is a complete joke, the staff in the office appear to just wanna get paid and don’t care weather their students pass or fail. The coursework marker is awful, don’t expect to have your work marked until you’ve finished the course!

records.title: Course is great in terms of qualifying…
records.text: Course is great in terms of qualifying for as a dental nurse, the tutors also offer good help and advice for students who are in the work place as well as trying to complete their couese work. However they don't do a great job in terms of checking on your progress and whether or not you need help

records.title: Lindsey makes Harriet Ellis better
records.text: I’ve had many tutors with harriet Ellis. It seemed quite disorganised. However at the end of the apprenticeship Lindsey Evans was my tutor and she was great. She checked in on me, made sure my work was top standard and was very supportive. I would give Harriet Ellis 1 star if it wasn’t for Lindsey!

records.title: I have given Harriet Ellis 3 stars due…
records.text: I have given Harriet Ellis 3 stars due to my experience throughout this course. I at times have found myself without guidance, in the past year I have had my DE change 4 or 5 times. This had a negative effect on my experience and I was behind with a lot of my course work without a lot of support. I am near the end of the course with Harriet Ellis and now have Linsdey as my DE who I cannot fault. She has got me back on track with my course work and been a great support, explaining everything I need to include and going through my work thoroughly to make sure it is at the best standard.

records.title: Not correct information
records.text: Can't understand clearly yet. Because there are many dental nurse clinics on apprenticeship gov.uk webpage, and after deadline for an application there again a new deadline time. When I try to contact with dental clinic they don't need anymore. I can't understand why these positions never been taken away. A little bit disappointed. Now have to look again but still hope that they will find for me one.

records.title: Review
records.text: Chloe was great ,she helpful and nice. But i havent heard from the other person who is meant to be finding my apprenticeship in over a month.

records.title: My experience with Harriet ellis
records.text: So when I started with Harriet ellis I was very pleased however during my course I had 3 different tutors, and trying to communicate with them kept becoming an issue. I had to keep calling/emailing to get responses and on top of that because of where I was located it was also an issue due to them not wanting to travel far to observe me. Regarding the course I felt as if it could of been more organised. However, Fenella was amazing and helped me through the exam stage.

records.title: Poor management
records.text: I applied to do this course as it’s meant to take 12-18 months to qualify. I started the course back in November 2020 and now only just qualifying in July 2023. The lack of support throughout the course was poor. I had multiple dental educationalists. Every time I got a new dental educationalist I was pushed back 5 months. The most recent dental educationalist I had was the only one who helped me get to the end. Pushing me to get qualified. I’m glad that I am now qualified and I do believe that this scheme could work amazingly if managed properly. As an apprentice I believe that it’s key that all students should get the support and not to be messed around like I did. There was a few times that I nearly packed in the course as I never saw the end.

records.title: Hard work at first if you get the right tutor
records.text: I started a dental nursing course with Harriet Ellis in November 2020 and all courses are done online but the tutors online only taught from a PowerPoint and then left us to do a workbook. Sometimes it was so hard to focus as there was background noise and the tutor didn’t always explain and give us time to write notes. I had 4 tutors, and apart from Natasha, the rest were very substandard. They weren’t very thorough and when Natasha took over she was correcting corrections missed by previous tutors!! Natasha was the most amazing tutor. She was friendly, helpful and supportive and offered to help as much as she could in regards to exams. The DMT team didn’t really keep us updated and weren’t very helpful when it came to support or problems any of us were having which also made it very hard for my practise to keep in contact as they didn’t offer any support to my practise and tips on how to help me with my work. I was so glad when the course was over and I qualified as I can now continue my learning without the added stress of deadlines and endless workbooks. I am very thankful to Natasha as she helped me so much with my course and workbooks and making sure it was all marked correctly and sent off

records.title: Unorganised and unhelpful
records.text: Unorganised and unhelpful. They were perfectly helpful in the beginning but have just seemed to get lazy with their help. Not one employee seems to know what's going on and my DE reads my messages and doesn't reply, which is always helpful when you're trying to complete workbooks or sit mocks. Wouldn't recommend unless you're prepared to figure out everything by yourself.

records.title: No the best
records.text: We have been experiencing issues with Harriet Ellis for over a year now. The students have been constantly getting sent mixed messages and both of my girls are now on their 4th or 5th Dental Educalionst. The course structure is not relevant to the exam the questions. I think this really needs looking into.Jennifer is one of the latest Dental Educalionsts and since she took over she has been extremely helpful. I hope things go forward from now.

records.title: The staff in head office and Kirsty…
records.text: The staff in head office and Kirsty have been lovley and helpful. Sadly I feel the two tutors I have had have not been helpful at all. I have felt very alone.  Never able to get hold of any one. I feel like I am doing the course on my own with no help. Sorry

records.title: One staff of Harriet Ellis is very very…
records.text: One staff of Harriet Ellis is very very helpful and kind her name is  Sally .Always she helped me a lot .Just I want to say thank you so much dear Sally.

records.title: Considering the amount of money that…
records.text: Considering the amount of money that had to be paid for this course, I was hugely disappointed with the quality. I was told I would be given support finding a job; i received 2 emails with suggestions which were too far away for me to apply to. I was told there was a 'customer service' liason to give me additional support. I was only ever contacted during my work hours, and whenever I reached out I got no response. The only time I was able to get a response was by contacting a manager. Classes were incredibly sparse, which I expected, but I anticipated that they would at least be used appropriately when they did occur. However, there seemed to be little lesson planning and the tutor was not concise. The only resource that felt useful was the tests available on the website, but even then the resources associated with the Levison's textbook were superior. Overall, I had expected a supportive and educational experience for my money, but only found a system which was uninterested in individual success and more interested in our money. Members of my class were warned by multiple sources of how little this course provider cared for us, but by the time we found out we had already been tied up by the non refundable costs.

description:
Our mission is to help every student, student-athlete and US university program benefit from a successful recruiting process.

We are the trusted source for support, education and guidance to athletes and their families. That confidence allows us to provide college coaches with access to one of the largest networks of international recruits.

We are the “how” and “where” recruiting happens, and, more and more, we are the reason “why.”

FirstPoint takes student-athletes where they often can’t take themselves. We work tirelessly to ensure our student-athletes and their families are informed, confident and inspired by the university opportunities we create together. This year alone, we’ve helped thousands of scholarship hopefuls in 34 different sports get to the next level.

We know each college commitment will only strengthen our reputation as the leader in athletic recruiting. More importantly, we know it means a student-athlete has found their place to play, and stay, at university.

records.title: A great opportunity for the next steps
records.text: The trail was very organised. Both parents and players were informed about the layout of the day and what First point offers. All staff were extremely helpful with top quality training drills.Overall it was a pleasure to be there.

records.title: Trial experience
records.text: I think the trial overall was a great experience to show my ability. The opening introduction was inspiring for me in terms of what I can achieve at first point.The drills were excellent imitating aspects of the game and the coach was clearly passionate about the game and wanted us to push ourselves to the limit. I would recommend to anyone.

records.title: Great coaches that clearly lead us…
records.text: Great coaches that clearly lead us through their drills, great facilities and an informative introduction.

records.title: Excellent trail program with big opportunities…
records.text: The trial was good the atmosphere as well it felt like a home for footballers even the spectators enjoyed watching the practices matches and we were all treated equally and given the same amount of attention as u would like a trail to be like but the only problem was the weather but it’s not their fault but could have chosen a cooler day to do the trail cause it’s was freezing but then I enjoyed and loved it like everyone else claimed and hope to be in another one soon.Big thumbs up.

records.title: It was really good and fun cause the…
records.text: It was really good and fun cause the staffs were lovely and also gave me an opportunity to showcase my skills

records.title: Great experience
records.text: Great experience, very well ran event in Stafford,  my son really enjoyed his day. Great coaches and brilliant communication. Thanks guys

records.title: It was really good learnt a lot of what…
records.text: It was really good learnt a lot of what they do and the journey that you will be taking if you accept it .

records.title: Great coaches
records.text: Great coaches, all experienced in what I am trying to do ( go to America) Good level pitch

records.title: Trial Review
records.text: Training Session was great! High intensity and well explained. Talk before was extremely informative! Slight lack of clarity before the trial that there wouldn’t be any other girls, but session moved smoothly regardless and played with the lads so not a big problem! Would recommend to others.

records.title: It was a good and fun experience
records.text: It was a good and fun experience to be out there and train and play rugby like I haven’t ever before and all the staff were very polite inside the club and outside on the pitches

records.title: Well organised and good fun
records.text: I think the assessment was well planned out and clearly a lot of organisation was put into running the trial. It was also great fun working with other players alike and I throughly enjoyed doing the teamwork drills I took part in. I also think the PowerPoint introduction at the start was helpful for players and parents in particular because we were given a honest insight into what the process of moving to a USA university would be like.All in all, the trial was well organised and good fun.

records.title: Good experience
records.text: My experience was great because it tested my stamina, speed, flexibility, strength, passing and shooting all in the trial, only problem I can say I had was having to play out of position in the match as I'm a midfielder and not a striker,but this wasn't really first points usa's fault as my team did not have a striker.This trial was also good because it gave a detailed description of what first point is all about and what you can gain from going to America.This trial made me grow as a footballer even more and I'm happy that I came and got to experience it

records.title: The trial was well organised from the…
records.text: The trial was well organised from the start to the finish, very informative with every detail needed from knowing how the scholarships works and potential pathways to how the trial process is formatted. The football itself was very fun and had a variety of fundamental practices so we could showcase our talents through our technical, shooting, defending and attacking, transitional sets and game related scenarios.

records.title: It was very well set up and executed…
records.text: It was very well set up and executed perfectly to find our strengths and weaknesses

records.title: Got me very interested in US…
records.text: Got me very interested in US scholarships. Presentation was every good and full of information. Did well with the little time they had to review player performances. However maybe more sessions would be needed to get a big understanding of  the quality of the individuals.

records.title: Great experience
records.text: The presentation at the beginning was very well performed and it gave out details with relevant information to support these. It was very informative to ensure everyone knew what was going to happen. The coaching during the training session was very good, the coach was very firm and demanding but without it being too much. He made sure everyone understood what they had to do and would make comments on things to improve and things you are doing well which helps encourage you when playing.

records.title: ethan’s review
records.text: it was a great experience to demonstrate my skills and what i can do on the pitch. however i don’t think i performed to my fullest potential due to the games being on a smaller pitch which i understand makes it harder. the coaches seemed experienced and well spoken and explained the drills clear. Overall it was a successful day and i look forward to hearing back.

records.title: The experience over all was really good…
records.text: The experience over all was really good , had some quality time with some of the boys it was really good to meet them. The coaching was great personally because I got exactly what I looked for , was really honest and and over all helped me very much!!!

records.title: I enjoyed the whole experience
records.text: I enjoyed the whole experience, everything was set out from the get go and was clear what was happening at each stage and where I should be. Drink breaks were often but quick, and rotation was easy and seamless. Coaches pushed us all hard and were clear with what they wanted.

records.title: The experience was a good one because…
records.text: The experience was a good one because the persons who led the session gave clear and specific instructions of what they required of us The activities were phenomenal I had a lot of fun and I know the others did too What could’ve made it even better is if there was an all-star game where all the more preferred players played a game against each other

records.title: I enjoyed the trial
records.text: I enjoyed the trial, because it challenged my decision making and technical ability. Coaches were nice and friendly and the drills were well organised. It would’ve been a lot better if we were split by age group and gender so we could do contact.

records.title: Football trials
records.text: I enjoyed the football trials and it was a fun experience to play against others who strive to continue with first point USA in the next stages

records.title: A great session to meet some FirstPoint…
records.text: A great session to meet some FirstPoint coaches and new players from all around the city. Improvement could be multiple trials or just more games being played so players get more opportunities to get in the ball and showcase their skill.

records.title: Good experience and a good opportunity
records.text: At the leeds rugby trial i found that the staff were very helpful and pushing to help yourself play your best game. They also explained everything in great detail if someone didn’t understand which i found helpful as i am a visual learner

records.title: It was really good
records.text: It was really good, they tested effective drills to increase our sharpness on the ball. One thing i'd want for them to improve is the age range as I was 15 playing against people way older than me so i didnt really get to showcase my talent

records.title: Very honest from the start about the…
records.text: Very honest from the start about the whole process. Did not try the hard sell which O have experienced from other companies.

records.title: The staff leading the trial day were…
records.text: The staff leading the trial day were great. Very engaging, welcoming and made the day an enjoyable one.One thing I think they could improve on however would be to do the trial days in age groups so that everyone is able to showcase their talents respectively and proportionately to their own age.

records.title: Parent review- Attended a trial paying…
records.text: Parent review- Attended a trial paying £20. The main coach was great, other coaches seemed to not be paying attention/chatting which worried me that my child would not be assessed fully. The group was mixed sex with mixed abilities so it’s hard to showcase yourself really. It’s now the day after and I have had this request from you to post a review but had no further feedback from First Point so have no idea on what to expect next. I am cautious.

records.title: First point USA trial event.
records.text: The event was really great starting with presentation and warmup, matches and some dills with detailed about body positioning.But at the end cooldown should be included. Other every thing was great.Good experiance.

records.title: It was a good trial with very good…
records.text: It was a good trial with very good drills. However I think there should be positional drills as well.

records.title: I LOVE FIRSTPOINT
records.text: I really loved the first point Football trial but i think the weather should be taken into consideration because it really affected me and some other players. I think it should be done indoors with ventilation, so that you can see us play to our maximum because the sun really affected my performance .When my sister went to play couple of years ago in the winter it was too cold which is better than the heat because i thought i was gonna pass out. All that is needed to see us footballers play in our prime is us playing in a comfortable environment

records.title: Overall it was a good trial
records.text: The experience was great. However, in the trials, there should have been age categories to make the trials more systematic and organized. The trials must also be spread through different locations across Bengaluru as not many players knew about the trial. Ending on a positive note, the trials had 11 aside matches and gave good exposure to me who was 15 and played with players who were 5-8 years older than me. Hope to work more with First Point.

records.title: Awesome event, but needed more matches.
records.text: First and Foremost i would like to Thank all the Members and staff for such an amazing event and experience that am forever grateful for.In my opinion the drills where am using and it really tested our overall footballing ability therefore you done an amazing there.My only “complaint” was that we should of had more of games to show and express our technical ability but more importantly a longer time to play and also bigger sized pitch and not limiting us to a small sided games which is hard to showcase our real ability.Finally I think the fact we didn’t get to play through ins or corner felt strange and it made the games a lot harder.Either Way Amazing Event. Thank you guys

records.title: The trials were very backs focused
records.text: The trials were very backs focused. Of course forwards need ball handling skills too but there were no position specific drills for forward, and backs, to demonstrate things like tackling, rucking or any other skills that you would not use during a touch match. The touch matches allowed people to show their game awareness and handling skills but that is not everything. It is mixed, girls and boys, and I hope that one day there are enough girls to do a separate trial so there can be more contact. I think the organisers should observe how counties and beyond structure their trials if they want a deeper understanding of the talents of individuals.

records.title: Really good opportunity overall
records.text: Really good opportunity overallPositives-meeting new people ,a chance to showcase your skills Negatives -severe skill gap between participants somewhat taking away from your own experience Most of the games between are quite back based as it’s mostly touch rightfully so though due to age difference,but I can imagine a foward struggling to make an impact and show there strengths in fitness and touch games

records.title: Nice experience
records.text: I like the staff, friendly and kind.I really think that to see real levels you need to dig a bit deeper in the major skills especially with specific role as flyhalf or fullback. For example: left and right passes with targets, kicks and receptions, etc...

records.title: A bit too short..
