records.text: Nice seeing an old pro athlete. But unfortunately, the trial was too short. The introduction was way too long and we didn’t have enough time to show our on field game. Maybe more specific position exercises, less game at the end.

records.title: Good session
records.text: Good session. All athletes were told we would get an acceptance or rejection email within 48 hours at the latest. This was not true and I am still waiting on a response.

records.title: I liked the drills we ran through and…
records.text: I liked the drills we ran through and the passion of the coaches. Thing that I dislike is the fact that we were a big mixed group with ages from 15-18 and boy and girls. This prevented us from practicing and playing with contact which doesn’t help bigger, slower and stronger players. This also doesn’t let you play to your limits during the game cause it is really only the fastest players being able to score.

records.title: Firstpoint Review
records.text: The coaching level and facilities were impressive. I also liked the informative part of the trial that broke down the course of action with a future at Firstpoint. However, i disliked the evaluation criterea as I was trialing with players 5 years older than me.

records.title: actual trials were poor, but the administration and information was very useful
records.text: Trials were very unorganized. there was no specific field location (there were 2 fields 200m apart) and only started at around 6.20, even though it was scheduled for 6.00. Several club members told us they had no idea what was going on and that it might even be canceled. However, coaches remained very professional and intelligent and easy to communicate with. Furthermore, website and interview information was very useful in helping me get prepared.

records.title: IOM trial.
records.text: Hi, I liked how well prepared the company were, i enjoyed the presentation before. It was clear and full of useful information. I felt the player to coach ratio could have been improved, more coaches. And more playing time or more trial dates to show full potential.I unfortunately didnt make it through to the next phase this time, but will try again in the future. I do feel as though i am of the standard that you are looking for, having excelled within junior football on the island and across in the UK at Bolton Wanderers Academy. As a goalkeeper i dont feel i had the opportunity to show my ability.Thanks - Aidan

records.title: I enjoyed getting out and playing…
records.text: I enjoyed getting out and playing football again but I feel like the person who took the training was rude and disrespectful

records.title: Contact skill needed
records.text: I think that the trial overall was very good however there was no aspects to a forwards game. A prop, for example, is not suited to play touch and should be judged more on physicality and contact in the future. Otherwise I think the general experience was great to have

records.title: Great coaches but too big of age range
records.text: I think the coaching staff were friendly and helpful. Rory was especially good at keeping helping the games stay rugby focused. It was enjoyable and I think it was smart to have a bit of fitness at the start as it shows whether the players can think under tired conditions. If I could change anything I would say to split the age groups as some of the younger guys were not  to the same level of the older guys. I also think some of the drills were not rugby specific and that if there was a group closer in age we could have done more rugby specific games to show who really had contact talent.

records.title: Start strong, but once they have your money....
records.text: The start of our experience with FirstPoint was great - I guess he was the sales guy - he was attentive, informative and kept following US up.  Once we had paid and in the 'system' the customer service has slipped.  We have to chase up our 'account manager', we have not had any feedback yet and now we have started reaching out to schools ourselves - which are telling us that 2024 entry is closed.  Now we can only assume that this is general entry times for the public and FP has more flexibility with times.But right now, we are not feeling the love from this company.  And we know we aren't the only person that feels this way.

records.title: Well first was the price £20 it's too…
records.text: Well first was the price £20 it's too much. Secondly it was alright I believe that people would be able to know where to improve more and also how to approach a trail next time

records.title: Camp Overview
records.text: What I liked about the camp was it was very involved with the camp attendees and had us play in front of a couple of the scouts that were also in attendance. What I disliked about it was half of the camp attendees unfortunately, I felt including myself, did not get an opportunity to play directly in front of all of the scouts at the camp. One thing I could recommend is to switch the players in attendance to the other field to get that opportunity to play in front of the other scouts. Other than that the camp was very great and I believe could potentially help me further my soccer career to play at a collegiate level.

records.title: A Good Experience
records.text: Clear communication during the First Point USA meeting before trial. Coaches provided key information about how First point USA operates. Each coach showed high levels of coaching abilities and made their intentions clear on what they were looking for. Unfortunately the location of the meeting was difficult to find with a lack of directions on where to meet. To continue, the quality of trialists were extremely varied, with also a mix in genders and huge gap in ages reduced the quality of the trials. Finally, as a goalkeeper I expected to be assessed using drill specific training, but this was not the case as I was just playing in goal during matches which made it harder to showcase my wide range of skills.

records.title: Disappointing coaching experience
records.text: The presentation was good, detailed and extremely useful.The range of abilities for players was too big, and resulted in a poor coaching / trial experience. With more experienced players frustrated with the lack of basic technical ability from some players attending meaning drills fall down quickly.

records.title: Trial didn’t have many aspects to show…
records.text: Trial didn’t have many aspects to show what i was capable of and was held back by others around me who were selfish

records.title: Not really that impressed
records.text: Pre games discussion made me less inclined to get involved and for my father it seemed like a time share presentation.   We were under the impression of a scouting exercise rather than touting for fee paying customers.Liked the games to technical sessions aspectsDid not like that there were too many people, and impossible to play and do your skills correctly.  How you could pick people out in one session is realistically not practical.Games were not orientated to technical and positional play and were dominated by persons wanting to keep ball at feet…The only positive was it was a trial experience

records.title: The System has to change
records.text: I did not like the football trials in West London because it was very irregular.I choose Striker/Left Winger part when i was registering your application but in trial everyone were playing randomly coach didnt care at all i dont know what were they looking and i dont know how they can choose a footballer with this trial.In the small side game with more than 20 players we tried to play in the half of field with just 1 goalkeeper and the coach was talking with someone in the bench side he didnt watch at all.This system has to change.I am from Turkey i came to Brighton for language school.On 28th July i came to London from Brighton with train.When I arrived I took 3 different buses to go to the Imperial.I mean it didnt worth it.

records.title: Poor Trial Structure
records.text: The trial was alright but been fully honest a lot could have been done better. For starters the trial wasn’t really set up position specific and we were just told to sort ourselves into our own positions during the small sided games even tho some times there would be 4 wingers in one team or 5 defenders. secondly the drills were very basic and weren’t broken down into position specific drills for examples defenders and wingers could have done 1v1 to asses their 1v1 abilities. strikers couldhave been tested on their finishing by reviving and one touch finishing drills/headers, instead we spent majority of time doing basic robotic passing drills for 20 minuets at a time something even 10 year olds could do not even position or individual specific to analyse. overall it just was really structured basic and not position specicc

records.title: Not what we expected
records.text: Initially, FirstPoint was very helpful in helping me to find universities, however, due to high academic demand or lack of scholarship on offer, none of them were suitable for me. I would have expected them to market me to more universities than just a handful. I ended up looking for universities myself and suggesting that they market my profile to them. Once I found a university that offered me a place, my family and I received virtually no help from FirstPoint in the visa or admissions processes. I have been at my university now for nigh on two years and I have not heard from them at all. Considering the fee that was paid, I think it is fair to say that my family and I deserved more from them.

records.title: What an absolute scam
records.text: What an absolute scam. Charging £20 for attendance, work that out when they travel the country, how much they make. What was funny was my boy and another 8 from his rugby club all got selected. Great u til you see the costings. If your son or daughter is that good firstly plenty of teams in the uk and secondly you can do this yourself bu getting in touch with the college or university. Don’t waster thousands of pounds on a dream

records.title: Unethical Practices
records.text: FirstPoint USA are withholding $20,000 of Faith Preparatory school funds for 10 months after the contract was cancelled. Despite multiple communications to CEO Andrew Kean there has been no response.Any school planning to do business with this company be very careful.Thank you for your response confirming that FirstPoint are holding onto our school' funds for 10 months. This is money that could be otherwise used to help students. Still no response from Andrew Kean.To all Schools being very careful before considering doing business with this company. Sadly they are not honorable.

records.title: It may be a good idea to notify those…
records.text: It may be a good idea to notify those who want to attend these trials that certain qualifications are required to go any further.  After taking a day off work, one off college, petrol for the journey to the StoneX statium and £20 for the privilege to try out,  we would not have bothered had we known that the student needs 5 x grade 4's to progress, which he didn't have!

records.title: Unethical Practices
records.text: My advice would be to proceed with caution when dealing with FirstPoint USA. They are witholding $20,000 of our school's money. Make sure you read the fine print of your contract very carefully. Our experince is they are not very ethical in their business practices.I would like to thank FirstPoint for their reponse below which reiterates my point. They are holding onto our money for 10 months after the contract was cancelled. We are a small Christian school and this money could otherwise be used to help students.We have reached out several times to the CEO Andrew Kean who has been unresponsive.Again my advice would be proceed with extreme caution in dealing with this company. Our experience is they do not operate in an ethical manner.

records.title: Feedback on 1st May's Trials in Hong Kong
records.text: I have some feedback regarding the trials. I'm puzzled why players of different ages and genders played touch rugby together. For those used to 15 aside contact rugby, especially forwards, this format didn't let them showcase their skills fully without scrums or tackle trials. It'd be helpful to inform candidates if Firstpoint USA is specifically looking for touch rugby players.I hope Firstpoint USA considers reviewing the selection process for fairer conditions in the future.

description:
City Lit is the country's ultimate destination for evening, weekend and daytime courses, delivered both online and face-to-face.  

Book now by visiting www.citylit.ac.uk

records.title: Italian taster…
records.text: I really enjoyed my Italian taster course. Veronica was very helpful and encouraging.

records.title: Amazing sculpture course, I recommend it.
records.text: Really enjoyed my sculpture course at CityLit with Annie who is an amazing tutor. Really supportive, gives great guidance and very knowledgeable on a wide range of materials. I learnt a lot and produced work I am proud of.

records.title: Learning Latin.                                                   The teacher has carefully broken down…
records.text: The teacher has carefully broken down the steps to learning Latin and given exercises to practise and websites for further practice. I was a bit baffled about accessing Microsoft Classroom as am an older learner and would welcome slightly clearer instructions particularly the reference to using Chrome. But eventually managed it! IT Help got back to me just as lesson started so I was relieved I’d managed to sort it out myself

records.title: I have been really enjoying my Italian…
records.text: I have been really enjoying my Italian classes with Mariangela. I started as a complete beginner, and so I have been progressing this year- becoming more confident at speaking. The classes are well organised, sometimes quite fast, so you cover quite a bit of ground which I like. I would really recommend and I am hoping to continue next year!

records.title: Careful! Learning is addictive at CityLit!
records.text: CityLit's range of classes is just incredible. I'd highly recommend joining in whether you want a class to learn something fun, get new skills, acquire knowledge, keep your old brain cells active or just to meet people.  The college offers in-person classes and online, the latter of which is a Godsend for me as I do not live in London. I enjoy learning and there is no end of topics/subjects that CityLit offers.

records.title: City Lit inspires
records.text: City Lit offers a fantastic range of courses, over many subjects.  In a great part of London, I have most recently enjoyed some short courses associated to bookbinding (which I study locally at evening class) - gold tooling and leather dyeing.The tutors are excellent, with a broad range of experience and the literature to take home to support home application has been great.  I have attended over many years, but am now limited by geography, as travelling from Devon, dodging train strikes, isn’t always easy.  If you like arts and crafts and London is accessible to you, I highly recommend City Lit.

records.title: Life-changing
records.text: Fantastic, life-changing place. In the past few years I have taken many courses, both short and long, at City Lit (the most recent ended less than a month ago). Some led to qualifications; others were just to acquire skills of follow particular interests. But every single course has been exceptional. The staff are knowledgeable and passionate, the atmosphere is friendly. And it's an opportunity to study alongside people of all ages and from all walks of life. I recommend City Lit to everyone I know!

records.title: Great venue & location
records.text: Great venue & location. Fantastic choice of courses. I've been impressed by the calibre of my fellow pupils. Unfortunately the onsite cafe closes at 3 pm during the week & is shut all weekend. There is no guarantee other people won't steal your work. This could be a problem possibly.

records.title: Realised ambition
records.text: When I retired one ambition was to improve my piano playing skills. Picking up from where I left off aged 18 @ level 5 City Lit gently and professionally taught me properly how to get to grips with this instrument. I’m really happy that I’m now at a sound level 6 and continuing to learn and improve week by week. It’s hugely absorbing and fulfilling and I hope will keep me entertained for the rest of my life.

records.title: Amazing Teaching at CityLit
records.text: Hi,Over the last five years since stopping work, I've done about 25 courses at CityLit. These are mainly singing and acting courses, but also intermediate French. So far I've never felt I had a dud teacher. Indeed, the longer I've worked with most teachers, the more impressed I've become with their professional knowledge. The teaching at CityLit is so good that even if you embark on a course of learning as an amateur, you may find yourself ending it as a full-blown professional !

records.title: I wish it were easier to keep track of what is being offered
records.text: I wish it were easier to keep track of what courses are offered.  I realise that a printed bulletin each year is not going to happen again, but would it not be possble to put a bulletin with all the next term's courses in a bulletin online where you can turn the pages!  It would be so much better to be able to check out the courses in an organised fashion to decide what I want to do.  Thank you.  Damaris Steele

records.title: Good tutors and courses
records.text: Good tutors, good courses.  Helpful staff. Clean rooms and loos. Seems well-organised overall My only criticisms are 1.Prices in café area 2. Opaque (even misleading) written 'help' in accessing and using Google Classroom (and I've been setting up/installing/ using computers/software since the 1980s..it must be even more of a nightmare for less confident users)

records.title: Great experience
records.text: I’ve been taking various language and music courses at CityLit since 2018. I’ve been very satisfied with the level of teaching, the content of the courses themselves as well as my own progression. I am disappointed however that the school does not offer senior rates for Saturday classes. I’m not too sure what the rationale behind that decision is. Senior rates for those Saturday classes would certainly bump my overall rating to 5 stars!

records.title: The teaching team and experience was a…
records.text: The teaching team and experience was a 5 star experience. The admin work and organisation requires more attention. Things like  an essay writing class, help with google classroom etc we’re not followed up which we’re promised at the beginning. The IT problem caused a lot of confusion and delays and we were informed a lot later. This could have been managed better.

records.title: Conversational French with Pierre was a…
records.text: Conversational French with Pierre was a pleasure. Always interesting topics so that we learnt more about France as well as the language. One thing Cit Lit could really improve is the indexing on their website. Search results are a real mish mash.

records.title: The courses are always interesting
records.text: The courses are always interesting. Finding a course is fairly easy. I’m only doing short examless courses without coursework. This means some of the admin doesn’t apply or isn’t really necessary. The college could make it easier for those of us in this position to contact lecturers erc.

records.title: Excellent courses but cafe facilities need changing
records.text: The art course was wholly up to expectations and excellent. The reason for lack of 5 stars are the cafe facilities  - the cafe closes on a whim, for example, just before lunch time with no warning whatsoever! The cafe is not open for evening courses and there is no drinks machine as a substitute.

records.title: I generally enjoy the History of Art…
records.text: I generally enjoy the History of Art courses - particularly those based in the galleries.I would give 5 stars were it not for the IT system. Just about everyone on my course experienced difficulty registering for a related Google account. Some may have given up. Surely it doesn't have to be this difficult?

records.title: Ten years of Ancient Greek.
records.text: I have just completed another high-level course in Ancient Greek and this has been my tenth year studying the subject at the City Lit. The courses have all been thorough, enjoyable, stimulating and very well taught.Teaching has been excellent.One minor criticism: the on-line information about the courses is not always up-to-date. During the Summer months the details on Autumn courses appear very late.It is good to know well beforehand which Greek authors will be studied. It enhances the anticipation!

records.title: The teachers are very knowledgeable and…
records.text: The teachers are very knowledgeable and the teaching facilities are good. It's got 4 stars because the cafe/canteen only opens from 9am-3pm, so when class ends in the afternoon there is no where for tea/coffee with fellow students.

records.title: I recently completed two courses at…
records.text: I recently completed two courses at City Lit in Ceramics and Painting. The Ceramics course was aimed at beginners, like me, one day a week over 6 months and Painting 1 was for complete beginners. Both were excellent. All the tutors were very knowledgable and encouraging. The facilities for ceramics were excellent and I would say good for painting. I would thoroughly recommend City Lit.

records.title: Just started my 2nd online course
records.text: Just started my 2nd online 6 week course with CiryLit. The first course was really informative and interactive. Great lecturer who is open to discussion and student input. The only issue was using Google classroom to access resources which I initially found difficult to access. However no such issues this time - new class materials have just appeared. I would definitely recommend CityLit.

records.title: Well worth it!
records.text: Very well paced course. Engaging tutor. Clean and learning focused environment. Descent training resources and practical equipment.This is my 2nd course with City Lit and I will be back for more. Huge variety of courses.

records.title: V enjoyable Film Studies course with…
records.text: V enjoyable Film Studies course with Jon Wisbey - British films of the 40s.Good selection of film clips and overview/discussion with a very engaging manner from the tutor.Would personally have liked some content on role of government re film making during the war but can’t get everything in!

records.title: Good, but some recent changes poor.
records.text: Almost without fail I have found the tutors to be knowledgeable and engaged with both subject and student. Unfortunately I have been unable to take several courses I would have liked to do because they have been split into short sessions over many weeks as opposed to one or two full day sessions. This increases travel costs and the probability of missing at least one session.

records.title: Affordable and well taught …
records.text: The courses at Citylit are affordable and mostly well taught. In my counselling year there were issues with a tutor resignation and no online access due to a security breach ( for 2 months). This resulted in considerable stress that admin and the department could have handled better. I loved the inner city location and would recommend this place to those looking for cost effective training.

records.title: The courses are very interesting and…Bravo  Citylit
records.text: The courses are very interesting and the tutors are good . It is disappointing when the subject is wide eg music and the course is short 10 weeks and sadly no follow up / continuation on a second programme. The Italian language course is also very good and the e excises are very useful to improve our grammar

records.title: Brilliant class with excellent tutor
records.text: Brilliant class with excellent tutor. The only reason I didn’t give 5 stars is the lack of catering in the evening. Even a vending machine for hot drinks would be good.

records.title: The 2-day watercolour beginner course…
records.text: The 2-day watercolour beginner course was relaxed and useful. We covered lots of aspects in a very short time. We were kept on our toes with lots of activities by a lovely, knowledgable and talented teacher.

records.title: Excellent course
records.text: Excellent course, great tutor at an affordable price. And brilliant to be there in person too. I’ve given 4 rather than 5 stars because the last 2 sessions were cancelled due to the IT problem.

records.title: Good but suited more to short courses
records.text: In my experience, CityLit are great at short, fun courses. I've found these to have high quality teaching, and be very good value too.For the more academic courses, of which I have done one - Counselling - this was a very intense experience.  Poor communication and poor treatment of students overall unfortunately. It is the first time I have an experience where I feel a department did NOT place the students best interests (nor similarly, a vibe of wanting students to excel/pass) as core. I hope to not experience that again.

records.title: excellent tutors and facilities
records.text: Been attending courses in various art & design disciplines for over 8 years now, excellent tutors and facilities. Until the pandemic the customer service was outstanding, but since then it's impossible to speak to a person if you have any issues or need to ask questions in choosing the right course/level. Also several of the longer design and illustration courses were cancelled last minute due to low enrolments. After going though the pain of making arrangements at work/travel to be able to attend or attending the course for work development training, it's very disappointing and cumbersome.

records.title: Student experience
records.text: The website is rubbish for all sorts of reasons.  It is not user friendly except maybe to people under 40.There is nowhere to get a coffee or bite to eat.When I have wanted to use the photocopier in the student centre there has been no-one to help.However, the tutor and accompanist in the Advanced song class are excellent.

records.title: Good tutors but poor books and poor IT…
records.text: Good tutor, very friendly and inclusive. Interesting clases. But book used was not at all helpful and CityLit would not respond to many of us saying there were better books out there. Google Classroom also a nightmare for many people who couldn't access it. And very hard to get support from CityLit IT team to sort this out.

records.title: Could be better
records.text: Feels like the courses are a bit limited lately. A lot of them are online or if in person, they are during the day (so pretty much impossible to attend if you work full-time). I wanted to join the Introduction to Illustration and Graphic Design course that was due to start this month and also earlier this year, but both times these were cancelled. Very annoying, possibly due to lack of people signing up?

records.title: Quality of tuition is very good
records.text: Quality of tuition is very good, but students experience variable levels of service from the organisation. For example, reduction in number of sessions did not automatically result in a credit. We had to complain before this was addressed. Vouchers for '£20 off' courses are sent to some students, not others, with no explanation why.Technology problems caused at least two sessions to be shortened by 20 mins each.

records.title: Music department experience
records.text: The move back on site after the 2 years of on line courses has not been a good experience .The range of courses on offer is much reduced - they are cancelled at short notice - ie one week before due to start - if insufficient numbers apply …. This is often after you have paid nearly £200 for an average 12 week course - there is little opportunity then to book on to another course and it takes weeks to get a refund . The site itself has closed its cafe etc early now - so you can’t get a coffee or anything between or before classes …. Once the classes are running in my experience they are trying to cater for multiple grades and hence don’t actually suit anyone …. So people drop out as it’s too challenging or too easy . Often they cease at an intermediate grade as not enough people have progressed to that level - they really should consider smaller class sizes at a slightly higher cost per class as a valid offering

records.title: It is hit and miss…
records.text: It is hit and miss some classes are amazing with really experienced, informed and knowledgeable teachers and other classes are very poorly planned and executed.  Do keep trying new courses / classes but would be beneficial if, particularly, "health and fitness" classes were overseen and teaching plans checked.

records.title: Teacher raced through materials
records.text: The college as a whole had been excellent from start to finish.  The only criticism is that the IT teacher just raced through the learning materials so fast that we were unable to learn anything really.

records.title: Mixed feelings
records.text: I have mixed feelings about the City Lit.  I have had some very interesting courses and good instructors, but I feel that the CityLit do not listen to their students nor act on feedback.  While majoring on zoom sessions, they have not got round to providing students with opportunities to talk to others outside the actual class (as one would be able to do with an in person class).  And a striking case in point is their reaction to the current major IT problem - no communciation with students at all, apart from a one page substitute home page on their website and a couple of entries on Twitter / facebook, not updated since 6 Dec.  What's happening?

records.title: Very knowledgeable tutors in Modern &…
records.text: Very knowledgeable tutors in Modern & Classical Languages.  But not all were good tutors!  Some incompetence with Google Classroom;  insensitive to Special Needs;  stuck rigidly to prescribed themes (discussion and questions stifled);  way far too much 'chat' time in 'break-out' groups, with little expertise or confidence in speaking the language competently to others (a College fault, imposed on tutors).  Fees far too expensive for really hard-up elderly, disabled students, (10 years loyalty!), with humiliating and demeaning system for financial aid._

records.title: Shrinkflation
records.text: Although the classes are excellent, some courses offered this coming autumn have been shortened whilst the price has remained the same - an example of 'shrinkflation'.

records.title: I am a bit disappointed that CityLit…
records.text: I am a bit disappointed that CityLit have not been more flexible regards courses at Keeley street during the very disruptive train and tube strikes in June 2022.  Many students will not be able to attend courses during this time, and CityLit could have provided short-term solutions to address -  eg hybrid offerings or a reschedule

records.title: I. T. crash
records.text: City Lit had at total I. T. break down with 2 weeks of a course is booked still to go. Information was slow and slight. All very unfortunate.Thanks for your reply @citylit. I'm booked on another course starting on Tuesday 10th. Still no joining details. Is the I.T. breakdown continuing?

records.title: Inaccurately described course
records.text: The day was good and the tutor was obviously very capable, but the course was not what was described. "Wildlife in the city" it was not. It was a matter of making the best of things, even if it was different from what was described.

records.title: I really enjoyed the language course…
records.text: I really enjoyed the language course however the cost is quite expensive for 10 lessons considering that it’s remote

records.title: When you advertise Greek courses
records.text: When you advertise Greek courses, the one I want is usually missing, or has the wrong data in it. It took a month or more to get onto the latest Greek course I wanted. The Bacchae. I can't see it at all in March's selections.Your group website I've never understood. why is it so complicated?When we get a good teacher, then the teacher is suddenly removed. Why. The last two terms have been good for Greek 5, but where is it going?

records.title: In normal times the courses were well…
records.text: In normal times the courses were well run and stimulating. In pandemic times things got difficult and the sociability and inter- action of the classes was lost. On line courses are OK for dutiful learning but the joy of adult education is the exchange between lecturer and students and between students themselves with all their different life experiences.Let's hope we can get back to classes with social distancing.

records.title: Great Spanish language classes
records.text: The Spanish language  classes are well run, there is an increasingly broader  choice  and the tutors are usually great.  Google classroom is a good learning platform; however, some of the classes are really quite large which gives less time for interaction and feedback .  I would find it helpful if the maximum class size was  listed as part of  the class information and when you signed up you were aware how many others had already signed up for the course.  If the class sizes were smaller i would rate these 5 star

records.title: Great tutors, poor infrastructure
records.text: These stars are not given or taken away lightly. I was VERY happy with the tutor – five stars for the excellent care and attention and great handouts – but there are far too many people in a relatively small room, even for non-pandemic times. The equipment is getting very ragged – surely City Lit can invest in new. (I am not referring to presses.) I've been taking classes for a few years now, and some equipment has remained in a poor state all that time. I come to City Lit for the excellent tutors, but unless the class sizes are reduced and some investment is made, I will not be back.

records.title: The website and Google Classroom is rubbish
records.text: The website is rubbish, I'm afraid. I cannot login to my Google Classroom, where files are meant to be had. This could have been a fairly simple setup, but it is made needlessly complicated. AND there is no direct phoneline to technical support. If you call tech support, you simply get hung up and 'redirected' to the website, which is little to no help. I have had several issues now and only gradually been able to get through to setting up my Google Classroom, now giving me the following message: "This password does not meet the length, complexity, age, or history requirements of your corporate password policy."I have already wasted a ridiculous amount of time trying to set this up, and now I'm being asked to show up in person to get it sorted. Considering that we pay for these courses, it shouldn't be so difficult accessing your course material.

records.title: The teaching was excellent.
records.text: The teaching was excellent.However, although constantly receiving many emails, enrolling was not easy.But,most importantly, the derelict  non-functioning "cafe" near the entrance is a disgrace.  Will there or won't there be refreshments at tea time or in evening? I won't advise others to come if not.

records.title: Unfair discount
records.text: Yet again, I have been penalised for enrolling early. I enrolled early in July, and about a week ago an offer of 10% off the cost of enrolment arrived in my in-box. This happened before, and after I made a huge and troublesome fuss I was eventually given the discount. Now I notice this line in the email "Discount cannot be used retrospectively on any course already booked." In future, I won't book until the week before the course starts. If that  means I don't get a place, so be it. There are other providers out there.

records.title: Not great, with one exception!
records.text: With one outstanding exception it’s not great. Overall the standard of teaching is not fantastic and it’s the delivery and interaction that leaves much to be desired (bar one!).  To be fair, I have only taken Arts classes done remotely/Zoom, so in person may be better.In a recent OFSTED review City Lit did very well; overall for the institution that’s probably fair.  That said my biggest bug bear other than the variable standard in teaching of Arts subjects is the complete lack of progression.  A course is given, oftentimes yearly, but there seems to be huge ‘management’ resistance to follow up.  You do something at entry level, you get excited and wish to continue to improve but there is NO level 2, 3, 4 … as you get with say languages. Over the past 18 months I’ve done several classes, I would love to do more, but sadly I will be going elsewhere to progress.

records.title: Fine for intro courses and meeting new friends not for anything more advanced unless you already the finished article.
records.text: Most of the teaching at City lit is good and the facilities are fine. On courses I’ve attended I’ve met friends I will have for life. So far so good. However, the place can feel a bit disorganised at times with room changes and a sense that lecturers don’t communicate with each other enough to get a better understanding of how things are going. This was not helped by a recent computer issues (now resolved) that hindered teaching for a while. I have recently successfully completed a course at city lit but feel badly let down as I’ve not been able to progress onto the course that is the level above despite evidence that some of my work is already at that level. It seems to me that City lit is fine for short courses and courses aimed at beginners but want the finished article that they do not have to develop much on more advanced courses. I feel that my on and off 8 year relationship is now firmly off for the foreseeable future.

records.title: Beginners Korean
records.text: Beginners Korean 14 in class so quite large. No communication with other students. After one week, a two week break due to tutor’s family bereavement.  Course shortened by one week so a refund received.Repeated difficulty with accessing course material with messages on line, repeating the message that I have no account. So far not brilliant.

records.title: I used to be a big fan of city lit but…
records.text: I used to be a big fan of city lit but post covid I have found the experience here disappointing. They have done away with face to face interaction ( even when standing in the building you have to speak to someone remotely). The website is confusing if you have multiple queries and the enrolment team is so understaffed its a struggle to get through. Don't offer taster courses if you have no-one that students can speak to afterwards to discuss course options.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: While I enjoyed my first course with CityLit, for the second I got caught in the downing of all online programmes.  I was very disappointed that CityLit has never got in touch about a reimbursement or alternative programme.  I am still waiting e en though online business seems to be back.

records.title: Great teachers, terrible communication
records.text: First of all, I want to say that my teachers at City Lit have all been great. However, my experience with the school has been quite the opposite. Lessons on the 1st and 8th December were cancelled due to IT issues (the final two classes of an 11 class module). I have received minimal communication since then, and have lost access to my google classroom. Some of this is understandable, but it's now been over a month. I see from other reviews on here that people have been contacted regarding refunds. All I have received is an email saying I will received a credit for the lessons missed. But, how am I supposed to do the next module without completing the one before? Am I supposed to pay to do the module again, or start the next one in a worse position than the rest of my classmates? I have requested a refund, and contacted CityLit via social media, but still haven't heard anything. I certainly won't be returning to CityLit for future language lessons.

records.title: The admin system is terrible
records.text: The admin system is terrible! I went round and round in circles for a long time. I only persevered because I really wanted to do the specific course. I would have given up much earlier if I'd had an option somewhere else.Bring back real life offices where you can talk to a real person, please!

records.title: Association of learning beauty therapy course
records.text: The website is easy to use and give good discounts on special occasions. The course material is easy to read and and questions are clear. Overall an amazing course. Very satisfied with association of learning.

records.title: Amazing experience
records.text: The experience has been amazing right from the start. The responses were prompt and conversations were very engaging. Looking foward to a great learning journey

records.title: Great value with a moderate cost
records.text: Overtime, I have made several research on which training company to enrol for my healthcare career progression, none had the depth, complete and cost effective features like Association of Learning. Hence, I made it my choice and no regrets!

records.title: My journey with Association of Learning.
records.text: My journey with the three courses I've completed so far has been really positive, and I hope to see more Level 5 courses offered so I can continue learning. They are great at addressing student inquiries, and I highly recommend their effective support and quick responses throughout the learning process. The assessors are polite and helpful, making assessments easy and hassle-free. The course materials are comprehensive and informative, even for Level 3 and Level 4 courses, which maintain excellent quality and standards. I would give them five stars across the board.  My personal experience has been excellent, and I have already recommended three people to enroll with them. I’m sharing my journey and positive experience in the hope that others can have similar experiences as well.

records.title: Fabulous gateway to further education
records.text: Very happy with my experience using Association of learning. The variety of courses and information is brilliant. There something for everyone! The full refund offer is an amazing incentive to also. Will definitely recommend

records.title: Just signed up

records.title: The company is reliable and competent

records.title: Association of learning have proven to…
records.text: Association of learning have proven to me that learning is not difficult as one might think. It took me over a year to settle on this program and I have never regretted for my decision.Thank you association of learning.

records.title: My experience has been wonderful

records.title: I initiated this course as I wanted to…

records.title: I really was pleased with the level of…

records.title: Cancellation…
records.text: Update: I have now received my refund. Update: I am pleased to share that Association of Learning has assured me that my refund will be issued. The team has been incredibly helpful and responsive throughout the cancellation process, addressing my concerns promptly and professionally.The course content itself was well-structured and exactly what I was looking for to further my knowledge. Despite this, I appreciate the support and understanding shown by the team, making the process much smoother than I anticipated.Thank you for your excellent service, and I look forward to updating again once the refund is received..Update: My course & direct debit has been cancelled but I have not yet received a refund. records.title: I was able to complete a level 3…
records.text: I was able to complete a level 3 diploma while working full time as the course works around me. I am now looking at completing another qualification to further my career as I loved the flexibility that these courses offer.

records.title: Value for money

records.title: I received a prompt response to…

I would look forward to seeing myself learning fast and having an overall experience that is interesting.

records.title: This course maintains high standards of academic writing..

The portal can be a bit problematic as the windows to write are small. Otherwise, it's a great course to be on, with excellent support available from the admin.

records.title: Wrong resources sent through
records.text: I signed up to do a Counselling Diploma so a bundle of courses and received the course materials the next day. Have completed two.units.which have been marked very quickly by the tutor. However when I looked to see how.many units were.in each of the courses I noticed that they have actually sent me through materials for a different diploma and which I also would like to add costs almost half what I paid despite it stating the correct course on my account!!!!I have emailed without any response and also rang but again without any response. I just would like the correct materials sent through but a little worrying when it seems so difficult to contact anyone.

records.title: Great course but one big let down
records.text: So i did a counselling and psychotherapy course being told if complete the course within 6 months I would be refunded.  I did the course which i found really good and the tutor was always there when i had questions.  I completed the course within 3 months and passed each module. So i requested my refund.  This was refused because although i passed i didnt meet the critieria which were in their terms and conditions.  Absolutely gutted.  So i just want to warn people to read the small print of the terms and conditions with this particular offer.Apart from that it was a great course and this is my personal experience.

records.title: following on from your reply
records.text: Following on from your reply... Yes I understood the importance of referencing, the generators are really useful as are the videos. Unfortunately it's taking me longer to get to grips with it that's all I am saying. As for you saying you do get one tutor throughout, I'm not sure why on all three of my feedbacks it says a different name then, on several occasions I have gone to message my tutor and it has said error, then a different name has come up on my feedback form. I'm not at all leaving a negative review on the company, it's just my opinion on how I am finding the course so far. Thanks, yes I will email them and ask them as like I said I am unable to email my tutor again.Many thanks

records.title: Shameful additional costs
records.text: Really good course content and tutor support too. But £25 for a PDF academic transcript is shameful and de -values the business.

records.title: SO Far good just waiting for Course…
records.text: SO Far good just waiting for Course Materiel.

records.title: No email replied and my account is locked out
records.text: Started a course in January (had to wait a few weeks for enrolment to start after purchase, as they didn’t have enough students apparently). I had completed one assessment but had to re do because the first question was wrong and I had made an error in the in text referencing for the 1st 2 questions so got told ‘she doesn’t even want to mark the rest’ so suppose will need to see if the rest is fine and hope she doesn’t just keep passing it back after one question. Anyway not managed to get back to it until this week where I tried to log in to my account and I’m getting that the log in details don’t exist. So tried the forget your password which I’m also getting my email doesn’t exist with them. (Same email I got my welcome emails etc). And my payments have left my account. I have tried 3 times to email them because existing students aren’t allowed to call them but no reply from them. I actually tried to call the new customer number and all I get is that their message box is full and it hangs up. So not sure what is happening with them as they have taken my monthly payments but il be cancelling payment details if they do not answer and rectify this week. Edit: So finally got a reply to the correct account email, saying my account is fine and that they have sent a resit pin to get into my account but this was sent for a very old account with a different email address.  So hopefully my reply will be answered asap, so it’s not getting dragged out any longer.

records.title: Right to reply
records.text: A negative review and, as if by magic, two positive one liners. Just a coincidence, obviously. All your positive reviews are invited reviews. The fact is that I had one assignment marked in ten weeks. If you believe that is acceptable, then fair enough. Good luck to you. In my honest opinion, you could have dealt with this more professionally.

records.title: Not a good experience
records.text: Unfortunately, a negative experience for me. Signing up was easy and their system of completing assignments is actually, for me, enjoyable and in a good format. It was the marking, or lack of,  that disappointed me. The blurb on their website quotes a 7 day marking time, then boasts of an average of 3 days to mark an assignment. I had one assignment marked in 10 weeks. To be fair, AOL acknowledged that the delay was unacceptable, apologised and assigned a different tutor to mark my work. Unfortunately nothing improved, leading me to ask for a refund of my course fees, which I actually didn’t want. I just wanted my worked marked in a ‘timely fashion’ as they said themselves. AOL actually cited that my expectations were to high; my only expectations were that they kept to their promises on their own website. Looking at all these positive Trust Pilot reviews, it looks like I was the only one having problems, which is strange. One thing that AOL did do in a ‘timely fashion’ was to suspend my account before I had received my refund. Very disappointed.I will also think twice about using Trust Pilot again as a guide to see how suitable a company is.

records.title: How can I make complaint?
records.text: I paid my account off in full after the completion of one of my courses on the 2/6/2020 after receiving an invoice as I requested. I then had a direct debit taken from my account for further money - I emailed and was advised this was taken due to timings of payments and that it would be refunded as my account had been paid in full. Fast forward to 1am this morning when I  received an email stating I have 24hrs to pay otherwise the account will default - I have been trying to contact them since 7.32am to try and resolve this issue and I am still waiting for a response 9 hours later. No one is available for phone calls, and the automated message advised a response should be had within the hour...I’m still waiting. I have confirmation of full payment, of the direct debit taken, of the invoice, and of the correspondence from the representative advising she would issue the refund because I had paid in full. This is causing me extreme stress, but I feel like I’m being ignored and can’t contact the company. If someone from the company is reading this, please can you get in contact and reply to my emails as it’s getting increasingly more stressful

records.title: They don’t care
records.text: I started a Diploma course with them April last year but they kept returning my work after 4 or 5 submissions for Unit 1 for a course of 20 Units. I regret registering with them. I am still paying till date(January 2025) even though I have withdrawn. They send threatening emails on payments. To worsen the case , they don’t stick to a particular date when debiting you. Beware of them!!

records.title: Completely useless
records.text: Completely useless. Admin has been shocking and I'm glad we cancelled the course. They couldn't get the courses right that we had signed up for, they then said one course wasn't available. I took up the offer to pay in full but now a month later I had 3 direct debits taken out of my account. I don't know why they took any direct debits never mind three since we'd paid in full and also cancelled the course. Wouldn't recommend at all. records.title: Absolutely appalling admin
records.text: Absolutely appalling admin. I’ve already written a review here and they’ve continued to be completely incompetent muppets. After writing here about how we’d had not one but THREE direct debits taken on the same day for courses that I’d originally paid in full but then cancelled due to red flags during the setting up process, I’ve subsequently had emails chasing for the money and saying the money will be taken anyway with penalties on top. records.title: Regret enrolling with Association of Learning…
records.text: I don't recommend Association of learning. As soon as you register they sent you an email to give a review obviously at that time you can give a good review because the registration is easier after that everything turns upside down.They keep on failing you.Will be trying my best researching and write assignments but what they say is you did not meet the criteria.After all you can not withdraw the course they keep on taking money since it is direct debit .

records.title: Poor communication leading to refund scam
records.text: Association of Learning are not responding to any of my emails, in reasonable time or at all. There is no way to phone them as a current student. Their linear assessment model means they can simply mark your work too slowly to make good on their refund offer, which is constructed breach of contract.One unit of my counselling course was literally duplicated from another course I had already paid for and completed. I do not believe I should be trying to have a legal battle with my education establishment because they won't mark my work fast enough to finish the course in time. Disgraceful, 2/10, please see me.

records.title: Locked out of the course because I need…
records.text: Locked out of the course because I need to complete suitability pre-check prior to assessing the course. All payments done despite being denied access. No link to contact support on what happens next. I feel robbed honestly. Sad things is I had recommended 2 other friends and we are all in the same boat, full payment and zero service.

records.title: Computer science teacher

records.title: The tutor was gave such detailed…

records.title: Daryl Creek is an amazing tutor

records.title: Great help and assistance on enrolment…

records.title: I had a happy learning with Oxbridge
records.text: I had a happy learning with Oxbridge, studied GCSE Mathematics highier Tier (AQA) from 2023 and wrote my final exams June 2024. I am glad I passed🙂. records.title: My personal tutor was amazing!

records.title: Things to be aware of before committing
records.text: So back in Sept 2022, my employers agreed to pay for me to do the NCFE Level 3 Award in Education and Training.The online distance learning platform was a better option for me, it wasn't easy to find a classroom course near where I lived and this option also meant I could work in it as often as I wanted.The platform was fine - it does cause a few heart attacks at first because there's a unit that requires you to be a school teacher with a school placement which isn't my profession but alas on investigation I didn't need to do that unitIt can at times take a few weeks to get assignments marked but the feedback is good.The problem was when the micro teach started to loom, I knew I had to deliver a micro teach but the NCFE kept changing the rules on it and Oxbridge struggled to handle that. At one stage they were going to put a microteach day on at a venue in the north as live in the north as did a number of other participants.Then this changed to having to attend Oxbridge's training centre near central Birmingham - this is very important for people to consider if they are choosing distance learning for better accessibility- you may well need to be within easy reach of Birmingham!And not just to be there for a couple of hours either, from about 9am til 4pm which I said o just couldn't do because I'm over 200 miles away from Birmingham with no public transport options so I would have had a very long and stressful drive through rush hours to get there and back - maybe a 15 hour day for a 15 minute microteach. I didn't want to do that and jeopardise not getting there because of traffic or being that stressed and exhausted that I mess up my microteach.So the other option was I had to teach people were I work with an Oxbridge assessor in the room. So then I had to scrap the micro teach I created and create one relevant to deliver to our staff. Then the NCFE instruction changed again at short notice that the course had to be longer than what I'd planned for.It started to become a headache that I never thought I'd pass, forms that had to be filled in and signed were more relevant to teachers in teaching establishments and I didn't have a qualified teacher here to sign my form.as I'm the workplace safety trainer! Then you get asked about C.Vs of bosses for their credentials to sign my forms off which I wasn't comfortable with asking for and managers I did speak to said they hadn't updated CV's in years.We got there in the end but it was made far more complicated than it needed to be.So things finally got signed off and submitted by about early Oct 2023 but right now it's 1st May 24 and I'm still waiting for any official notification from the NCFE which seems seriously long-winded and of course my boss does ask where things are at with the course they paid for!I feel for Oxbridge as I think the NCFE make their life complicated but I have to be honest about the difficulty it gives us as students.

records.title: Mixed feelings
records.text: Oxbridge were very quick in responding to my queries whilst doing my course work, however they changed requirements to pass units and for my observations half way through the course without notifying me, so I ended up having to rework some of my units. When it came to the end of my course, they failed to tell me that I had completed my units and then took 7 months to issue the certificate (after chasing on several occasions) I feel that the courses themselves and the support given by the course expert was good  , however the customer service and administration given by oxbridge needs improving.

records.title: Feedback response
records.text: Quick response. Courteous. Thigs may be looking up!

records.title: Prompt responses to enrolment queries
records.text: Prompt responses to enrolment queries. Very helpful over phone. Improvements could be made to the learning platform, and I think a physical copy of the main text book should be supplied as part of the course fee given that the learning is all online.

records.title: No response on chat at the Weekend  or on Monday
records.text: I wrote in chat over the weekend and got no response. So I wrote again today. Jake answered quickly which was good and he was reasonably knowledgeable.  I was given a phone number to call so it just means i have to go to other routes to get answers.  Other companies offer the information on their website so it's a bit of a clunky process on here.  Something worth looking at.  I wanted to know about predicted grades and to get them for UCAS.  The answer was talk to the tutor.  On another learning site, they explain at what point they can offer a predicted grade and the process.  I also had to ask about the CPAC and references - again info I would have hoped would have been easy to find rather than left on a weekend waiting for an answer that never came. And the answer I received was to call to discuss.  Many people are trying to decide which online school at the weekend so it is probably good to have people on during Peak enrolment weekends?

records.title: Great customer support
records.text: Minutes after enrolling onto a course I received a message from an advisor via the live chat offering a discount on courses if I was to sign up to one that day. I messaged the advisor enquiring about the course I had paid for and if I could get a discount on it, in other words a refund to reflect the discount. Although the first answer was no, due to already paying for the course, I escalated this and managed to get a discount and a refund. Thank you to the advisor Reiss who escalated my points to the manager and for getting me a discount. I look forward to starting my course with Oxbridge, more so knowing that the customer service is great.

records.title: Course was great
records.text: I thoroughly enjoyed the course and was very convenient to do. However, I had a tough time getting things marked at the beginning with my old tutors Carol and Amiee, the communication with them was poor too. But Joanne and Bobbi, helped me hugely, they were so good, there communication was instant, marking was incredibly quick and helped me massively with my future, most importantly they cared.

records.title: Mixed review
records.text: I thought the course content was good and an easy platform to use. However I was allocated 3 different tutors over 5 months and none of them got in contact or replied to my queries. I also had to chase up marking of all my assignments and all took much longer than the 2 weeks promised. I was happy to achieve my level 3 though.

records.title: NLP level 3 course
records.text: I completed the NLP level 3 course. The staff  were very helpful. Course work was marked promptly.  I completed the course for CPD and, with that in mind, for me there was too much emphasis on setting up in business. In the course material there was a reference to a workbook but when I requested this I was told it wasn't available so the content needs a review.   It look nearly 3 months to get my certificate because of delays but they did offer to provide a written confirmation.

records.title: Consistency needs work
records.text: Inconsistencies in the PowerPoint and the notes (wholes slides missing). Grammar and spelling could do with a good revision as well as the titles of the modules as they didn’t always match the content, or the course!Aside from that, the support from the tutor was great and the course had a good order and level of information.

records.title: Not the best experience
records.text: Not the best experience unfortunately. I did the level 3 counselling skills course and a lot of the questions were poorly worded, with multiple typos throughout the course material. Some questions asked you to write about ‘workshops’ or work done with your peers despite their being no workshops or peers on this kind of online course. I also had a change of tutor without anyone telling me. My submission for one unit was once accidentally deleted by Oxbridge and so I had to wait months for it to be marked. When I finished the course in august I was told my certificate would be with me in 12 weeks, and I’ve only just received it at the start of March, after chasing it several times. Overall I don’t think it was worth the money, sorry.

records.title: One tutor per some subjects
records.text: The selling team is fantastic.  All questions answered quickly.  The follow up call is not aggressive or pushy. However, it transpired that at least some subjects only have one supporting tutor. Furthermore, some tutors are assigned  up to 100 students. It would be a huge risk to sign up, in my view.

records.title: I’m still waiting for the support…
records.text: I’m still waiting for the support system to help me about the email I’ve sent them

records.title: Don't Waste Your Money
records.text: I've been studying A Level Computer Science with Oxbridge for a few months and I wish I hadn't wasted my money.As mentioned in other reviews, the content is full of errors and this is really confusing when self studying. Also, rather than offering on demand videos, the content is just PDFs (Which you could substitute with a text book) and links to youtube videos (not oxbridge content, but various computer science youtubers), these are great, but you could easily find these yourself withouth paying hundreds of pounds for the course.One of the only pros is the course tutor, I've had responses from a couple. They reply quickly, are friendly and couldn't be more helpful.

records.title: GCSE Spanish
records.text: Tutors - really nice people, but the Oxbridge framework doesn't allow them to properly support your learning. For example, I requested one 45 minute monthly call to check in with my tutor and ask language questions. Not an unreasonable ask. Oxbridge's support team stepped in to tell me this was not available to me. Since I was outside my cancellation window, there was nothing I could do about it.Coursework - full of broken links, typos and errors in the coursework. I've listed them and shared them with Oxbridge in the hope they will fix these errors for any future students. They also test you in assignments on topics you haven't yet covered. There is also a heavy reliance on BBC Bitesize (which your license fee already covers) Also, printed materials were not available to me despite being promised at point of sale (Oxbridge relied on asterisks and small print.)Quality - more worrying was the quality of translations, my Spanish partner spotted many simple mistakes in what was being taught.I worked really hard, and I am hoping for a pass in spite of the issues above. Thanks to my tutor Emily for doing her best in Oxbridge's framework, which is not really designed to support your learning, but to maximise a passive income stream.

records.title: Review part way through
records.text: The course content is great and after completing only two assignments my knowledge has greatly increased. The reason for 2 stars though is my personal tutor does not respond to my emails and I have to chase up the college every time I submit work. The first assignment was marked late and my second one after 23 days was marked, despite saying they will be marked within 14 days. After paying nearly £400 for this course thought things would be done in a timely manner

records.title: I wouldn’t do another course here.
records.text: The course itself was fine and reasonably priced. However, part of my course required a certain format which no one at Oxbridge ever helped me learn how to do; I emailed constantly and I never got a response. I did try and learn it myself but I just couldn’t understand it. Then during my final grade I got significantly marked down due to this not being done yet I received no help during the process. When I appealed this afterwards, I received several emails asking for details on what had happened and was told it would be looked into. I heard nothing for about a month before I chased them again and was told since I had my certificate they could not amend my grade, despite the fact that the first time I saw my final grade was on my certificate.

records.title: Aggressive marketing
records.text: I had a chat online with an advisor who was very helpful, but they didn't leave me alone for the next 10 days after that: texts, calls and emails every single day. I sent an email saying that I would think about it and if they could please stop calling, to no avail. I've just asked them via chat to delete my data, they closed the chat without a word. My worry is that they put all their effort in getting customers in, not sure what happens afterwards but it doesn't give me confidence to want and find out. I'm giving an extra star for the first helpful chat.

records.title: DO NOT JOIN
records.text: DO NOT JOIN. I am taking three A Level courses. In each course the have been countless spelling mistakes, grammar mistakes and even as bad as missing content. The is information missing, where they have missed out half a page. They do not support you with how to answer a exam question. One of my tutors doesn't respond to any of my emails asking for help. I honestly have no clue how they can call themselves an award winning college. I DO NOT RECOMMEND this college to anyone.

records.title: Not for me
records.text: Materials were great. Submission methods aren't ideal if you are busy. Support lacking. I wouldn't take another course with them

records.title: I completed a travel and tourism course…
records.text: I completed a travel and tourism course back before the summer holidays. I’m still waiting on final results and certificate. I’ve emailed a few times chasing up to be told it’s held up. Really disappointed as I worked hard to complete on time.

description:

records.title: Not quality checked
records.text: The Change Management Foundation course is disappointing to say the least. Foundation courses should give you a foundation to build further knowledge, but this course absolutely cannot be used as a standalone. You will need to do constant external research - switching back to the course syllabus constantly, because the AI transcript does not do a good job of translating the tutor's accent and slides don't always include practitioner names - just to understand core concepts. Lessons often introduce a methodology or model as extended examples and forget to include an explanation of what you're actually meant to be learning.Another slap in the face is the poor quality. Slides are missing icons, almost every module has grammar/spelling mistakes, and there are even lessons where the information is just incorrect. You would think for a course charging hundreds, it would at least meet the quality standards of what you would find for free on YouTube.The admin side is also a concern. If you choose to pay in instalments, you will receive an email on the last payment telling you your training has expired, which is never explained to you beforehand. When I received a call the next day to answer my concerned email, I was told this happens a lot - so why wouldn't the company just change it? I was also "kindly" told that my exam could not be booked until my last payment had been made. The email then included a screenshot confirming my final payment had been made two days ago. I submitted a complaint almost two weeks ago and never received a response or acknowledgement that it had been received. Hopefully, at some point, the course will be properly reviewed and amended so people get value for their money.If you want a Change Management Foundation certificate, buy the exam only and do your learning from trusted sources. Or if you don't mind poor quality, wait until this course is on sale and it might not feel as bad knowing what you're going into.

records.text: I realy enjoy the self taught style of work and study you have to under go throughout the course,as well as the access to source of help supplied through the course itself aswell as the fast respons time from people like 	Rosco McKinnon and the rest of the support staff.Theonly negative thing i can mention whould be the fact that the mentors are not allowed to directly help you with which at time can leave you demotivated and feeling a bit lost.

records.title: Data Science Skills Bootcamp
records.text: HyperionDev was willing to listen and improve its processes, which is a positive attitude. I accessed free training funded by UK DfE. The Data Science course pushed me to meet deadlines and learn to code tasks which seemed impossible, which has given me a sense of accomplishment. Without the deadline then I would not have finished this course.

records.title: Great Software Engineering course for…
records.text: Great Software Engineering course for people who want to start their adventure with programming but also those who want to brush up their skills.The best part in my opinion is the Graduate Support where HyperionDev offer additional help in fining a new job in tech.I was part of the first cohort sponsored by DfE so there were a few teething issues.

records.title: Effective learning
records.text: I like the structure of the bootcamp, completing the tasks one by one helps students develop skills and knowledge. The mentor support service is also handy, which makes students easily seek help from mentors.The on track/progress bar and stars awards/scoring system also motivate students to do better and faster to achieve goals they aim at.The examples provided for the tasks/topic really help students to understand the content deeper.

records.title: Useful cast but technical difficulties
records.text: I've  been doing the Boot camp for Data Science, and it really works for me. I find the fact that they mark your work very helpful to me, as I need that extra motivation.I've knocked off a star because unfortunately I have been plagued by technical difficulties, from the very beginning of the course eg. I made a small mistake on the intro form and then couldn't sign the contract (and therefore access the course) for about 2 weeks. However, I did find that the technical support people were very helpful when contacted (in particular Oscar Msibi).

records.title: my personal experience
records.text: i have gained far more from this bootcamp than expected and was well guided by the many mentors and other members of support that they offer.If you are ever thnking of getting into code and or learning a new form of code i would highly recommend this bootcamp to you. The only thing i could comment on is that even tho the mentor sessions are done to standerd it can leave you lost some times due to the fact that mentors often have to dance around the answer which can be very difficult to rap your mind around

records.title: A Robust Bootcamp
records.text: Hyperiondev is a great place to develop your skills. They are very open and guide you through the application process, onboarding and lectures. They make sure everyone is included and has the resources. The tasks are well constructed to enable you to understand and perform them. I have leant how to code in just a few weeks and handled my first project. Oh, and there is the career section where you learn about the industry, and how to create a compiled cv and attract recruiters. I am glad I enrolled on this boot camp.

records.title: Great program, unrealistic expectations
records.text: The program was very well introduced. The lectures are as thorough as one would expect of a beginner level bootcamp. The concepts are clearly explained, with plenty of example code.I would have rated it a 5 star, except for one thing. I am skeptical about the employment or self-employment prospects upon completing the course, since even entry level tech jobs (for example in LinkedIn jobs) seem to require significant breadth of programming knowledge apart from basic Python. People joining the course from non-tech backgrounds are unlikely to achieve this sort of breadth within a short timescale and without the aid of several other courses...not really feasible for those already in full-time employment.

records.title: Wait time to get to boot camp can be a while but it’s worth the hassle!
records.text: Very well explained documents and videos explaining what you need to know for the task ahead!Simple and easy to understand everything explained, for a complete novice to coding this helped immensely and I now feel I can go ahead and create a basic code doing whatever I wish. Great community that are all in the same boat and willing to help with tasks if they’ve already complete them and vice versa. Only downside is the wait time to see if you’ve made it to the boot camp - because of this I ended up starting a few months behind others. Although I did complete all mandatory tasks in the end.

records.title: Lectures are done on a great level!
records.text: Lectures are done on a great level, informative and easy to follow along. Learning curve is steep, but all the resources or ways to obtain them are available straight away to any student. The only problem I found is that my tasks have taken a long time to check, but considering the amount of people on the bootcamp, it is understandable that such delays are going to happen.

records.title: DS Bootcamp experience
records.text: 1. Task Reviewing that credit hardwork and encourage to explore beyond expectaction on tasks.2. You are not penalised for using a different approach to the task instead you are encouraged to  exercise your knowledge as long you meet the expected task output. 3. How the program is designed it ensures that you alway on track and  competitive.4. Post program, I was not 100% active and cant say much of the experience due to personal problems.

records.title: I got my certificate
records.text: I am happy I got my certificate and a £100 voucher for amazon. The way the boot camp was taught was rather disorganised.

records.title: The written information is amazing
records.text: The written information is amazing. I still have no access to video lectures.

records.title: The Bootcamp is adequate.
records.text: I did the Software Dev & Full Stack Dev part time bootcamp (12months) The curriculum is good (MERN STACK). Support is good. Problems: A lot of the tasks/examples/projects are 2+ years outdated, so the examples doesn't really help at all, (for instance, the React/Express sections are extremely outdated and its makes the examples worth nothing). It doesn't matter so much in the Javascript/html/css/php tasks, as the changes overtime in these technologies are minimal. Biggest area they need to improve is providing decent and updated examples/explanations. This bootcamp is great if you are prepared to do a lot of self research, practice, etc.Just put in the effort to watch tutorials, practice, etc. and you will be fine.

records.title: Free Course Expierence...
records.text: For a free course "Goverment sponsored" it's great. But besides that, course material is pretty basic, intro level stuff. For an actual learning expierence HyperioDev would need some group projects, lectures based in a classroom and more intense curriculum.

records.title: Nape's HyperionDev exp
records.text: Assistance platforms to student should be improved. Discord platform is not effective at all for me and the slots for 1-1 with the mentor becomes a challenge at times since most of the time they are not available.
