records.title: Really interesting and stimulating…
records.text: Really interesting and stimulating presentations. I did find it hard to get to see all so managed about 1/3. A 2nd week to catch up would be great though I'm aware they are now part of the lifelong learning. Thanks especially making it accessible being free online.

records.title: The conference was great!!
records.text: The conference was great and having online access was so helpful! So many useful videos and the posters were really interesting. I've learned a lot and it's brought a number of things to my attention that I'd like to explore further and bring to my practice. The only negative thing is that I wish it was available for longer. My understanding is that the resources are only available for a week. Between work, travel and other commitments I haven't been able to take in as many of the presentations as I would have liked. Having the information available for longer (2-4 weeks) would be so much easier. But it was otherwise brilliant.

records.title: Much of what I saw and heard was very…
records.text: Much of what I saw and heard was very informative even though it didn't apply to my role. I support teachers (mostly ECE teachers), and I like to inform myself so that I can pass information on to them.

records.title: Well put together online conference
records.text: Well put together online conference. Easy to navigate with an interesting range of talks and posters. Thank you to the presenters and the SIE team!

records.title: Very informative and engaging
records.text: Very informative and engaging. However, I found the sessions at the start and end that didn't have a presenter video much more difficult to engage with.

records.title: This is one of the best explanation for…sensory system physiology.
records.text: This is one of the best explanation for a busy mom, who needs to know essential information on this extensive topic. But your team has super simplified.🙂   Sensory information is vital for our body to respond to the outside world and its dysfunction has a profound effect on quality of life. keep up the good work.

records.title: good grounding to SI knowledge and practical tips
records.text: it was clearly laid out and organised. liked the practical tips that feel safe and possible. explains background of senses and why we need them and the importance of recognising when we need to pay attention and the role of flight or fight. would have liked it to include interoception -but maybe theres a reason for not including it. given us a sense of curiosity about ourselves as adults too.

records.title: Keeping current at own pace
records.text: The ability to tune in to current research on SI practices at my own time and pace was helpful amidst the busy work schedule.

records.title: The strategies given were good but it…
records.text: The strategies given were good but it would have been more helpful with more practical examples.

records.title: Enjoyed the course
records.text: Enjoyed the course.  It was a helpful introduction to the world of Sensory Processing issues. An excellent starting point, but now need to dive deeper to find out information specific to the person I am thinking aboutSlightly frustrating that at times took a long time to download some of the new presentation sections...but this may be a problem with my download speeds rather than an issue with the course?!

records.title: Really useful, but longer access time needed
records.text: Really useful, well-presented and interesting training.We made a block-booking for all the OTs in our service and the only down-side was that several of us found that 1 months access was not enough for most of us, despite the best laid plans caseload demands took precedence at times. records.title: Varity of formats and perspectives
records.text: I think it is great to have everyone's voices heard - OTs, parents, individuals with some SI differences. I enjoyed the topic of the conference - from sensation to participation. I enjoyed the interview and poster formats. I wish that the speakers wouldn't repeat each other and things that we already know. I suggest the conference is at least two weeks. One week is a lot of rush. And in Nov there are other conferences as well, and it really feels like a lot. Thank you so much for your efforts to put everything together.

records.title: I thought this was a great free…
records.text: I thought this was a great free training resource which was very accessible in terms of the information and how it was presented.I did find the set up of the training quite confusing - with the 'mark as complete and continue' button being available throughout the training. Initially I thought this applied to the slides so I ticked it and within a few minutes I had completed the whole course! I worked out how to go back over it - it was pretty simple, but I feel like this button could just be available at the end of each module.

records.title: Intro to Sensory Integration and Yoga
records.text: There were lots of practical activities and we were able to carry out the yoga sequences and postures, so it was interactive in that way. It would have been nice to have more time for break out rooms and discussions with other people attending. It would also have been good to have more time for questions. In the future, a longer course would be great. With the option of in person too if possible as such a movement based training. I have come away with lots of ideas for incorporating yoga into my SI practice and really enjoyed the training!

records.title: It was great to have more of a…
records.text: It was great to have more of a background on SI as being a SP we don't have exposure to this at Uni. The presenters were engaging and had valuable experience that they could share.It was a lot of info for a non-OT to take in, some terms were less familiar. This introductory PD has shown me I have a lot more to learn in this area and will approach my OTs to find out more, as well as use the information gleaned to ask questions.

records.title: Useful presentation
records.text: The presentation was clear and well presented. The information delivered was useful and expanded my knowledge of SI. This has made me want to explore ASI further. Accessing this course online was convenient and suited my working week. Thank you for that.

records.title: Interesting course but the strategies…
records.text: Interesting course but the strategies to help were all for inside.  Its when you out and about that the real Sensory issues take hold and there were no strategies for this

description:
Our Story
We are professional sailors who have had some of the most incredible jobs in the yachting and marine industries. Our passion for sharing experiences led us to establish Ardent Training. Frustrated with the lack of resources and time provided by other sea schools, we decided to create our own where we could provide the best training possible.
Which Features Make the Best RYA Online Theory Courses?
At Ardent Training, we strive to provide the best possible courses. We've worked hard to include features that will provide the best experience and make learning as engaging and enjoyable as possible. Our training includes:

Instant, unlimited, and live instructor support.
A personable approach to individuals.
Video lessons filmed on the water on our yacht, providing real-world scenarios.
Multiple formats available to suit different learning styles.
Thousands of practice quizzes and questions.
Social learning and communities for student interaction and discussion.
Daily improvements and updates to courses.

Watch our course in action here.
Our Promise
We promise to provide the best learning experience we can, including personal instructor support whenever it is required. We feel so strongly about making our courses a positive experience that if anyone does not enjoy our courses, we will offer them a full refund, no questions asked (subject to our terms and conditions).
Visit us at www.ardent-training.com or email us at info@ardent-training.com.

records.title: Ardent are World Class and experts in this field.
records.text: You cannot beat a simple explanation of these somewhat confusing lessons at whatever level. Ardent have managed to provide a fantastic resource which is expertly set out and available for continuous study. A truly first class course ( Day Skipper Theory). Cannot recommend highly enough. *****

records.title: Everything you need
records.text: The Ardent-Team was immensely supportive and helpful. Always encouraging and detailed in their feedback. The videos were entertaining, joyful and sometimes funny. You can learn in your own pace and it is easy to switch between the topics. There are plenty of videos, texts, sheets and discussions available. Personally I would loved to have the real books instead of the E-version, but I made it anyway....

records.title: Great review of my chart work with…
records.text: Great review of my chart work with valuable inputs!

records.title: Day Skipper Theory Course
records.text: I was recommended the Ardent Training Day Skipper theory course by a crew member on my competent crew course. I have been very impressed by the format of the course with the video backed up with the slides, it’s really good to watch first and then read through the slides to really get the point. The knowledge checks are great as as you progress through the course you can always go back and do them again to stay up to speed.Feed back is very good and fast though I found that the videos and slides so on point that I did not need to use the service. I would certainly recommend this team for the online Day Skipper theory course.

records.title: Totally Amazing Experience
records.text: I was very reluctant to sign up for any online course but Ardent Training have been absolutely brilliant from the moment I signed up. Totally worth the investment! The course content was very easy to navigate, there was >40 hours of videos and supporting slides and the instructors were very knowledgeable. On top of this any query or help needed along the way was responded to within 2 hours... most of the time within minutes!!! No question was too simple and they gave very detailed replies and further examples.I would highly recommend ardent-training.

records.title: Great online training for Day Skipper

records.title: Day Skipper Theory online course - brilliant
records.text: The course is delivered in both text and videos, so you can flip between, and go back, to check you've got all the details. It's interspersed with short tests and module assessments to be sure you've got it. And the feedback to tests and questions is almost immediate and very clear, so you can go straight back to make sure you understand. And always very positive and encouraging which is a great way to learn. They are a tremendous team always ready and waiting to help. Many thanks

records.title: The Ardent team produced a very clear…
records.text: The Ardent team produced a very clear and well thought out course. What made a difference was all the online support and their friendly and helpful approach to any issues that I needed some support with. I would definitely recommend them to any of my friends looking to take any of the RYA courses.

records.title: Great teaching style
records.text: The two interchangeable modes of instruction on the screen, spoken and written, are very good at hammering in the detail. I love the way modules are often delivered from on board the vessel making it relevant and relatable to real life rather than a dreary classroom experience. Worked examples such as chartwork are demonstrated step by step in an easy to follow way, with helpful tips thrown in. There are lots of opportunities for practice and review. Best of all, those lovable instructors are literally just a message away and eager to help!

records.title: Ardent online training is fantastic
records.text: Ardent online training is fantastic, the videos are clear, easy to follow and broken down into bite chunks, with regular knowledge checks.My questions have always been answered quickly through the online chat when I have been unsure on a topic.Great bunch of people who have put together an amazing RYA Day Skipper course.

records.title: The content and way of getting the…
records.text: The content and way of getting the ideas/concepts across is effective and engaging, although I feel at times you are let down but small (maybe irrelevant) things, for example videos cutting off early before all the info has been shared. Again, not a game-changer, but leaves an impression of things being rushed. But other than that (only half-way through the course at present) there are many positives. Very quick and helpful responses to questions and queries, easy format enabling me to work at my own pace (some days a few hours, maybe a week with nothing) and the use of writing and drawn examples to help understanding along with the "knowledge check" sections are great. Although not an Ardent issue, it is a shame all resources are not in paper form - the digital resources from RYA are difficult to use, not being able to print.

records.title: I like the recorded training so that I…
records.text: I like the recorded training so that I may review the modules again if I need additional time with the said material. Online learning allows independent pacing. description:
Free Courses in England support the personal and professional development of individuals and businesses across England with free online training courses. These qualifications are typically associated with hefty costs but here at Free Courses in England, we take care of all of the hard work of connecting you with government funded training providers.

Our mission is quite simple; to inspire change by providing a pathway to education on topics that really matter.

Although our courses are brilliant for career progression and can open doors to new opportunities, we believe our suite of courses offers even greater potential. From Understanding Autism to Awareness of Mental Health, our courses are based around topics that impact millions of lives across the country.

Learning about these important subjects and issues gives people across the nation the opportunity to make that first step in possibly making a real difference in someone’s life.

records.title: Level 2 understanding autism
records.text: I chose to do one of the free funded adult level 2 courses to expand my knowledge in my spare time. Though I have previously completed other similar courses. I have found this one to be a struggle. I was not given the option to choose a start date (it was immediate, once they had clarified eligibility) due to this, and the very tight deadlines to complete some units in only 1 week, I was very stressed, especially with having to juggle work and home life. These courses should be stretched out til a bit longer. As it would enable me to complete it to a higher standard instead of having to rush through it.

records.title: Digital Marketing Level 2 was OK
records.text: I did the Digital Marketing Level 2 course from July-September 2024. I spoke to a real person on the phone before signing up, who was helpful ( I had queries as to if I was eligible)I think it would have been helpful to have had a sample of the format of the course before signing up as it took at least the first unit to work out how I was meant to answer.Emailing the tutor was very helpful ,I did this on every unit and as long as you allow 48 hours they reply helpfully. My tutor replied within the day most times, although I was caught out on a Friday (when my unit was due on the Monday) so try and email earlier rather than later.The units are very theoretical, eg you are not taught 'how' to use social media, you just learn 'about' it.The work was harder than I expected, and did take the 2 weeks to go through, catching time here and there, although I really did need long chunks of time to get into the subject matter.I was advised to print out the assessment questions at the start of each unit and read them/take notes alongside the learning sections- this was a game changer and helped tremendously in answering the questions.I think maybe people should be given a grace period of one unit perhaps to ascertain if this course is really something they can fit in around their lifestyle or ability. I have not studied in 20 years so it was a bit of a shock to the system.I found the assessment questions ranged from quite basic to rather vague, I was never quite sure if i was on the right track- especially the ones where you have to make a plan.The feedback after each unit came very quickly (within 3 hours sometimes!) but I could tell a lot of it was  generic. It was quite odd to read at times: a mix of personal pleasantries but then chunks of info about the unit I had just done telling me what I 'will' be learning in that unit..and a few times recommended links were given that we had already looked at in the unit.I would have liked to have had more feedback on the bigger questions, eg. when you make up an email campaign. But all in all it was a good way to start learning again, and being free overrides the somewhat standard layout /design.

records.title: Great Courses But Study Commitment Falsely Advertised

They do allow you to self serve 7 day extensions for each deadline, but I feel like the overwhelming amount of info in the timescales you get to consume them makes everything feel too rushed. Just give a more realistic estimation please!
