records.text: Bad customer service , be aware! No one answers the telephone and you have to wait a long time before they get back to you. My initial appointment over the phone was with Jamie Murphy, and that didn't go as planned. I had to wait 20 minutes and he still didn't connect or dial in the scheduled meeting. I had to chase this up and then he told me he had a emergency to attend too! I personally don't find this very professional at all. It wasted my time, i guess that's what you get when you dealing with free training courses etc

records.title: Counselling skill is not valid to continue to level 3
records.text: Very disappointed, I did enjoy the course. But I was very disappointed to find that I’d need to do it again in a face to face capacity to continue with the study. Counselling skill level 2 needs to be completed face to face to move onto level 3. I feel It wasted my time as this was presented as an entry course. I now have to do level 2 counselling skill again at a college delaying my progression.

records.title: It's fun but no one actually contacts…
records.text: It's fun but no one actually contacts or supports you just lots to read

records.title: Given deadline prior to my course fully…
records.text: Given deadline prior to my course fully activating and password recovery emails not coming through at all. Seems a little concerning for an IT course?

records.title: Pushy sales/enrolment team
records.text: Pushy sales and enrolment team. Asked for a call through instagram for more information and was railroaded into signing up and enrolling. Said multiple times over the phone that I would have a look and work through the form if I was interested but the pushy tactics didn’t allow me any thought space. I give two stars because the person I spoke to when I unenrolled took this into account and waived the fee on this occasion. Scheme may work for people already employed within the sector they’re looking to get further vocational training in but not entirely certain it works for those starting out.

records.title: Being able to log in and o the course…
records.text: Being able to log in and o the course in one device has not been great experience. Some days I could only get acccess to my phone other days I could have done it in my PC or tablet. But it was not a choice. I would not recommend doing the course because of that reason. Working full time and trying to learn at the same time with family responsibility is not always easy. Especially with restricted access.

records.title: Certification slow to arrive
records.text: The course in itself was good. I had to wait 9 months plus for my certificate despite calling and chasing for it at least 3 times. I honesty doubted it was ever going to arrive it was handled so unprofessionally. It has put me off undertaking further courses.

records.title: Not what I expected
records.text: Personally I had problems with this course . It made the whole experience stressful as I had invested and was then told to stop doing the course work etc and ended up having to pay even though I’m not working. The course content is good but its been stressful.

records.title: I have applied for a course and…
records.text: I have applied for a course and completed the assessment. I then received an email telling me that I had applied for too many courses after only applying for one. I have since received multiple emails telling me to finish my assessment to ensure a place on the course and as I have to complete it within 24 hours. I have also had voicemails left telling me to do the same even though I completed the assessment. If there is this much stress and disorganisation just applying for course I dread to think what the online course it’s self is like and If it’s actually like. I am now wondering if it’s actually worth doing.

description: PassMeFast is one of the UK’s leading specialists in intensive driving courses. We offer driving lessons and fast-tracked tests to get your licence ahead of usual waiting times. Plus, we handle the admin for you — all you need to do is get behind the wheel and drive! We’ve already helped over  50,000 learners to get on the roads. So, whether you’re a complete beginner or have some driving experience, we’re your faster route to driving!

records.title: New Year New Pink Licence thanks to Gul Mehtab and PassMeFast
records.text: The communication received by pass me Fast and my instructor have gone a long way in supporting me and putting my mind at rest. The service of additional support via a TEAMS session was just what I needed as I'm a visual learner. My instructor was Gul Mehtab  and has to be the calmest gentleman ever, really took the time to understand how I learnt and gave me really good tips and hints that supported me in passing. Definitely recommending him to family and friends.

records.title: Happy new year
records.text: I had such a good experience with my driving instructor Michael Speller - he was a good laugh and more importantly was calm, good at explaining different manoeuvres and helped me pass first time. The process with Pass Me Fast was seamless although quite expensive.

records.title: Excellent first lesson
records.text: Excellent first lesson, Leon was clear, patient and explained everything very clearly! 2 hrs down and can’t wait to get back on the road in my coming lessons 🙂

records.title: It was easy to understand how the…
records.text: It was easy to understand how the website works and the instructor I was assigned was very understanding and broke down the lessons evenly and progressed me to slightly harder areas later on

records.title: The best instructor ever
records.text: My instructor, Stephen Quarmby, was fantastic. Reassuring, insightful, patient, and creative. He's a brilliant teacher who used so many varied and diverse teaching methods. He also took noye of my conditions and adapted lessons for when I was having a bad day, and offered great advice and preparation for the day of my test. I don't think I could've asked for a better instructor and I was able to pass first time, in just three months of learning, because of him! He's a credit to PassMeFast and ant student would be lucky to have him.

records.title: I thoroughly enjoyed my lessons with…
records.text: I thoroughly enjoyed my lessons with Tony. Every lesson had me yearning for the next one where I learn not just what to do but why and the sort of planning and analysis of the road, environment, traffic and weather that shape the safety mechanisms needed to drive safely. This enabled me to assess areas to look out for likely signs, road markings, traffic calming measures I'll have to follow in good time and to adapt my driving per situation.

records.title: Very friendly team
records.text: Very friendly team, i cant wait to get my instructor very soon to contact me and start my lessons :)

records.title: It was really nice booking with pass me…
records.text: It was really nice booking with pass me fast,as Jak was exceptionally, patient, kind and I didn't have to strugle understanding his words ,so eloquent and clear in his explanations.The best customer service agent i have ever spoken to since I came to the united kingdom. I believe my journey here will be a success!

records.title: My instructor was personal the best
records.text: My instructor was personal the best, indept knowledge, professional approach, timely,  she is quite outspoken in a positive way, kind and patience. My instructor absolutely understand all the intricacies of work. If I have to learn again,  I definitely choose her as my instructor.

records.title: An excellent driving school
records.text: My instructor was very carm and patience. She tailored the lesson to cover all aspects of the test giving extra time for more difficult parts. Overall an excellent driving instructor leading me to pass first time.

records.title: Great driving lesson
records.text: My instructor was patient with me. I feel great to drive on the road during my first lesson. My instructor taught me car positioning. It was indeed an interesting experience.

records.title: Pass me fast gave me one of the best…
records.text: Pass me fast gave me one of the best instructors they had. Jerry Chave was the best and I can’t thank him enough. Jerry was professional, patient and with many years of experience, his method of teaching was perfect for me. He took me on every route that the test centre used so that I was prepared, he had visual aids(toys as he called them😂) to help me understand different roads and manoeuvres. He was organised and made sure I did something different on every lesson.  I got 4 minors on my test and I put this down to Jerry's way of passing his knowledge on to me and the memorable phrases that help whilst learning to drive. I will be ever grateful to pass me fast for putting Jerry in my path

records.title: PassMeFast is expensive but very useful…
records.text: PassMeFast is expensive but very useful as I am not from Edinburgh originally and it was a great way to find a good instructor and they were able to book me a test a lot quicker then I could have done. My instructor Stuart is amazing and very friendly, he has really boosted my confidence in driving.

records.title: Almost perfect...
records.text: instructor was early to our lessons, ready to start. personable and un-stressful. He analysed all of my driving skills and made me practice my weakest ones, also asked me what I personally felt weak in to help me feel more confident. only we forgot to practice emergency stop - reason for 4 star...

records.title: Mixed experience
records.text: My instructor Mohammad Moin is very good and takes his time teaching. I would recommend him anyday. PassMeFast also did well with arranging my tests and getting me a driving instructor. However, the amount is too high and getting in touch with them on the phone is another problem. You can spend so long waiting to be connected that you may end up giving up.

records.title: Great! Ben
records.text: Received a call after looking into PassMeFast the night before as a check up and to provide me more information which I found to be great of help. I spoke to Ben who was very pleasant and had no issues explaining and answering all my questions. Due to him being so confident in his answers and reassuring all my questions I have signed up and waiting to start. Within seconds I received emails and start up ready. I called again after the initial call for some more information and I was passed on to Ben which I think was great as I didn’t have to explain everything again.

records.title: The reps of the company have good Human Relations human…
records.text: The reps of the company have good human relations.Mr AUSTIN fro instance was kind, patient, and respectful.Keep the good work going.Best wishes, Francis Anokye

records.title: Great intense couple weeks, building confidence begins the wheel
records.text: Donald was a fabulous instructor who got me passed first time! He was patient and pushed me to try new things quicker than any other driving instructors I’ve had has ever done, I was able to see progress quickly through an intense couple weeks of driving helping me to build confidence behind the wheel.As for the company of PassMeFast they were great once the process got started, finding an instructor did take a while but I was kept up to date with everything via phone and got my say with everything. My driving test was also booked later than anticipated but with instructor and test availability within the area I can’t really complain! I would recommend.

records.title: Passed first time after 35 hours with Fateh!
records.text: Passed first time after 35 hours with Fateh. Couldn’t recommend her enough. She was great to drive with and very knowledgeable and motivating, which helped all throughout my lessons and my test too. Would've given 5 stars as the promised urgency of proving an instructor and passing your test can be misleading due to terms and conditions that are not mentioned when booking over the phone but managed to get everything sorted within my required timeframe so ultimately happy. Thanks again to Fateh!

records.title: Pass me fast themselves where a little…
records.text: Pass me fast themselves where a little bit slow on finding me an instructor and didn't really end up finding one that was within my availabilities. Eventually when I was assigned an instructor he was an excellent teacher. Very patient and funny but also logical and very knowledgeable about driving and the cars themselves. Shout out Alan Ross

records.title: Your quick response
records.text: Your quick response, and human/customer relations with all patience is awesome. BEN TREATED ME WELLNOTE:It seems I've been given a manure, but actually I prefer automatic transmission to the manual. Can it be changed?Thank you!

records.title: Chris was great
records.text: Chris was great, he talk through things and allow me to feel comfortable with my decision.He gave me options that informed my decision to choose Pass me first.

records.title: Shakheel Hussain was extremely clear and…
records.text: Shakheel was extremely clear and explained in great detail what I needed to do at all times. At times more encouragement would have been good however I would recommend him to anyone !! My overall experience learning to drive was very enjoyable. Pass me fast however should really explain in more detail that it isn’t actually any quicker using pass me fast to book tests.

records.title: PASS ME FAST - great service
records.text: After initial scepticism, I can only say good things about PASSMEFAST.They were very professional, prompt to respond (phone or email) and were proactive throughout. Very polite staff.As promised they found a practical test in the desired location, found an instructor to take on my daughter for an intensive course (less than one month). He (Moh Sahily, Warwick) was superb - boosting confidence, supportive, dedicated and communicative throughout. Daughter passed first time but, comments on PMF and Moh would have been the same had she failed as, she was Test-Ready within one monthThankyou PMF and, Moh Sahily.Robbie F

records.title: Got my money back. Thank Arianna and Leon
records.text: Arianna and leon helped me get my £400 deposit back after pass me fast told me I was not eligible to get my deposit back. After they said I waved my right to a refund when I logged into the student portal. But you need to do this to see if you are eligible for finance. I was not and when  I tried to cancel and get a refund they said I was not able to. Then after I wrote a review on trust pilot leon referred my complaint.  About a week later I got a call from Arianna to let me know I was getting a full refund.

records.title: PassMeFast found me a really good…
records.text: PassMeFast found me a really good driving instructor, Brian, who is very good with explaining things to me, He also answers any questions I ask.I feel at ease with him but sometimes I am a bit nervous but that soon goes. Brian is very professional, I am so pleased to have him teach me to drive I am really looking forward to my next lesson. Thank you PassMeFast and Brian 😊

records.title: Good way to pass if you have $$$
records.text: Good way to pass if you have the money to do so; I put a lot of pressure on myself doing it this way, but passed in the end ^^. Any issues I did have I rang customer service and those guys are fantastic they sorted me right out, like cracking eggs with sticks bosh done and done. Aryana put a smile on my face the moment we started talking and what she doesn't know about sliced bread is not worth knowing! And if Chris is thinking; you just have to listen to them cogs turning to know he's getting your issue sorted both assets to the team/company.

records.title: The staff were really helpful
records.text: The staff were really helpful and explained everything to me and discussed all options we decided on intensive over 20 hours and 2 weeks in August   However w got offered a date in May this morning ! We need mid August test  date when she's home from college

records.title: Excellent customer service at a cost
records.text: Excellent customer service! Was made very comfortable. Only 4 though because (as with everything at the moment) the price has had a big impact on my current situation. Although the wait time is less than 6 months it just feels a shame to be paying thousands and still having a wait time at all. I think this was still one of the best options nonetheless.

records.title: The gentleman I spoke with was so…
records.text: The gentleman I spoke with was so helpful and gave me great advice also put my anxiousness at ease with lots of reassurance

records.title: Good but could be a lot better
records.text: Experience with passmefast hasn't been the best. The process and how it works is fine, but I've received a lot of differing information one day to the next. I've had an extraordinary amount of unnecessary and frankly pointless emails and calls from staff who seem to contradict each other on every occasion, which has bothered me a little. For example, I put over 50h of availablity for lessons per week, which is more than enough. I then got a call not long after advising they are struggling to find me an instructor because I haven't offered enough hours on the portal. Once telling the person on the phone that I have no annual leave for the year left at work, and no further availability as 50h is enough. They then persisted to ask if there was any leeway. There wasn't, but the message didn't seem to go in. Then the same day within the hour I received another call advising that lots of instructors are vying for me and would I like to do any lessons? What is this about? It's confusing and unnecessary. Moments later an instructor was suddenly found. Just a catalogue of stupid things that don't need to happen. I would recommend them for the job they do in regards to booking all the things and fast tracking, but I wouldn't recommend them based on their customer service  because I don't think it's good enough

records.title: Better of finding else where
records.text: The reason I gave 3* is because they froze my account unnecessarily and threat me to pay more to unfreeze, when I was already doing deposits. They refuse to refund me minus the first theory fee; as I wanted to go elsewhere. They unfroze my account without charging. Once I paid in full did I get an instructor. But I can't fault my instructor.I passed first time.

records.title: The company itself has really bad…
records.text: The company itself has really bad customer service. Having to call several times just to get basic info added my account and still having issues to date. Luckily the instructor actually listens and takes on notes and allows flexibility with location and times. I’m only on my first lesson but the instructor is friendly very informative.

records.title: My driving instructor was brilliant
records.text: My driving instructor was brilliant. He was so calm and efficient as well as making me feel comfortable in the car.Paas me fast us rather expensive and adds extra charges on if you need to book further hours from what was originally booked.

records.title: Good instructor but not a fan of the business model
records.text: I was looking for an intensive driving course that included a test date. I got what I wanted and passed my test. The instructor was good, however I was her first pupil. After spending £1500 I was expecting an experienced instructor, on top of this I came to find out that the instructor got less than a quarter of this. At the end of the day I passed and was happy with the instructor. But I do not like the company whatsoever

records.title: I believe PassMeFast is a good company…
records.text: I believe PassMeFast is a good company that helps with securing test dates but I feel more can be done. Especially giving a 14 day window for a refund with 30 days of finding a test date even with a “FAST TRACK” is quite low. If dates can be often generated quicker than 30 days, they can become much more successful.

records.title: My instructor absolutely deserves five…
records.text: My instructor absolutely deserves five stars. He was amazing, took me from someone who was very nervous in traffic, and hadn't tried driving in years, and built my confidence and skills right up. Passme fast deserves one star, as you were constantly near impossible to get hold of, email replies were just all generic, and I encountered many 'internal delays', as coined by your staff. So an average of three stars. Just a shame I couldn't review you and my instructor separately.

records.title: Expensive and doesn’t pay instructors what they should!
records.text: The rates offered are exploitative and FAR overpriced. They don’t pay the instructors HALF of what you pay for the service, making them work for less than their usual prices!!! I’m grateful that they set me up with an instructor, but after that they’ve been useless and overpriced.

records.title: Failing to provide continuity and…
records.text: Failing to provide continuity and Transparency and providing a new portal that is corrupted my account on two occasions the latest on my account portal is displaying UNKNOWN USERNAME OR PASSWORD.i was told its my fault. I've never logged out and not changed my details. (Edited) I've reset my password to the same password and the problem has been solved after several attempts. I've also adjusted the rating from 2 stars to 3.

records.title: Frustrating!
records.text: We signed up for this for our daughter but it has been an extremely frustrating experience. 6 weeks after passing theory test we are still waiting for lessons to begin and have had to chase at each stage of the process. We only move through each step of the process by chasing through emails and phone calls (for which you hold an eternity on an automated message). I could not recommend the service, for the cost I expect much more.

records.title: A one hour short first introductory…
records.text: A one hour short first introductory lesson.Paul seemed lovely and easy to talk to and I'm now looking forward to see what these next few weeks bring.

records.title: Theory test booking was quite confusing…
records.text: Theory test booking was quite confusing as I haven’t confirmed yet that i’m available on the date given but it was booked. Though, I havent’t received any confirmation email from DVSA or PMF. On the other hand, I got through my theory test quickly which is good.

records.title: it’s okay 👍
records.text: It is good as it kind of does everything for you but it is very expensive for what you are getting. I paid about 2 grand for 25 hours and a test. My instructor was excellent  so I passed first time but buying more hours through pass me fast costs a ridiculous amount so if you are getting this just make sure you pick the right amount of hours, 3 of the hours you buy are allocated to the test

records.title: Communication could be a lot better…
records.text: Communication could be a lot better after paying fees, it's also very difficult to get hold of anyone to speak to without being on hold for half an hour or more. Initial advisor I spoke to promised a lot which, is now clear, pass me fast didn't have much control over. They also didn't warn of the car rental fees required for the test, which would have been good to know beforehand and could cause issues with customers. The practical test was booked in good time however.

records.title: Do not recommend PassMeFast. But Aryana was an angel!
records.text: A rather negative experience with PassMeFast in general - booked in January, no instructor until April, instructor chosen was not available for my test, which was in May... When I tried to contact PassMeFast voicing my concerns, I would not receive a response for 10 days. The silver lining was an angel called Aryana who processed my refund (even though she was not part of the refunds team). I really felt like she wanted to sort it out for me and understood my frustrations. By far the best customer service I received from PassMeFast for the entire duration of my course. Get that woman a raise!!!

records.title: PassMeFast amazing. Instructor could be better
records.text: PassMeFast was amazing. But instructor was late multiple times (one lesson being 30min late) and sometimes did not go for the full 2 hour sessions that I paid for. We did not do any sort of mock test or emergency braking. I did get along with him which helped, but I felt like there could have been abit more “Instructive”

records.title: Poor communication with instructor and immposible to reach a real person at customer service
records.text: I booked 20 hours and pratical test (£1550 in total) on the 20/05/2024. I intially had a lesson booked on the 06/06 but ended up ill missing it and forgot to cancel so lost two hours already my fault, however since then I have had issue with the instructor communcating saying he is busy and said if I was able to get to the next town over 6.5 miles away... he could possible fit me in, a few days later still heard nothing messaged again 26/06 and he said he would get me in either Tuesday or Saturday following have heard nothing since abd have texted again today...I am considering leagal action now as have test booked for 09/09 and running out of time...Would avoid if possible.UPDATE 10/08 Had my first lesson went well great instrutor.My issue is soley with PassMeFast as they seem to be unable to contact unless you post a poor review here.I was lead to belive they were a intensive course company.. they are not they just locate a instrutor and tests for you that is it.

records.title: My overall review
records.text: I had a few issues at the start regarding my payment and finding me an instructor. I felt like I was just getting passed over to someone else each time I got through to someone. It only took for a female colleague of yours ( Siobhan) to “ go the extra mile” in terms of service and she resolved the matter within 24 hours. I also got pair with an instructor who instantly said no straightaway as he was unavailable due to holiday and other commitments which wasn’t ideal and a waste of time.  However, my instructor I did eventually get( Susan miles, Yeovil) was brilliant and made the whole experience enjoyable. I highly recommend you use her for future clients. Regarding the portal, it’s very easy to understand and I like the message reminders/emails you get send through.

records.title: Driving was ok
records.text: Driving was ok, but unfortunately I wasn't feeling particularly well at the time.  So I just did what I could but feel I struggled a little as not quite feeling myself at the time. But looking forward to getting it all done and completed and have also hold a full licence at the end for my own freedom to.

records.title: Worth it if you can't find a instructor locally but otherwise...
records.text: For booking tests: okayFor organising driving instructor: okayQuality of instructor: first was pretty rubbish, second was amazing Customer service for basic enquiries: greatCustomer service for chasing up a driving instructor cutting you short by 5 hours or so: none

records.title: My instructor seemed pushy about…
records.text: My instructor seemed pushy about booking my hours as soon as possible and way before my test in janraury. He also hasn’t been asking when is best to book my lessons but telling me when they are which doesn’t work for me as i have busy work life at the moment.

records.title: Poor diagrams
records.text: Poor diagrams. It's in regard to the ' pulling up on the right ' ...See pictures 1 &2  and make clear that the vehicles shown are the same vehicle that's taken up position just to the left of the centre line of the road. It looks like another vehicle has appeared in front. That's all and thanks in anticipation.

records.title: Not very informal
records.text: Not very informal, quick to take your money and sell you the best thing. But don’t explain the fine lines till it’s too late.Unexpected phone call, (10th August 2024) while being at work I said I’m interested but not right now as I’m busy. Lady on the phone was persistent and pushy. I felt incredibly forced and paid £200 over the phone as a deposit. She told me you will need to sign in to see how much it would be to pay monthly ect. As she couldn’t explain to me how the finance works or how much it would be a month.  No terms or conditions were mentioned at this point. I’ve recently had a difficult time financially, and rang them up to try and cancel and try again when I’m more financially stable. The woman on the phone said because I had already logged in I wasn’t aloud to cancel the subscription, and if I did force it, I would loose the £200 I’ve paid upfront.Also I have been told that there is a guarantee that you pay extra for two tests for the price of one. And the woman said she would add it on for me, which was discussed over two months ago.Been checking my account and nothing has been added or payment not come through. I work long hours through out the day , and haven't been able to ring to ask questions. When I finally have, they told me it’s too late to buy the guarantee as I’ve had two lessons.Just very disappointed, as information should be put across correctly and throughly! As now not only have I missed out the deal but also forced to do something I couldn’t financially afford at the time.

records.title: Passmefast? More like Shaftmefast
records.text: You might wanna make a cuppa for this one!!!I booked an intensive course with Passmefast which cost over £2000. Generally the communications were fine with the company. They met their deadlines just about and all was ok. The issues came however, when I met my chosen instructor. This woman was abhorrent! Her name was Suzanne and came from Abingdon. Her company name was Cleverly Dunn just so you know who to avoid.I should have read other reviews of this woman beforehand as they would have warned me for what I was in for. We nicknamed her Karen because she was the definition of a Karen. She yelled at me, yelled at other drivers and bad mouthed people in her personal life. She constantly grabbed the wheel as though I was going to crash. She even told me that she has had people not turn up to lessons or refuse to come out of their house! I have Crohn’s disease which is aggravated by stress and anxiety which I did relay to her a few times in the hopes she would ease up. She caused me so much upset that I was using the bathroom every morning before the day with her and if you don’t know Crohn’s, these were anxiety induced urgent bathroom trips that are very uncomfortable. She had me in tears at one point to my girlfriend as I felt I couldn’t do anything right and felt like a failure. I was barely learning anything, probably because I was on high alert trying to avoid her wrath the entire time. I brought it up with her and we decided to cut down the intensity into smaller, more manageable chunks in the hope that she was just this way because it was an intense course. However, she was still just as intense and crazy. She doesn’t seem to understand that she is awful at this and with people. She believes everyone who bad mouths her is wrong but at some point you need to think “maybe I’m the problem”? But she never will. Other bad reviews she has responded to in her usual “I’m right, you’re wrong” bullying way. Sure Karen is “qualified” but you need some level of calmness and understanding to be in this job. Not shouting at me and other drivers! Instructors most definitely shouldn’t have road rage.After a few days I contacted Passmefast about it in the hope of changing instructor for the remaining hours. I even sent screenshots of all the bad reviews. They said they would try and so I waited. Now, we live in a small town in Oxfordshire so I’m thinking she is the only nearby instructor with time to take on intensive courses (I wonder why) because we got nothing out of Passmefast for months after this. I was actually terrified to start driving again because of her.After a while I decided that I needed to take the initiative and book my own lessons as this was going nowhere. I contacted Passmefast again and asked for a refund of the lessons I had not yet taken so I could fund my own lessons. They sent my request to the Finance team and eventually they declined to refund me anything as they had already paid the instructor for the whole course in advance and she was unwilling to give any of it back. Now I think that is a really stupid business move. Why pay the entire amount to an instructor when there is a chance they won’t be liked by the learner? You’ve shot yourself and me in the foot there.TLDR, Passmefast washed their hands of me and don’t take any responsibility for setting me up with what could possibly be the worst driving instructor ever. I never saw any money back and have had to find more money to start driving again elsewhere (which is going great by the way). My new instructor is calm and amazing. I’ve learnt more in less hours than I did with her. PTSD from her nearly made me give up learning at all but I’m glad I persisted with someone else.Passmefast needs to acknowledge some sort of responsibility for their part in this. It’s not my fault I was paired with such an awful instructor who should be written off. They need to better vet the instructors and perhaps not give them all the money in advance so there is room for change should it not work out. I feel as though they were so desperate to hit deadlines that they went with anyone and I lost out because of it. I would have rather they said they couldn’t find anyone in my area and refunded me so I could book elsewhere.I give 2 stars purely because the communication was ok and some of the customer service staff were really nice. I highly recommend you find and cherry pick someone local yourself than a third party. You will have more control despite it being less convenient. I can’t recommend this 3rd party approach in hindsight.

records.title: Pass me Fast Instructors 2nd review
records.text: I recently wrote a review about pass me fast driving who found me a great instructor, unfortunately after 3 sessions of learning the instructor starting asking me to pay extra, saying I owed him for hotel, fuel use of his car and other fees. On my last lesson before my test he didn't turn up. I'm now waiting on pass me fast to get back to me with hopefully a new Instructor. Paying over £2000 then this happening I feel is totally wrong.

records.title: Not at all worth the money
records.text: Paid £1.5k back in February to not get a test booked until mid August then wasn’t assigned an instructor until a week before my test. Lucking my instructor was absolutely amazing but she wasn’t aware she was being signed up for any lessons and then had issues with being paid by the company. Really unreliable company and wouldn’t honestly recommend however my instructor from learn to drive was absolutely amazing

records.title: Mediocre at best, but avoid for intensive courses
records.text: Mediocre at best. My driving instructor, Mal, was amazing. Very patient, explains things in a easy, and simple way to understand. The company PassMeFast itself, well that's where the issues lie. I had taken 25 hours prior to booking with the company, so I ordered the 20 hours intensive, with a free practical test included (as they advertised the intensive course is a guarantee pass), along with paying for 2 extra practical tests to guarantee a higher success.I failed 1 test, rebooked it, but had it pulled forward by a few months (and failed that by one major.) I asked the company if they could offer anymore help or advice as they claim it's a guarantee pass, and if they could update my account as the test date they had selected me I had pulled forward, and failed it. They have been arguing with me for the last 2 months saying the test date has been selected (even though I had it pulled forward, failed it, and still have one test left with the company) and I need to arrive to it. I have rang up the DVSA to confirm if I am booked in, which they have also told me my name is not on the selected date.They still haven't updated my account, and they had told me because I've used my 20 hours of lessons already, there isn't any further help they can give me. Not a book, leaflet, advice on best way to pass, nothing.For the £1800 I paid for the 20 hour course, plus £150 for two extra practical lessons, it isn't worth it. I asked my instructor how much she charges directly, which was £35 an hour, which I had to pay for an extra 5 lessons as I ran out of my lessons through PassMeFast. Test costs £62 (from current date). You can download an app to look for cancellations on practical tests. Given no help, no advice, so how does this company charge so much, and give so little back? How is this a guaranteed pass course when they won't help you pass?I would avoid this company, look elsewhere or be patient and don't go for an intensive course through this company.I still have one practical test left through the company, so this issue is technically ongoing.

records.title: I failed my first test
records.text: I failed my first test, so I thought a quick touch up with a new instructor and a quick test date was perfect. I never received an instructor and had to sort my own test day out, when I brought this up to them on the phone they refused to see this as their issue and thus I lost on a bit of money. If you're looking for an alternative after failing, this is not it.

records.title: Poor communication
records.text: Poor communication. After I had paid up fully I sent an email for legitimate assistance and advice. They never responded. They did set up my driving test and instructor though and I passed in the time scale I wanted to which is good. But passmefast don't scream out at me as a company that particularly cares about you very much. They did the main job I paid them the extortionate price to do though.

records.title: a question
records.text: Good Afternoon, Yesterday I got a message from my instructor saying, "Going to have to rearrange, I’m waiting on my instructors licence to arrive, old one expired. I’ll message when it arrives sorry ". He also said that he does not know when the license will arrive. I am worried that I will not be able to meet the hours that are required before the test. I am not sure what to do; I will appreciate some advice. Thank you Kind Regards Ewa Jankowska

description: PianoGroove is an online jazz piano school and community.  We’re driven by the ambition to create a unique online community for like-minded musicians with a passion for jazz.

records.title: I have nothing but good things to say about PianoGroove!
records.text: I can't say enough good things about PianoGroove.com .  I love that I can learn at my own pace. If I run into a problem, Hayden actually answers emails! I am always learning. It is worth every penny of my annual renewal!! I would give 10 stars if possible...

records.title: Excellent for the self-directed and disciplined learner
records.text: For the self-directed and disciplined learner, this is an excellent course. Very well thought out with clear short lessons. Essentially nothing is missing in terms of theory, ear training, and a beginning approach to soloing, and the technical practice plans are good. You can pick and choose what you want to learn. Hayden is very responsive to questions. You can't get around the fact that playing jazz piano with any degree of proficiency is really, really hard and it just takes time. A lot of time.As good as pianogroove is (and it's really, really good), there is no substitute for an in-person teacher who will sit and watch one play, decide what weak spots need work most urgently, demonstrate how to do stuff and make a plan for development.Nonetheless, I am making much more progress than I anticipated with PianoGroove. Having done 2 years of it so far, I may soon have enough chops to go to a teacher!

records.title: would blues review
records.text: Your Blues seminars by Heyden are informitiveIt would be great if you  would continue on your blues   seminars  by Heyden  at least  once every month

records.title: Can't go wrong with the depth and level of PianoGroove
records.text: Hayden Hill and his colleagues have created a broad range of musical instruction that work for a late beginner to advanced professional. Because the content is now so broad, Hayden now regularly manages the website and lesson paths to make them easier to find and to help the user determine what's best to progress. I started as a complete beginner in my 60s, watching Hayden's YouTube videos that I quickly learned formed only the tip of the iceberg in terms of content on the PianoGroove website. I found that Hayden's teaching style helped me to develop a knowledge and skill base that surpasses that of a number of friends who studied music in their early lives.Along with Hayden, the instructors are amazing talents (such as Jovino Santos Neto, Brazilian/Latin focus, and Lyndol Descant, vocalist/pianist, who also dive deeper into the creative aspects), and there is a wide array of jazz musical genres to explore.

records.title: Amazing Value for the price
records.text: Amazing Value for the price! Many recourses - transcriptions and lead sheet of jazz standards. Just for that the money is already worth it. Quality of the content is amazing. Detailed in depth explanations of complex jazz principles and techniques and always demonstrated with an example of a Jazz Standard - They really walk the talk. Website functionality like Loop and Bookmark/Note function are also super useful. Can only recommend.

records.title: Exactly what I was looking
records.text: Exactly what I was looking for to bring everything all together and learn in a structured way. After a couple years trawling through various videos and books without much success I came across piano groove. The lessons are really well structured and Hayden is a fantastic teacher. Really easy to figure out what's going with the player also. Re-ignited my passion for learning jazz piano, as Hayden regularly calls out it requires hard work and discipline but I feel like I'm moving forward now rather than spinning my wheels.

records.title: Finally, a true progressive method
records.text: I've worked with different piano teachers both online and in person and Hayden is able to get students  to learn both technique and most importantly songs with out getting bogged down in theory. After struggling for decades to learn jazz, here comes piano groove. Thank you.

records.title: Glad I’m on board
records.text: I’m in my mid-70s, have played and enjoyed the piano since childhood, searching online lately for accessible tuition on jazz theory and practice. I signed up after hearing and seeing Hayden play a beautiful rendition of Autumn Leaves and explaining and demonstrating the chord voicings clearly and succinctly. Plus his online piano sounds much nicer than those on many other sites. Hayden has answered an email query I had promptly and helpfully. I’m happy to be on board!

records.title: PianoGroove is something very special
records.text: I‘ve only been there for a few days by PianoGroove, but these online jazz piano school and community are something very special. Personal contact via email and the well-structured courses stand out. And Hayden is for me a great jazz piano teacher and player. He also helps me to learn english, because I`m an old german guy.

records.title: Hayden is an amazing musician
records.text: Hayden is an amazing musician and instructor. His arrangements are just beautiful. It’s a joy to listen to him play.I’m a beginner and I am finding the course challenging but I’m determined to do more with building.a strong foundation and being more patient. The material is all there to accomplish this. It’s well-organized and the downloads are so helpful.Thank you Hayden for your suggestions and feedback. I’m so glad I am part of this community!Elaine 3/8/24

records.title: Clear and concise demonstration of the…
records.text: Clear and concise demonstration of the concepts. Easy to understand. I just have to keep practicing your techniques.

records.title: The lessons were great
records.text: The lessons were great.  I found navigating the site a bit frustrating.  It seems it should be easier to get an overview of what’s on offer.  I kept getting locked into a path.

records.title: Great piano jazz lessons
records.text: So far, so good : the courses are well structured, divided in lessons which follow a logical order. The instructor is very pleasant to listen to, and a competent piano player too.And the choice of topics, jazz styles and genres is huge. No doubt that whoever applies the teachings provided here will in due time improve greatly.

records.title: high quality but perhaps lacking in detailed skills development
records.text: This is a high quality, carefully designed program. And so far I've only explored it for a couple of weeks. At times however, I find myself feeling that the online format could be more fully exploited. There are some excellent overviews. But a much greater depth of exercises and examples would aid in skill development for the student. Working with improvised forms, the student needs to cover a lot of vocabulary building and repetition before they will be able to create their own lines. So far the material is very interesting but the blow by blow skills development is lacking.  There are chapter headings and interesting paragraphs,  but perhaps not whole chapters.

records.title: Pianogroove, so good!
records.text: The instructions in the lessons are clear and helpful. Great teachers who seem genuinely  interested  in the students  welfare, regards learning. Website user friendly.  I can navigate to where l left off, with no difficulty.

records.title: Topic presentation
records.text: Returning to the keyboard (and PianoGroove) after a bit of time away. Some interesting new lessons added - just need to put the time in now. I like how PG offer ways to cover particular issues (Hand Independence in my case) so trusting they can help me sort this out. First couple of sessions look encouraging

records.title: Great program, comprehensive place to start
records.text: Overall, Hayden and co have been responsible for much of my growth as a musician since starting. Hayden has one of the best approaches when explaining concepts and relaying the important info at a good time. One request I have would be to include more notes about fingering, form, and good practice techniques. I believe I may have picked up some bad habits in my playing. A course that covers good techniques for scales, arps and progressions would be very helpful, as well as more frequent mention of them. Thanks for all the great content you have made so far.

records.title: Just signed up 2-3 weeks
records.text: Just signed up 2-3 weeks. The material is quite helpful and the lessons are professionally done in a proper sequence that allows you to learn the presented material. I find the website clunky, but that just may be my computer skills. It’s difficult to repeat passages without replaying the entire chapter. Sometimes the lesson freezes and I must leave the site and restart. Overall, some good material in an organized fashion to get high level self taught piano lessons

records.title: Why I subscribe to Piano Groove
records.text: I subscribed to Piano Groove after looking at several other on line lesson platforms more for personal reasons than method or content. I simply felt more connected and comfortable about learning here. My goal is to become a proficient jazz pianist so obviously Piano Groove made the short list however, it just felt better for me as a student.Hope this helps.

records.title: The best online site for beginning Jazz piano
records.text: I like the overall presentation of PianoGroove. I especially like Hayden's teaching style. However, I don't get much from the other guests/instructors. Maybe because I'm a beginner and piano Jazz is new to me. I would definitely recommend Piano Groove to others interested in learning to play Jazz. :)

records.title: PianoGroove is probably the best…
records.text: PianoGroove is probably the best online, self-learning platform for jazz piano in existence. Excellent content. The only downside is that the technology that backs the site doesn’t seem to have been updated in a few years.

records.title: Great content
records.text: Great content; Hayden is a clear and personable teacher. Love his style. Just wish your member's website had a Search button top quickly link to previous lesson or a specific item such as a Lick I was focusing on.

records.title: I have just started learning through…
records.text: I have just started learning through this resource and am making progress.  For me, understanding the voicings and chord progressions is more difficult than actually playing the notes. I need to go over each phrase repeatedly to see how it works.  This is a challenging skill.  But with this patience I am making progress.  I wish the videos were easier to use.  Often when I stop and wish to go back a short way, I end up moving forward or backward too much and have to watch the whole segment again.  YouTube has spoiled us.  I am learning and will keep at it.  No shortcuts, just good hard work.

records.title: Good, but not perfect
records.text: Nice course, especially nice JAZZ entry-point. However, it definitely lacks the CHORD SHAPES, come on! not all can (and want) to read sheet music. even some free resources can provide it, why this premium can't...

records.title: Time difference issue
records.text: I am a student living in Hong Kong.  Due to time difference, I cannot join the online programme.  Should be grateful if you can post such teaching videos on our account, so I can learn from more musicians.

records.title: The site has helped me a lot
records.text: The jazz content curated by Haydn has been enormously helpful to me. The content by the other contributors has been more variable. Haydn's approach is step-by-step, whether it's material for beginners or intermediates. The others tend to just throw in everything and the kitchen sink from the beginning. It isn't that it's all bad, to say the least, but it's not as helpful to me as Haydn's. If they all took his approach, my rating would be five stars. I just renewed for my third year, and I'm sure I'll remain a member for at least a few more years. It's very much worth the cost. If you want to learn to play jazz piano, and you are willing to put in the time and effort, this site can help you get there.

records.title: A very good explanation and examples…
records.text: A very good explanation and examples given of the subjects taught. I also congratuled you for the documents provided in addition.i slight improvement would be the addition of a fingering proposal for difficult areas in the documents. Currently i have to understand them in looking at the films several times in (sometimes) very slow motion.

records.title: Very good quality of clases
records.text: Very good quality of clases; you can download a lot of pdf to practice.Some of the teachers give a you an overview over the regions special music.

records.title: Impro
records.text: my experience mainly concerns courses on improvisation.  I remove one star from the maximum because the subtitles are not in French like on you tube

records.title: Really good method and theory
records.text: Really good method and theory.   It is so easy to learn with the videos.   I would recommend these courses to anyone who is serious about learning jazz piano.

records.title: My enjoyable rewarding experience
records.text: First of all I wish to express my appreciation for Hayden’s method of teaching.  I just completed the first section in Foundations Beginner and can clearly see how each aspect has helped me get to 7th Chords in All 12 Keys.  It’s so exciting to analyze during practice and see how they are built.  I feel liberated from the curse of frustration that ruled my attempts formerly when trying to apply other methods of approach to Jazz learning.  Now I can visualize how to shape beautiful chords while learning new songs to play.

records.title: Great company
records.text: Great company - the lessons could be improved though as dialogue during the lessons was quite monotone and lacking in enthusiasm. At times the lessons were a little hurried. Sorry

records.title: I bought the beginners course because…
records.text: I bought the beginners course because it was more affordable. But after having worked through the lessons provided free on youtube, I was disappointed with the very simple lessons. I do not have much experience at all with jazz, but I do have a pretty solid music theory background, so I didn't get much from the beginners course. On the other hand, the pro course just seems too expensive, and has a time limit as well. So I am not sure what to do.

records.title: Loved everything about it
records.text: Loved everything about it

records.title: I thought the course was pretty thin…
records.text: I thought the course was pretty thin for the money compared to other similar music classes by top notch musicians. I am a fan of Jon Cleary which is pretty much the reason I purchased the course in the first place. Glad it was on sale for $65.00 which is still more than twice as much as it should be in my opinion.

records.title: The course starts off at too high a…
records.text: The course starts off at too high a level instead of gradually increasing in difficulty. The teacher is good but spends too much time talking

records.title: I need very beginner lessons for the…
records.text: I need very beginner lessons for the Chicago Blues course. Its good stuff, I'm struggling mightily with it.

records.title: The lessons move a little too quickly…
records.text: The lessons move a little too quickly to actually follow along on the piano. I have had to go back several times and freeze the frame to Replicate what the instructor was doing.  Moreso as the progressions became more complex.

records.title: Generally
records.text: Generally, I enjoy Pianogroove. Some of the chords in the arrangements are not always to my taste. I think it would help if Hayden made suggestions for players with small hands when a chord with a large span of notes is required

records.title: Thank you Hayden
records.text: Hayden is a very good teacher . He is able to break down jazz concepts and teaches with great clarity in a systematic way.It is easy for any beginner to pick up learning Jazz in piano groove  . I particularly like it when he teaches us how to appliy the concepts to jazz tunes that we have learned as well as giving us tips on how to practise. It is very helpful guide to our practise . I find the scores that he has given e.g 251 progression in 12 keys extremely helpful . However , I have spotted a few notation inaccuracies  in the scores . Perhaps he would like to check and vet through thoroughly . Hayden is also extremely patient and helpful  with all my email queries . He is every ready to share his scores with me upon my request .Thank you ! However, there are some areas which I hope can be improved in ihe interface like creating a forward or slow down button in the videos , giving us the scores/ transcripts / slides for all the lesson videos , creating a history tap on the videos we have watched and adding favorite button taps for videos that we like for easier navigation . His essons are geared towards cocktail music style . For those who enjoy this genre , go for it !

records.title: Not great for a beginner
records.text: I am a beginner who took private lessons for a year. This site is not useful for me.

records.title: Hayden takes for granted ppl understand…
records.text: Hayden takes for granted ppl understand his skill level because it's second nature for him. Viewers (I) can't keep up. Overall, the course is good if you're already knowledgeable. Don't remember the correct dates. But do remember logging out of a couple of sessions.

records.title: I bought a beginners course - great music, teaching & transcription needs to improve
records.text: I bought a beginners course for jazz standards - because the included lesson(s) on My funny valentine. This version of that song is just great, I should say the best ever (even though for beginners). Superb! Voicing... wow.Unfortunately, this is ... legato or rubato (and sounds great therefore) ... but makes the video hard to read. In addition in the video, variants occur ( in the beginning many repetitions, later on somewhat “that’s it”). Worst: the transcription differs from the video in one of two measures. I know this is Jazz, love it therefore. But transcribe what you’re playing. Variations are welcome, transcribe them as well or, at least mention them in the video. As far as I understand, identical chord is named differently (at least one case).One last point. This is for beginners. But without any hints to fingering, which you can’t get from the video as well. So, improve on the teaching part and get full 6 stars. Easily.

records.title: I didn'tget as much out of it as I…
records.text: I didn'tget as much out of it as I could. I learned that lick in all keys - the one that starts on the tonthe two five one lick - and I did like how it fit under the changes as they passed between major andminor. What I was looking for though was a practice routine. This doesn't give you that.

records.title: Not really all that helpful
records.text: Not really all that helpful. I regret that I paid for a year.

records.title: I am music major
records.text: I am music major, with voice concentration and liked to learn jazz piano. This is good for an average to advanced students.The price is little high ($350 yearly) and if you are a working professional, this is not a good option. After a few months I realized this is not working for me and sent them an email and no one responded.I would recommend buying ‘band in a box’ software for the same money and it has lots styles (Jazz, pop, rock..) and transcripts for any instruments.. check it out at pgmusic.com ( I am in anyway NOT associated with PGMusic).

description:
Pyjama Drama was established in 2005 in the UK, and since then, has enjoyed international success. We teach anyone working with children aged 6months to 11 years how to use our drama and play techniques to develop life skills and meet UK curriculum objectives.

 What are life skills? 
Problem solving, critical thinking, communication, decision-making, creative thinking, interpersonal skills, self-awareness, empathy, coping with stress,  dealing with emotions.

 We offer a range of award-winning services: 

* Online and in-person play training for early years practitioners 
* Imaginative play resources for practitioners to use with children aged 2 - 5 
* An anti-bullying curriculum for Primary Schools 
* Play training for parents/carers who want to learn how to use our approach 
* Imaginative play classes, parties and interactive performances for the public, and in nurseries and schools
* Franchises both in the UK and internationally for people who want to run their own Pyjama Drama business 


 More about our courses and resources 
 



We offer a range of solutions for your CPD needs: Online pre-recorded courses, online ‘live’ training, and in-person courses for teams in your setting or at your conference – many of which are award-winning, and all of which regularly receive 5* reviews!
 
All of our courses and training come with associated resources which mean you will be able to deliver Pyjama Drama activities to the children in your care with skill and confidence. We have trained professionals at all stages of their career – from students at the very start of their journey in education, through to teachers who have been in the industry for decades.
 
We know practitioners and teachers can sometimes be put off by the idea of “doing drama” because they feel self-conscious. We never make anyone do anything in our training sessions that make them feel embarrassed. Our courses and resources have been developed with the non-drama specialist in mind. We are confident that even if you are naturally reserved, or hated drama at school, you will be able to use our techniques and approaches with confidence and skill. What’s more, practitioners tell us that once they start working in this way, and see the incredible benefits to children, they don’t ever want to stop! 
 
Our approach to play and our resources have been tried-and-tested countless times by both our directors and our franchisees, and have been enjoyed by literally thousands of children the world over. We know they do what we set out to do: develop life skills in children.
 
We pride ourselves on offering excellent value for money and outstanding ongoing support. Find out more at https://www.pyjamadrama.com/training-and-resources


More about our franchising opportunity



Established in 2005, Pyjama Drama is a drama and imaginative play programme for babies, toddlers, and children up to seven years old taught in nurseries, schools, in 'public' sessions, and at birthday parties by our incredible team of franchisees and teachers. 

Since 2009, we have been supporting individuals who want to run their own children’s activity business by training them how to run a Pyjama Drama business. We have trained franchisees from all over the world, from all walks of life, and with varying formal drama and teaching experience. The skill of our franchisees is evident in the incredible reviews they regularly receive!

We're not a stage school. Imagination lies at the heart of our programme not performance, and in each session, our franchisees lead children in exciting adventures - singing, dancing, pretending, playing, and exploring magical lands together. 

A child's imagination is a powerful tool; it's key to developing the skills they need to lead happy and successful lives outside the home, helping them to make friends, manage conflict, regulate their emotions, develop confidence, build self-esteem, and so much more!

As a Pyjama Drama franchisee, you can play a crucial role in helping to develop these all-important skills in your community, making a demonstrable difference to the children you work with, and creating a robust, financially rewarding business at the same time.

records.text: Super straightforward. Really great course format and all areas of the course were well covered with diagrams and voice over and interim quizzes. The trainer was engaging and went to great pains to make sure that the content was understood.

records.title: Easy to use. Good course content

The look of the lessons was a bit disappointing-not much more than a series of 20 year old Powerpoints. Did not need to get help during the course, but very quick response when email sent regarding structure of exam. I would recommend friends to use Kipper.

records.title: Works well... happy customer
records.text: This course works well to learn all the theory: it's a little old fashioned, but it works. It's a good idea to order the plotter and dividers, although a good pair of compasses (with the fine tuning wheel) is also helpful. You don't actually have to do the exam at the end, but I did to give myself some confidence that I knew what I was doing. Don't think that this is a shortcut over other options though: I'm a pretty fast learner who generally finds this stuff quite straightforward, but I spent more hours on this than I would have done on a week-long course. It was simply more convenient.

records.title: Course is well organized into modules…
records.text: Course is well organized into modules with small tests along the way to check your understanding.  The online instructors are very responsive and helpful if you get stuck!

records.title: I liked being able to study on my…
records.text: I liked being able to study on my schedule.  The course was well presented and the learning objectives were clear.  My only complaint was the persistent technical issues I had with the narration.  It frequently just cut out requiring me to close and reopen my browser.

records.title: Great experience
records.text: The course are well done, the access is easy, permanent, you can stop and restart whenever you want, and user friendly. Nevertheless, you have to work on your own...Only one thing was missing for me, it is a short and efficient process to make some exercises.

records.title: Day Skipper Theory
records.text: We signed up to do the Day Skipper Theory course and found it very interesting and easy to follow. It takes a while to do and we both found redoing the lessons a great benefit. The mock papers are very useful but quite a bit harder than the real thing.

records.title: Ocean Yachtmaster Shorebased Course
records.text: This was a well structured course which covered the syllabus very adequately. I found the lectures a little fast at times but as it was on line I could stop and review at any time so this was not a problem. The platform was very stable and super easy to navigate and pick up where I left off.Altogether a good experience.

records.title: It was extremely good for an online…
records.text: It was extremely good for an online course, However my only improvement would be if you could see someone talking (as if you were in a classroom) or if it was a bit more interactive like the RYA safe and fun course for example.

records.title: RYA Day Skipper Theory
records.text: I was pleasantly surprised with the content and overall delivery of the course. Whilst a little apprehensive about self taught online modules, my initial reservations about the lack of face to face learning were unfounded. As a student, you will receive animations and detailed voice overs for all 10 topics. I would fully recommend this to anyone who is interested in the theory side of yachting and wishes to progress onto the practical courses.

records.title: Skippers Online provide very clear…
records.text: Skippers Online provide very clear online lesson materials with useful exercises. They also go into enough detail of elements you ought to know. The chartwork elements are easier because of the practice opportunities offered by the exercises. The three non-chartowork lessons are long and it is up to the student to find ways of retaining this important material. My tip is to revisit your notes from these and work out a way of structuring them to make revision easier.

records.title: Overall, a great course!
records.text: Well rounded, plenty of exam questions for practice and accessibility to all answers makes it easy to work through everything at your own pace. Overall a great course!

records.title: Thorough course
records.text: Over-all a great course with very detailed material that covered the syllabus well. The turn around time on receiving and taking exams was extremely fast and over-all I had no problem following the course.Would be 5 stars if the audio quality across the course had been a bit more consistent (sometimes the volume and audio quality was a bit variable) and if the learning management system dealt with the end of module questions better - the only way to mark them was to compare the PDF emailed to you looked similar to your answers. It would be better if this was done in the browser, and if answers were automatically marked where possible.

records.title: Day Skipper Theory Course

records.title: Course has got stuck in 2017
records.text: I enjoyed the experience of studying with Kipper Sailing but it seemed to me that the Coastal Skipper course had got stuck in 2017. RYA's Safe TRX - an important replacement for Coast Guard 66 from 2019 was not mentioned in the course!On several occasions graphics (which were consistently bright and engaging) were misleading and inaccurate. But when I raised these issues - changes have not been made. An online course has the opportunity to be agile and easily adjusted - but this one isn't. The instructors were always prompt and informative though. Thanks.

records.title: Comprehensive content and a logical…

I would check it out.

records.title: IASSC Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
records.text: I had taken the 6 month course package including IASSC exam from Hudson. I had passed the IASSC Lean Six Sigma Black Belt on 21 June 2024.What did i like about Hudson?The course had a lot of material and was a mixture between webinars and pre-recorded narrated slides. The combination of both provided an engaging learning environment. The course had the official peoplecert study guide which was useful as they are the IASSC examiners.The trainer provided interesting practical examples which one could engage with and understand how lean six sigma is applied in the working environment.In general, Hudson support was good when responding to any queries.What did i not like about Hudson?The IASSC exam was far more difficult than the practice exams that Hudson provides. This is somewhat understandable but what is not, is that the video material that Hudson provides is not fully sufficient to pass the IASSC black belt exam - i had to dig deep into my undergraduate statistics memory (from 10 years back) to answer some of the exam questions. There needs to be a review of the course material provided by Hudson to ensure it is relevant and up to date with what is expected of a candidate in the exam. My success in the exam was a combination of material from Hudson, GoSkills and my undergraduate statistics training.I hope that the above will help the Hudson team to improve the course as i do think they have the necessary building blocks in place:)!

records.title: Ironic Success but foot on ladder
records.text: It feels mildly ironic writing this after blitzing the test. The materials are iterative and effective, and make no mistake it is down to your own hard work once the concise materials have been watched and re-watched. If you're coming in with little to no process control, as I did from a C.I. and Mgmt. system perspective, this will be a learning curve. I hope this review catches the BDM or Quality Manager's eye because the materials need improving, there is inconsistency across the materials and whilst the DMAIC phases can and do overlap or revisit documents and analytical concepts, it seems clear to anyone with a degree of education in transferable studies and used to producing training content would be equally as frustrated as I was going through the green Belt course. For clarity, I will be joining the Black Belt course and doing the exact same as I did here only with more structure now I'm familiar. Hudson would do well to trial this course and gain real time feedback on the clunkiness of the materials - there's no doubt the competence  of the creators is there, but the quality of the process, outline and consistency across the materials really needs looking at. Be prepared to work hard, harder than necessary considering this course material is about LEAN 6 sigma, a topic on process and design and waste (insert puzzled face emoji)

records.title: You won't pass IASSC Black Belt with this course
records.text: This review is for Hudson's IASSC Black Belt course:Pros: good website, easy to access course materials, focussed on real world application of knowledgeCons: you will not pass the IASSC Black Belt using this course alone.  The real exam is far harder than all the sample exams provided, and has a much greater focus on stats and manually calculating stats than Hudson covers.  If you have a good level of stats knowledge (e.g. A Level for UK residents) you might be OK, otherwise you'll need to spend a long time learning inferential statistics, which this course does not cover in sufficient depth to pass the exam

records.title: Inadequate course material & customer support
records.text: The Lean Six Sigma Black Belt course material is not clear - I had to spend hours & hours on free Lean Six Sigma websites to supplement the lectures & course material to be fully prepared. The course notes are poorly structured. The test papers are just PDFs that are 50 pages long so it’s not convenient to print. So you spend a long time writing down your answers (to non-numbered questions) to then go through & manually mark the answers. There are other solutions online for £30 - £40 which have it all automated so it replicates how the exam looks & instantly marks / shows you which questions you got wrong which allows you to focus on value add activities. In addition - the customer support is poor. You have to go through many check box exercises before they will allow you to book your exam. However, the system was incorrectly showing that I hadn’t completed parts of the course. When I highlighted this I got serious attitude from the customer service rep which was not professional. In summary - using the materials & support from Hudson I did not pass first time, then using free bodies of knowledge online & a cheaper £40 solution meant I was able to pass second time.

records.title: Eventual conclusion
records.text: I'm updating my review. While the customer service was fine, the overall experience of the course was below an ideal rate. The course material from Quickstart was poor, initially starting off after some time of using Quickstart I encountered problems accessing the material. I was then redirected to use udemy or some other source, based on my choice. The course in Udemy was great. Thereafter, the material from quickstart was poor. Next the certification material from Hudson, while the teaching was good, there were parts in the teaching which were not covered, which ended up coming for the Measureup exams. The Measure up exams also required a rather extremely arduous task of having to pass about 4 exams consecutively with 90% or higher, which for the difficulty of this course can be rather unrealistic. In the end, I was unable to complete the course and don't intend to renew the subscription. I'm sorry but for the ten thousands of Rupees that was invested into this course, I didn't really get a good outcome as I should have. Even Udemy teaches better and their courses are far more cheaper, even if their certificates are not worth anything, the knowledge is useful.

records.title: Practice exams and important areas of…
records.text: EDIT: Upon request of Hudson I am re-evaluating this review. I still stand by my issues of incorrect tests and poor grammar. The initial response I received in February didn't explain that I could receive a link to this new test system, just the fact they were about to change the system. So, I waited - Over 2 months later, the tests were still the same, the same grammatical errors still present and in this time I'm still paying a large sum for access. Only now this week, 3 months after my first complaint, have the old tests been removed. So, I completely stand by this complaint made at the time as it was relevant. Also only improved the review to a 2 star as a 5 star would be ridiculous and a complete lie, despite this being what the Hudson support person has requested I do!Finally, whether or not Hudson emailed regarding these tests being phased out, they still allowed these tests to be used across their site and failed to acknowledge the entire point of my complaint being that it is hard to actually trust Hudson and their ability to teach someone to pass the course, when the actual testing function they've been using is so bad and off putting. [Original review before edit is below]Practice exams and important areas of the training are so grammatically incorrect it makes no sense. No way to be sure I'm learning the correct practice for these exams. I even complained to Hudson regarding this, who said they would look into it and yet nothing was done. I feel like I've wasted my money and my time.
