records.title: I can’t believe the experience I just…
records.text: I can’t believe the experience I just had with this company. They called me and were extremely rude, refusing to even let me explain my situation. Here’s what happened:The representative accused me of not answering my phone. For the record, I provided two numbers because I genuinely wanted to be reachable, but my main phone was stolen!Then they claimed I didn’t reply to their emails. I NEVER received a proper email from them. Upon checking, I found their emails had gone to my junk folder—and even then, they were all generic messages with nothing specifically addressed to me.We all have busy lives, but speaking to customers in such a condescending and unprofessional manner is absolutely unacceptable. Do yourself a favour and avoid this company if you’re looking for genuine support and success!!!

records.title: No refund for cancer victim
records.text: I paid for a course with Hudson but unfortunately was diagnosed with cancer shortly after. I contacted them to ask for a year extension, in the hope I might recover and be able to complete my learning. They said 6 months was all they were willing to give me. It ended up taking years for me to finally win my battle, after which I asked for a refund as I never used any of their resources or completed any exams etc. Despite producing the relevant doctors certificates I was told they would be keeping my money and were not interested why I wasn’t able to complete the course. Heartless and greedy, not what I expected from a company such as Hudson.

description:
RidleyAcademy is an online music academy which uses a completely new approach to music education, which makes learning music extraordinarily simple, fast, and fun. The Academy's mission is "To Make Artists, Fast", and have a good time doing it! An artist being defined as 'One who can express themselves and their individuality fully in music'. 

All courses are created and taught by the incredibly charismatic Stephen Ridley, an internationally renowned pianist, singer, performer and composer. 

Most of the courses are delivered online, with the exception of the Artist Development Programme, which comes with tickets to a 3.5 day bootcamp where a very small group (10-20 people) are personally guided, drilled and mentored by Stephen Ridley. 

Everything about the Academy is about making music more accessible, enjoyable and evolved, than ever before in history.

records.title: Experience with piano academy Ridley
records.text: The patience and dedication from the theacher to explain things concerning piano exercises is top.They stimulates and guides you to do the exercises every day and twice a week they aske how things are going.For me it was a very fine experience and helpfull year of piano lessons.

records.title: My Mentorship with teacher Madison
records.text: My Mentorship with teacher Madison Johnson is the best. She is very helpful to all of us and very patient! She is a saint to deal with us as well as very knowledgeable in the piano. Her complete focus is on each of us improving. I don't know how far I will get with the piano but she stresses the basics and builds upon that. Thank you Madison!

records.title: Ridley Academy is an AMAZING EXPERIENCE…
records.text: Ridley Academy is an AMAZING EXPERIENCE  Ridley is an Accomplished Musician and Teacher If anyone has the Desire to play Piano, this is the Course for you. Ridley is absolutely Inspiring full of energy and encouraging   His courses are BEST ON THE INTERNET!I would recommend Everyone 8 to 80 Small, Tall, or Crazy to take His Course. It is Wonderful Henry

records.title: I’ve suffered with Dyslexia all my life…
records.text: I’ve suffered with Dyslexia all my life and thought I could never learn how to play the piano. Although it’s challenging, I’m finally able to integrate my brain and hand functions with Stephen’s step by step simple approaches alongside his mentorship program where one-on-one coaching helps me work through the the challenges. I started the program on July and have worked my way up to scales in level 3.

records.title: Stephen Ridley, Ridley Academy
records.text: Stephen Ridley is an amazing person, piano player, and mentor.  I have longed my whole life to learn to play piano.  Stephen made it possible.  Finished the Master Class and joined the mentorship program with a personal weekly Zoom class for continued experience.  Playing the piano is so much more than reading sheet music.  Stephen is so inspiring.  Down? Stuck? Just review the MC video of choice for continued inspiration.  Join the mentorship program - add positive influence in your life and being the artist you dream to be.

records.title: With such a busy schedule
records.text: With such a busy schedule, I’m able to learn how to make a beautiful sound on my piano as my time allows. Watching Mr. Stephen, and Mr. Rex play so beautifully, as well as effortlessly is amazing, and keeps me determined to never quit!  They helped make my joining the Ridley Academy so easy, and their helper Ms. Abbey was wonderful help as well. Their patience is Golden! I really love learning in ‘the Ridley Fashion’ because it makes sense when learning. My piano lessons at a young age always seemed so difficult, and my fingers are to continue working, as long as it may take, instead of getting ‘spatted’ when wrong piano keys are hit, so that one day they will ‘show themselves’ approved, and make beautiful music…in the 528hz when/if ever possible! 🙌🏻☝️🎵🎹🤗. I absolutely Love This Academy

records.title: Learned piano in two months!!!!
records.text: This piano masterclass is phenomenal!!!  If you stick with it, and you do what he asks of you, you ABSOLUTELY will be able to learn and play songs for friends, family and in public within four months, if not sooner! An incredible experience and life changing if you always wanted to play the paino.  I could not recommend it more!!!!

records.title: I've loved this course
records.text: I've loved this course. I've learned much more in a few months than in the past two years following the traditional method. I think it's the best money I've ever spent on training. Plus, Stephen, with his incredible energy, makes you forget your fears and believe in what you're doing. Personally, I recommend this course to anyone who wants to learn to play the piano.

records.title: This is a tremendous uplifting…
records.text: This is a tremendous uplifting experience! Stephen is a joy to listen to and learn from! He is positive, encouraging and concise in his details! I was in a rut with my piano playing and this is bringing new life to my passion to learn this instrument to a new level! Thank you to Stephen for creating the Ridley Academy!

records.title: High Energy and Informative Bites
records.text: Stephen is very high energy and takes the learning process into little steps.  I am very happy for this program because I have played piano a long time ago and have learned some things I actually didn't know.  Plus the fact I can participate in the education on my schedule.  Great information....looking to complete and be the piano player I want to be.

records.title: From the Netherlands, with love
records.text: This company is growing enormous and still like a family. Playing the piano after  more then 50 years is so wonderful,  because you do it step by step and everybody encourages and inspires you. I also bought a mentorship program, expensive but ohhh so good for me....better then a holiday;-)) Teuntje, the Netherlands

records.title: The Ridley Academy is not just about…
records.text: The Ridley Academy is not just about music but also mentioned people to become the better version of themselves.

records.title: Thank you for this opportunity
records.text: Thank you for this opportunity, I have completed the course but I desire to go over it again-my fault!Did not spend the needed time on certain topics so as to master it.I’m going to start over, paying more attention and taking the time that’s required!Overall I think the program is good, wish Stephen had taken more time on some of the hard to understand topics!Thank you .

records.title: Inspiration! Encouragement!
records.text: I'm slowly moving towards my goal of playing without sheet music, composing my own. Thus, only 4 stars. I don't have experience with this yet. BUT! my instructor, who I keep in touch with via email, is so wonderful. She is encouraging, very well informed in response to my questions about technique, and gets back to me consistently within 2-3 days. I was inspired to go back to the piano and the saw the Ridley Academy and joined in, further inspired, and encouraged, by Stephen Ridley. I started almost a year ago and I found myself going back to classical piano, studying Hanon exercises, playing Gershwin and Bach. My technique has blossomed since then and, albeit slowly, I continue to work towards my goal. With my instructor to encourage me, I will get there. I am diligent. It has added greatly to my life.

records.title: Remember to ask questions of the Ridley Academy Instructor
records.text: I have had multiple times I have asked the instructor questions. For example they helped me with questions I had about buying a folding keyboard and on Finger Work in July. I have always received a reply the next day. On July 20th I ask about recommendations for a folding keyboard when I travel as I wanted something that I could take with me easily. One July 29th I asked about the focus of the finger work and what part of my finger to touch the key with. Each time the instructor sent me written additional information beyond what was in the instructional videos. This has been very helpful in my learning.I actually write the instructor and converse with them in email quite often. I talk over anything I want to know more about, or let them know when I'll not be using the videos for multiple days to prevent them sending me the dreaded "Where were you this week Tasia?" email. 4 instead of a 5? Repeatedly sending that message, even after I have told them I am working on something.

records.title: Stephen has great enthusiasm and…
records.text: Stephen has great enthusiasm and commitment to his teaching. However, I found that there was too much theory and not enough practical advice. There really never was much advice or practice on using chords. The claim before I bought the class was that I would be able to play songs easily and quickly. That wasn’t the case. I’m sorry to say I’ve been disappointed.

records.title: So far so good
records.text: So far , so good . Stephen Ridley’s experience and design of what is important and how to get to playing music quicker is affirming. After years of piano joy, I continue to be a life long learner , a novice at song writing, one who needs music in my life . The course started slowly but I am now into the real meat of adding new ideas and possibly negating old fears . My day revolves around music and the piano .

records.title: Making my dream a reality.
records.text: This is an excellent tool, especially for a novice like me. My fingers are sill a bit awkward as I learn navigate the keys but with constant repetition I am slowly improving.Steven is an inspiring teacher and I want to do him proud! It’s been lifelong dream of mine to learn to play the piano and now at 68 Steven is facilitating making this dream a reality. My goal is to play a song at my mother’s 97th birthday celebration this coming July,

records.title: so many times i tried to play a musical instrument .. now i learn  having had a stroke   ;-)
records.text: i tried many times over the years to learn how to play a musical instrument and failed. Stephen Ridley takes the bore out of it, making it really fun and easy to learn,. having had a stroke and whilst challenging i find the finger strengthening exercises  an excellent rehabilitation method but more important enjoyable too..any pause in your learning and they  msg you to offer help if required, you dont get that with any other courses..

records.title: I was a level 4 player and ignored
records.text: I was a level 4 player and ignored, for the most part, anything that had to do with reading music and found myself at a dead end. I found Ridley Academy and saw a chance to kick start something I have always want to do, but dropped out because of the constant slow process of learning, thinking I was the problem. I checked it out and started having fun and enjoying the learning and re-learn of something I have always loved. It hard work but it was in a fun way and it has sparked my enthusiasm. I started about a year ago and went through the course and I am still going. found a baby grand for less than nothing (still in good shape) on the web page they showed me. Nothing but good has come out of it. I am older and I wish this would have been around when I was still very young, but non-the-less, I am doing what I love. They gave me a new excitement of an old desire. Finished the classes and that is just the beginning. Thank you.

records.title: Well organized
records.text: Well organized. Love the fact that you can set your own pace. Also love the fact that time on the website is monitored and someone inquires if you miss significant time out.

records.title: Easy to follow, fun and engaging!
records.text: Easy to follow and with the engaging content and tutorials with having started most recently. So far it is motivating. I can always go back to them on my own time. I like how affordable the course is as well. Right away you can tell how super passionate Stephen is about music and the magic of the piano. I look forward to completing it and to have fun and enjoy it every step of the way, especially when I find things a challenge as a total beginner. So much love, honesty, and great gems being shared from theory to practice that other piano teachers are oblivious or unaware of. Why not give it a try at the least? Love it so far! Thank you. With gratitude from my heart to yours.

records.title: Music to the people, people to the music
records.text: 58 years ago I got music lessons, too much too soon. Now I bought this course and start believing in myself and in music again. I have a lot of fun going step by step through the theory thanks to Stephen who made it all so easy and teach us to have fun!! See you on your own stage people!! With joy and love, Teuntje

records.title: Not good for learning pieces, but great for theory
records.text: If you want to learn to play the piano with set pieces to learn and practice week by week this is not the course for you.  If however, you want a painless way of learning and understanding music theory, Stephen covers that in a unique and entertaining way.

records.title: In the Beginning
records.text: Stephen seems to care about one learning and is excited about the process.  I was lost at the beginning in navigating the platform and haven't taken advantage of the support.  I'll be back as I go through the program to share how things are going forward.

records.title: So far, so good
records.text: I haven’t completed the course so I can’t give 5 stars yet. However, the method so far has been good. From the fundamentals to the exercises, I’m learning a lot. I’ve learned and played scales on a different instrument but the explanation about them makes the most sense I’ve ever heard. I’m enjoying it so far. For those who think this course is too expensive, I paid $25/lesson weekly for a year, in person, a few yrs ago and that’s on the low side for piano lessons so do the math. I didn’t get some of the background I’ve gotten with this course but I did learn a lot of other things with my instructor in person. I’ll write another review once I complete the course.

records.title: I'm learning to use my fingers better
records.text: I'm learning to use my fingers better. I'm going slow because I have limited use of my left. Hopefully I build it up better. Your instructions make sense to aquire knowledge and understanding of playing music. Thank you

records.title: What I focus on becomes bigger
records.text: I have a belief system that everything you focus on becomes bigger. For decades now my bucket list was to play piano but I struggled to find the teacher who was right for me. Then Stephen Ridley appeared in a FB advertisement and here I am now part of the Ridley Academy and family:) In my view having a good grounding before venturing into any activity is paramount. The videos have achieved that grounding for me. All the doubts and skepticism have been washed away because every subject has been unpacked and vocalized enthusiastically, many of which I can personally relate to. To then have a separate section on confidence really was the icing on the cake. Thank you for manifesting all those videos and covering all those topics but especially thank you for your video on confidence and addressing ethics.

records.title: iam really so proud to be a part of…
records.text: iam really so proud to be a part of this amazing Academy....First, I was a person who kinda had issues with believing in myself but going through all this, it brought back my faith in myself I believe I can be what I want to be, do what I want to do. I know I want to be one of the greatest international Gospel singers to inspire the world especially the young people to show them that they can be who they want to be, with their talents, achieve more positively and change their lives for a better world. I can do it,and am already on my journey.  thanks to Stephen Ridley for believing in me, his team and Ridley Academy..

records.title: Reading through the other reviews
records.text: Reading through the other reviews, I must admit that it is easy to believe this is a scam. I taught myself guitar and I did that in an unorthodox manner so I could believe that learning piano in a different way could be possible. The first block of lessons are there to get you in the right mindset, to believe that it is all possible. The second block is there to teach you dexterity and only then does it move forward with notes, octaves, scales etc. Even though I bought the package I was still sceptical and was waiting for the scam penny to drop, but with each new video and practice I was genuinely getting better. I'm not very far into it but I would honestly say that if you can afford it and if you are seriously into the idea of learning piano in a different and more approachable way to consider this course. In this way, my fingers are nimble and piano ready before I even learn to play anything.

records.title: new scales or cords, new keys
records.text: If Steven shows, plays new scales or cordsits hard to see which keys, is it possible to show thembetter!

records.title: Since I am a beginner in piano music
records.text: Since I am a beginner in piano music, the Piano Masterclass course is a course that has really helped me. But I don't think that lessons on music reading are so good that after going through them you can play well enough to sheet music. There should be many more exercises.

records.title: Great course but…..
records.text: Great course, but…absolutely far too expensive for what it deliversStephen is talking a lot about the composition and improvisation courses but they are not part of this “masterclass”.Apparently (at least that is what support says) has there been a live course before covid but not now

records.title: May not be for you if you're a long time piano player.
records.text: Stephen is certainly a force to be reckoned with! Unfortunately, part way into the course I realized that as a long time lifetime piano player at 66 years old, the course was really not for me. I expressed my concerns to the team, but they refused to give me a refund. So at the moment I consider it a colossal waste of money.

records.title: Anxious!
records.text: I am at the point of finding a keyboard so I can continue learning. A bit anxious w very little in checking account. Of course I want the right "touch" and "sound" so I want the best. What a quandary! I appreciate your lively spirit and believable motivation! Let this artist out of her shell !! At 72 I still yearn for my artistic expression and depend on you!

records.title: I have mixed emotions
records.text: I have mixed emotions.  The course itself was solid in that it teaches the fundamentals of the instrument and of playing.  It was also very enjoyable.  I was surprised and disappointed though when the course culminated "Level 10" with playing a song as compared to the marketing videos which showed Stephen playing / improvising and set the expectation that one would be doing much more than playing a basic song at the end of the course.  I hated the Sunday workshop or whatever it was which I was invited to which led to me purchase the course.  It was supposed to an hour in length.  If I recall correctly ours went to at least an hour and forty five.  The first thirty minutes were fine though then make the pitch and the offer and let us get on with our day.  During the course Stephen mentions an Artists Course which he is developing which will get into improvisation and composition.  I am open to exploring that as what I really want to accomplish is sitting down at the piano and making some music out of a handful of chords.  The Master Class gave me the foundation to do so though didn't unlock the ability for me to do so.  Perhaps the issue is me.  Do I recommend the Master Class?  Yes.  Though it fell short of the expectations which I feel the marketing created.

records.title: I was so excited about the masterclass but.....
records.text: I was so excited about the masterclass. I get why he had to fill it with a pack of lies about it being live, I imagine the course is good, but get real, US$1400 is ridiculous, and no payment plan in this day and age.

records.title: Definite Beginner
records.text: So far as I just started the piano masterclass and been doing the finger gym exercises I find that I'm learning more than I have learned in the last year in traditional piano lessons. I never touched a piano before until I started traditional lessons, so basically I'm a complete beginner but I find Stephen very motivating and is teaching me things that I didn't get with traditional lessons. I would recommend Ridley Academy if you are willing to pay attention and do as asked. I enjoy the course very much.

records.title: Amazing program
records.text: Amazing program, but unfortunately I do not have the money at the moment to pay for it. And my daughter did not enjoy it as much.

records.title: New To This
records.text: I just started and I’m loving the program so far. I’m happy I found your academy.

records.title: Is this course real or fake
records.text: Is this course real or fake? Do they give you back the money i mean the refund?

records.title: I am a trained classical pianist but…
records.text: I am a trained classical pianist but have not played in many years. I went to a famous conservatory and you do have to practice for days, hours, and weeks to get more than proficient at it. This might work if you want to play chopsticks or very basic melodies. You will not play like Ridley unless you devote yourself to it. I know many professional musicians. Getting on the concert stage requires pedigree schools and great ability. I am now a professional singer who would like to learn to play jazz interpretation. This won't be the ticket...Sorry to say. Good luck Ridley!!

records.title: Great course for complete beginners but not for anyone who can play sheet music.
records.text: This is a wonderful course for folks that know nothing about the piano or playing.  Stephen is enthusiastic, and does a fabulous job explaining all the aspects of beginning piano.  A complete beginner will be able to understand and play a little at the end of this course.  Unfortunately, I am too advanced for this course.  I am fluent in scales, chords and can play sheet music well.  I misunderstood what Stephen was selling. In his enthusiasm, he doesn't fully explain that this is a course for folks that have never touched the piano.  I have spent over 10 hours going through the course, learning nothing because I am more advanced than the course.  So far, I cannot get any acknowledgement from support for a refund as is promised.

records.title: This course is a complete con
records.text: This course is a complete con, and no way does it justify the price. You do get lots of videos, and an E-Exercise pack but it is all very sub-standard for what you have paid (I paid £1,300 in Nov 2023) And you have to do most of the work on your own. Learning 24 scales (which Stephen says will take you about 90 minutes, haha) actually took me about 4  months, and that was practicing every day.The content is riddled with errors, especially the exercises in the pack, and when I have pointed them out in the comments underneath the videos, they are just ignored, or the reply doesn't actually address the issue, or they refer you on to the support email (which no-one ever replies to, unless it's a generic response). The same goes for other people who post comments voicing dissatisfaction. I have a whole string of unanswered emails to their 'support' team/person.I stuck with the course until June this year, and did actually get to Level 10, but then it was a massive anticlimax as despite having learned the piano to Grade 4 in my teens, I mainly only learned some additional scales and chords. Most of the course covered stuff I already knew, like how to read music and music theory. I didn't learn how to improvise, I didn't learn any new pieces of music and it did not improve my playing of classical music, which is what I wanted from the course. Stephen claims in his 'masterclass' (which is nothing but a sales pitch) that the course is suitable for ALL levels, but this is completely untrue. I can see how it might be helpful for complete beginners, but definitely not for people who can already play and read music, and who understand the theory, and definitely not at that price. Piano-for-all, which gets good reviews, is only £49. The only thing this course has done for me is convince me that I need actual lessons from a proper teacher.

records.title: I got to the end expecting to be able…
records.text: I got to the end expecting to be able to play more than Minuet in G and where the notes were. The Masterclass doesn't leave you anywhere close enough to be able to play as a good player would. I felt taken as I still have to make installments on a course that left we short of its or my goal.

records.title: Suspicious
records.text: I was listening to his Masterclass promotion and his playing was so tacky.   It was painful to anyone with a sense of music.  Anyway, the pdf books promised for those who stuck it to the end didn't arrive.  Instead I got an email saying they'd send a free book if I watched it all over again in the replay!

records.title: Tricksters selling beginner music theory
records.text: The teachings are beginner level, and not worth the price at all. The 100% Money Back Guarantee is boasted consistently but, the course must be completed (they keep tabs on you) before a refund can be requested. This clause is mentioned inconspicuously in some of their sales videos but is quickly veiled by switching the subject back to the deal of a lifetime. Don't waste your money unless you have absolutely no experience in music theory. Spend your money on music lessons with a real life teacher.

records.title: I was deceived
records.text: I was deceived. I attended a masterclass that was 4 hrs long that described how you will be able to play the piano from a scale of zero to a level ten in 6 months. It said if you sign up NOW (red flag) you will receive a special of the course at $13.95. Surprising I was charged $1,941.26. Since I didn’t bargain for this I text the the number that texted me a number of times reminding me of the master class. No one responded to me. However I got a text from another number reminding me of another upcoming masterclass. With a money back guarantee, I thought getting a refund would be easier. Still no refund to date.

records.title: The marketing is mostly hype
records.text: The marketing is mostly hype that can play piano at increasing levels in weeks and months with practicing for 10minutes a day.  I have been taking course for almost 6 months. I practice for 1/2 -1 hour and other than finger drills and struggling  to memorize scales- it doesn’t deliver.The lessons are too short and then instructed to go learn on your own and will be easy and fast- neither are true. I did give it 2 stars as there are some pearls on Learning piano skills but then you are on your own.

records.title: I was so disappointed
records.text: I was so disappointed! An hour and a half gone and never to return. Stephan is likable as all heck. He's charming, self-effacing, and plays like no tomorrow. But, the problem is that I know HE can play which he did beautifully but the strategies to actually learn well were a few items that could have been discussed in about 15 minutes. Very light on any real information. A hard sales pitch at the end was crazy. If he had shown actual technique throughout instead of saying WOW listen to THIS (him playing beautifully) I would have signed up in a minute. If he had offered, say the first lesson or the first 5 lessons free then I'd have more confidence in his program. Now, I just feel sad.

records.title: Informercial
records.text: Infomercial very misleading.   Wanted piano lessons only.  He is selling voice lessons, how to write music, and a whole gammit of other stuff.  SCAM!!

records.title: Every actor should get on Act On This
records.text: Act On This is a hugely informative platform with a wide range of sources made available to the members. Ross’ interviews are always enjoyable to watch / listen to and I always learn so much from each guest and Ross himself. Ross isn’t afraid to ask all the questions that every actor wants to know and he gets such an incredible quality of guests on. Invaluable resource for actors starting out or veterans who want to brush up on their knowledge. Thanks Ross!

records.title: Act On This is a fantastic platform for actors!
records.text: Act On This is a fantastic platform for actors. There are many useful resources including recordings that you can watch in your own time as well as regular live online meetings. It’s a supportive space that helps actors to grow in their careers.

records.title: So worth it!
records.text: Where to begin? There's nothing out there like this. It's informed, with well connected people who humanise the business, making them more approachable with up to date information, very regular Podcasts, insight and the sort of advice that your 'mate who's already made it' will tell you about. And for the money! It makes drama school a waste of time since this is all about the business of the business. (Wow, they work hard, Ross and Petch) It's also very honest with a friendly group whom you can get in touch with at any time - the answers to any questions I've had were responded to within an hour or two (great) and it seems to be only getting bigger. If you're serious and need encouragement, support and advice without any faff or hard sell, this is for you. SO worth it!

records.title: Act on this is a great motivator
records.text: Act on this is a great motivator. By listening to casting directors it helps with understanding the business of being an actor and how to go about trying to get cast. you also feel part of a team of like minded people otherwise you can feel very out there on your own.

records.title: Research. Network Growth. Inspiration. Entertainment.
records.text: ActOnThis is a great actor resource. I have been using it for years for research, network growth, inspiration and entertainment. It is invaluable to listen to interviews with major players in the industry. Not only it is motivating, also, whenever I see a casting director I want to contact I can go through the back catalog and find out exactly how they like to be contacted. Ross Grant puts a lot of his personal experience and life into each talk. You will get to know him and members of the community well.

records.title: Even if you sign up for a month it's worth it
records.text: Ross has put in a huge amount of effort in to the materials (the contact lists as well as interviews) and continues to do so each week. The back catalogue is vast! The guests he has are also very insightful- casting agents, directors, agents but also actors with advice. I had a membership, had to stop for a while but then came back as soon as I could. It's worth having even for a short time, certainly if you can do one of his 5 day challenges to start. Only reason I have not given a 5 star as the amount of content is so overwhelming that a suggested order- like you get in Gravy for the Brain ( V/O course) would help/ improve it.

records.title: Really good source of information for…
records.text: Really good source of information for actors already in a changing industry or people starting in their career. Very supportive and interactive. I have been a member for a number of years.

records.title: Great interviews
records.text: I  love the energy that Ross puts in and there have been some very good interviews with casting agents and directors that have been really usefull.

records.title: Game changer
records.text: Was very sceptical to begin with but Act On This really is a game changer the opportunity to listen and receive constructive feedback from some of the top professionals in the industry is daunting but so valuable.

records.title: Stock trading course back in 2015
records.text: Did the stock trading course back in 2015 in Amsterdam. The 3 days live training were ok. However, the strategy taught turned out to be only suitable for trending markets and the promised leads were worthless. After half a year I quit like the majority of participants from my group of 65. I  did attend some follow-up meetings for 2 years out of curiosity and hardly ever met anybody who was successfull. The majority of 5 star reviews is from the last few months only and almost entirely from participants who just attended the 3 days. Back in 2015 I would have given 5 stars at the same time...Update:Dennis did contact me a few months ago and was very supportive offering me a free online training and weekly signals. I didn’t yet take the offer but like to add a star to the review for this great support.In hindsight it’s easy to recognize that the period I tried IM’s strategy was difficult with no clear direction in the stock markets and thus no opportunities. Sure VCA is always an option but no one needs an expensive workshop to learn such a basic strategy. And ofcourse IM’s workshop just briefly mentioned VCA as there’s not much to say about it. The reason participants enroll are the “always profitable” Buffalo trading strategy which didn’t work during the months I tried.I'll update again once I've done the updated workshop.

records.title: I had bad experiences with the Gold program
records.text: After 2 months of trading according to the strategies of Investment Mastery, I covered way more than the fee in the stock and crypto market. The only thing I'm angry about is that I haven't started earlier because the strategies make trading chilling, even in crazy times.Keith and Dennis deliver valuable content and recommendations from their watchlist every week. They are not offering the fish. They are offering the knowledge of how to fish - also in Q&A webinars.If someone is unsuccessful with the strategies or the platform, it's only because they are not asking questions or executing the teachings. And I was laughing as I read the scammer review of 1 star - don't give it your attention. Focus on your success as I do.Enjoy the process, the ride, the experience and your profits.UPDATE: I’m using my rights as a consumer to write an honest and fair review about my own experience. I joined their Gold Program for 12000€ incl. tax and now I understand the other 1-star reviews by first-hand experience. What I got was I small group of very friendly and good people. I experienced a lot of them extended the Gold program for 4k€ because they had no success in their first year. Other members said they won’t extend their membership due to lack of success with the strategies. Keith and Dennis are very nice people. The webinars cost a lot of time during the day with little to no value to me, even though they had some interesting concepts like evaluating altcoins. The buffalo strategy in the stock market was a losing money strategy for me, even though they sold it as a “done 4 you served on a silver tablet” strategy in the freedom trader seminar by Success Resources. In Gold, they offered to teach “Advanced Buffalo”. I tried it and lost money with their explanations I couldn’t follow. The advanced crypto workshop was a time-wasting seminar during the week - pretty hard as a business owner not selling my own services but following strategies that are not working, even in the bear market. In the bull market everyone is a hero. The workshop would be better as an online course than a multi-day webinar. Slingshot strategy = complex money-losing strategy. That's why I stopped being part of the group and stoped losing money.Despite of the nice guys from investment mastery I regret to got sold on joining Gold Program. My recommendation to you if you consider joining Gold is to stay where you are and stick to the Contrainian momentum strategy. That’s the best strategy ever and recovered my lost 12000€, but not what I lost using the strategies and my time I invested too. That's why I’m not giving just 1-star, but 2.These are my experiences. Learn from it and make your own. All the best.

records.title: Training Strategies Disappointment
records.text: Training Strategies.I undertook the SIA Security/Door Supervisors Training Course between May to June of this year. I passed all three exams out of four. As missed the working in the public sector element session due to injury so was told I need to do this and take the exam in order for me to pass and gain my full SIA licence that Training Strategies was supposed to be paying for. I have contacted training strategies on several occasions to keep me updated as to when I can complete this element and take the exam to gain my SIA Licence which has not come to pass resulting in my SIA Licence application being cancelled. Also told I will not receive the certification for the three exams that I passed until I attend the one outstanding session and take the exam. Yet no update or communication from Training Strategies as to when this can happen. Whilst I accept I could not be granted the licence. I should still have received accreditation for the exams that I sat and passed. I am extremely disappointed in this treatment by Training Strategies and will not be recommending them in future. A complete waste of my time and the wonderful tutors that put in their hard work, time knowledge and effort.

records.text: I took my course back in June and received my results in July after taking my course in Blackpool.I dont see why I should have to continually chase payment for my SIA badge. If I had known for sure that Training Strategies would prolong payment (I assume in order to frustrate people and get them to go away) then I would of just paid for a 6 day course myself. I lost income by having over 2 weeks off work.I won't however let up and shortly, I will take legal action as paying for my badge was part of the agreement I entered into, I think contacting them on 6 occasions now is more than enough!If you are reading this then please PAY for my badge before I write a LBC to you, it will be in the next 7 days!It is a shame as the tutors, especially Kevin Griffiths was exceptional. However I can only truly rate on the whole package and as yet they have failed to deliver.*** EDIT *** 28th September 2021After much badgering and needing to potentially take legal action, I finally received payment for the SIA Licence last Friday 24/09/21, Post Office done the next day and notified that I have my SIA Licence yesterday 28/09/21, so just TWO working  days to get the licence.So I have my licence now but Training Strategies could of made it easier and I am extremely disappointed with their customer service and communication (lack of or misleading).That being said, the actual course was good as were the tutors, notably Donovan Hutchinson and Kevin Griffiths in particular. They made the course enjoyable.Course started 10th June for 14 working days, results received 26th July and payment for licence 24th September. That is most likely your MINIMUM timescale.If you are reading this though, do you know when I will get my certificates???

description:
Britannia School of Academics is a UK based training provider, focusing on delivering courses to education professionals. As educators ourselves, we found that often training providers lack the flexibility that suits most educators when it comes to undertaking courses. Either there is a schedule, a lack of self-study materials, or tutors have less knowledge about the course topics than you do.
This is where we stepped up as an online training provider of education and training courses, with completely flexible study time, great material, and knowledgeable tutor support- all at a very disruptive price point. Each year 2000+ learners choose us on their journey to upgrading their professional career, and more than 1500 corporate clients trust us for the training of their employees. Our staff has a wealth of experience in education and training. We take pride in our quality and aim to provide our learners with the best chance of further employment, through free career guidance and advice.

What we Offer
Mobility To Learn Whenever and Wherever 
Online education and training courses at affordable learning schedules and prices
Expert Instruction 
Flexible study, great materials & knowledgeable tutor support
Learner Support 
Full tutor support through emails, VLE, discussion forums and live sessions.
Professional Development 
Free career guidance & advice. Our aim is to provide our learners with the best chance of further employment.
No Compromise on Quality  
Complete guarantee of the quality of our offered courses as we make no compromise on the standards set for our OfQual accredited qualifications.

records.title: Diploma in Education and Training
records.text: I completed my DET Level 5 with Britannia School of Academics, and I would recommend this organisation.The feedback they provided throughout and the areas for development identified were always aiming to get the best out of my work, stretching my knowledge and inviting me to contextualise as much as I could. Being a qualified assessor myself, I believe this is excellent. I did not give a 5 stars for one main reason: they do not really have a teaching element in the course, meaning that apart from a list of resources there is no "pre-work" support that learners can benefit from. I did appreciate some audio recordings and slides which attempted to provide this, however only two assignments out of five had such resource, affecting the consistency and overall quality of the support. If they rectified this, they would be a top school since, as mentioned, the coaching and evaluations were admirable. Arsalan and Rosa came across very positive, always there to support if needed, which was appreciated!

records.title: I studied with School of Academics for…
records.text: I studied with School of Academics for my level 4 certificate in education and training. I don't really regret my decision but be warned that their online courses are no match of the traditional face to face learning. You are pretty much on your own finding your way through the course and completing the tasks without much help. I mean there are guides and books, but if you are used to attending lectures before doing assessment then you will struggle. Also, no deadlines mean that you will struggle to self motivate to complete the course on a fast track basis. I guess it's just an individual decision and I hope I am not being too harsh. To be fair to them, my tutor was always prompt in marking my assignment but I almost always had to resubmit as she always wanted me to do more. I am just glad that I am done with this, no more courses for me at least for another one year.

Please do not waste your money and time.

records.title: Poor experience
records.text: Poor experience. Incompetent Tutor who couldn't answer any of my queries and clearly did not know about the course. Everything is done by Moodle, no email exchange even though this is a distant learning course. It's done by Moodle so the School can claim that the tutor answered one's query and did their job even though they're just replying from a script that clearly has nothing to do with the actual question asked. Avoid.

records.title: I had to withdraw literally the next…
records.text: I had to withdraw literally the next day as received call from the hospital to say my parent had a stroke, didnt even start the course, rang them to say wouldnt be able to start could i have a refund, told to email, did, got receipt for email being read, no response and then email from a tutor welcoming me. my parent has since passed away now so in a week lost a parent and no support from these, they just want the money..... worst company on the planet do not go near them

records.title: Level 5 DET
records.text: The process to enrol on your course is relatively straightforward, which is very helpful. Unfortunately, starting your practice is something else. The introduction video has information which is confusing to the learner. Additionally, the learner has to spend quality time to understand the process of the course and how to start it. Go to the forum to find an answer to your question. There is no guidance from the tutor. The team has removed the units, and it is only assignments. However, those assignments required you to refer to those units to achieve your task. They have not changed the introduction video information. Next is to listen to someone, not seeing the person explain those assignments, which is not pleasant to listen to when you are tired after a long day of work(I prefer to read). You only see the PowerPoint. I can not ask for a refund as I already have the course, but if I had known it would be like this, I would have never signed with them. I'm very disappointed with the structure.

description: A fast track barbering academy for beginners, advanced & intermediate. Created by Jake Hillery the owner of international barbering brand, The Quarters.

records.title: 2 week Deluxe barber course
records.text: Just finished a 2 week course in the Birmingham academy and honestly can not fault it, my tutor jack was an absolute legend and had time and patience and could always go to him if you had a question. The course helped me loads and found something I want to do for not just a hobby but a career path. Thanks to jack again can’t fault the lad.

records.title: always a great service with great trade…
records.text: always a great service with great trade professional people Credit to their teachers just had another haircut absolutely loved it thank you again Patsy hope you do well for the future, keep it up guys

records.title: I have just completed my 2 weeks deluxe…
records.text: I have just completed my 2 weeks deluxe course in Camden Town with Tim and I can’t thank him or the quarters enough. They have given me so much knowledge in the past 2 weeks that Im now more than confident to tackle any hair. Highly recommend the academy whether you are near Birmingham,Northampton or London. You wont be dissapointed.

records.title: Went to the course not knowing a thing…
records.text: Went to the course not knowing a thing about barbering, never even touched a clipper, but as soon as the second day there we was already cutting hair with the assistance of jack, which i cant thank enough for doing everything he has for everyone on the course. Thankyou quarters academy!! Highly recommend!

records.title: Great course
records.text: Great course, so grateful got to cut on live models, Jake has set up a great structure, Jack is an unreal barber and teacher. Very laid back, great mixture of personalities, really enjoyed it, also made some friends for life. I have no opened my own barbershop!

records.title: As a student of QBA it's been exciting…
records.text: As a student of QBA it's been exciting and an absolutely life changing experience for me personally. The amount I've learnt from jacks has been overwhelming but crucial to the pivotal point of finding work afterwards and progressing my career. The teachers have a great duty of care in assisting us reaching our goals. I've really benefitted from learning at this academy, hope to continue to learn more and I feel like I am learning more as time goes by from my personal day to day . 100% recommended to anyone looking to start a new career in barbering /hairdressing.

records.title: Exceptional course!!!
records.text: Been to the course as it was exceptional to say the least! The staffs attention to detail was superb! I’ve left the course feeling competent and ready to start cutting hair! Would highly recommend to anyone wanting to get started in the barbering world!

records.title: Birmingham Academy
records.text: Attended the Birmingham academy in June. The trainer Aaron was very friendly, going in to a new career can be very daunting but Aaron eased any worries but explaining what it was like when he made the career move. After a week of the course jake the owner paid for a highly skilled hairdresser/barber trainer Tim come in from London who has years of industry experience. It was good to see how both trainers Aaron and Tim approached cuts differently but both came out with a high standard of cut. The facilities we good too, never working in a barber shop the academy gave you a real feel for what its like to work in a barber shop which make you even more keen to get in to the industry. The course is cheap but don't let that put you off, i researched courses all over the in both Scotland and England and nothing offer the same level of content. Would highly recommend!

records.title: Course was amazing and has massively…
records.text: Course was amazing and has massively helped me accelerate my career as a barber. Landed my dream job after having the opportunity to show my new skills on plenty of models. Can't thank the guys enough!

records.title: Excellent course!
records.text: My wife purchased this course for me as I wanted to get into barbering. I was very pleasantly surprised, everyone on the course was really friendly and the teachers (Chris and Aaron at the time) I had were excellent. Very friendly, passionate and made you feel comfortable. Definitely made some new friends! The course was very easy to understand, they went through things step by step and nothing was too much trouble. I met Jake (owner) one day of the course and he was also very pleasant. I’m really glad I went on this course, it helped me determine that barbering was the career I wanted to get into. I’ve since gone on to further my education because personally I want to become an assessor in the future. You don’t have to go down this route, you will become shop ready as long as you listen and put the graft in! Would highly recommend to anyone who wants to learn the fundamentals and gain confidence. For the price you can’t go wrong!

records.title: Badly organised
records.text: I attended the course a while ago in Northampton. The first day we got there we were waiting outside the barber shop and the instructor turned up late and didn’t seem to care we were all waiting. They claim the course is”half price” but this has been the price for about 2 years now…during the two weeks there was hardly any models and most of the day we were sitting around chatting as they didn’t even provide head dolls to learn on. They claim you can learn other skills such as wet towel shave, in reality you see this done once by the instructor. Jake was no where to be seen but the instructor Chris did his best but agreed the course was badly organised. I tried to complain but told the lack of models was due to covid hence the “50% off” I think the course is a bit of a show and they care more about social media looks then anything else. I would go elsewhere. Another pet peeve is the majority of the reviews are from his own staff members, defiantly not a true representation.

records.title: Do NOT book onto this course
records.text: Do NOT book onto this course! went to Portugal on holiday on the day he was meant to be teaching our course. No equipment to practice on and no advertisement in place for free haircuts so no clients hair to cut. Charged £700 to sit in a chair in the academy for 2 weeks cutting no hair while Jake Hillery is posting videos on his Instagram doing balloons and ignoring phone calls from his staff who are asking for his help. AVOID at all costs. The guy cares more about his social media image than the barbering industry!

records.title: Deposit paid for course
records.text: Deposit paid for course - date and times changed which then included weekends and longer days which wasn’t acceptable as course was originally booked for specific dates, when schedule was agreed the company didn’t take into account bank holidays - would not refund, requested call back to discuss heard nothing - deposit lost.  Found communication on telephone very abrupt and not forthcoming.  Only correspondence received was to request payment! Would not recommend.
